caveats.location: 第6格扩散/退火工艺说明
caveats.original_text: 通过高温扩散或退火，激活杂质并修复晶格损伤，使掺杂分布更均匀，性能更稳定。
caveats.explanation_zh: 退火可激活掺杂并修复损伤，但目标不一定是把掺杂分布变均匀。浅结等工艺常要求在实现激活的同时限制扩散，保持设计的掺杂轮廓。

caveats.suggested_annotation_en: Annealing can activate dopants and repair damage, but a more uniform profile is not always the goal. Shallow-junction processes often seek activation with limited diffusion to preserve the designed profile.

title.zh: 一张图看懂半导体8大工艺
title.en: Eight semiconductor processes at a glance

subtitle.zh: 氧化、光刻、刻蚀、沉积、注入、退火、互连、封装测试
subtitle.en: Oxidation, lithography, etch, deposition, implantation, annealing, interconnect, and test/packaging

body.zh: 在硅片表面生长一层二氧化硅（SiO₂），用于绝缘、掩蔽或作为后续工艺的基础。
body.en: Grow silicon dioxide (SiO₂) on silicon for insulation, masking, or subsequent processing.

body.zh: 流程：硅片清洗 → 高温氧化炉通入 O₂ 或 H₂O → 生长 SiO₂ 层 → 膜厚检测。关键设备：氧化炉。作用：形成绝缘层、保护层或掩蔽层。
body.en: Flow: wafer cleaning → supply O₂ or H₂O in a high-temperature oxidation furnace → grow SiO₂ → measure thickness. Key equipment: oxidation furnace. Purpose: insulating, protective, or masking layers.

body.zh: 将掩膜版图通过光刻投影转移到晶圆上，形成图形化的掩膜层。
body.en: Project the mask pattern onto a wafer to create a patterned masking layer.

body.zh: 流程：旋涂光刻胶 → 软烘 → 对准与曝光（紫外光）→ 显影 → 硬烘 → 图形检查。关键设备：光刻机（DUV/EUV）。作用：把掩模板图形转移到光刻胶。
body.en: Flow: spin coat resist → soft bake → alignment and UV exposure → develop → hard bake → inspect pattern. Key equipment: DUV/EUV lithography tool. Purpose: transfer the mask pattern into resist.

body.zh: 利用化学或物理方法去除未被光刻胶保护的材料，形成沟槽、孔洞或图形结构。
body.en: Chemically or physically remove material unprotected by resist to form trenches, holes, or patterned structures.

body.zh: 流程：光刻胶保护 → 刻蚀去除暴露区域 → 形成图形结构 → 去除光刻胶 → 清洗残留物 → 结果检测。关键设备：刻蚀机（干法/湿法）。作用：实现图形结构的刻蚀与材料去除。
body.en: Flow: protect with resist → etch exposed areas → form structures → strip resist → clean residues → inspect. Key equipment: dry/wet etcher. Purpose: pattern etching and material removal.

body.zh: 在晶圆表面沉积所需薄膜材料，如绝缘层、导电层、阻挡层等。
body.en: Deposit required films on the wafer, including insulating, conducting, and barrier layers.

body.zh: 图示步骤：通入反应气体或金属原子 → 材料在表面成核并生长 → 薄膜沉积完成 → 腔体抽空 → 冷却 → 膜厚与均匀性检测。关键设备：CVD/PVD/ALD 设备。作用：沉积功能薄膜，构建器件结构。
body.en: Illustrated steps: supply reactive gases or metal atoms → surface nucleation and growth → complete deposition → evacuate chamber → cool → measure thickness and uniformity. Key equipment: CVD/PVD/ALD systems. Purpose: deposit functional films and build device structures.

body.zh: 将特定杂质离子注入硅片，改变其电学特性，形成 P 型、N 型等掺杂区域。图中离子：B⁺、P⁺、As⁺。
body.en: Implant selected dopant ions into silicon to change electrical properties and form P-type or N-type regions. Illustrated ions: B⁺, P⁺, As⁺.

body.zh: 流程：光刻定义注入区域 → 离子加速 → 离子注入 → 去除光刻胶 → 退火激活掺杂 → 检测掺杂分布。关键设备：离子注入机。作用：精确控制掺杂浓度与深度。
body.en: Flow: lithographically define implant areas → accelerate ions → implant → strip resist → anneal to activate dopants → measure dopant profile. Key equipment: ion implanter. Purpose: control dopant concentration and depth precisely.

body.zh: 通过高温扩散或退火，激活杂质并修复晶格损伤，使掺杂分布更均匀、性能更稳定。
body.en: High-temperature diffusion or annealing activates dopants and repairs lattice damage, making the dopant distribution more uniform and performance more stable.

body.zh: 图示内容：进入高温炉 → 高温扩散/退火 → 杂质扩散（更均匀）；修复晶格损伤、激活掺杂原子、冷却。关键设备：扩散炉/快速退火炉（RTA）。作用：激活掺杂、修复损伤、调整结深。
body.en: Diagram: enter high-temperature furnace → diffusion/anneal → dopant diffusion (more uniform); lattice-damage repair, dopant activation, and cooling. Key equipment: diffusion furnace / rapid thermal annealing (RTA) furnace. Purpose: activate dopants, repair damage, adjust junction depth.

body.zh: 在芯片上形成金属布线，实现器件之间的电气连接。
body.en: Form metal wiring on the chip to electrically connect devices.

body.zh: 流程：刻蚀通孔/沟槽 → 沉积阻挡层/种子层 → 填充金属（Cu/Al 等）→ CMP 去除多余金属 → 形成金属连线 → 多层互连结构。关键设备：PVD/CVD、刻蚀机、CMP 设备。作用：实现信号传输、电源分配与多层连接。
body.en: Flow: etch vias/trenches → deposit barrier/seed → fill metal (Cu/Al, etc.) → CMP removes excess metal → form wiring → build multilayer interconnect. Key equipment: PVD/CVD, etcher, CMP. Purpose: signal transmission, power distribution, and multilayer connections.

body.zh: 对晶圆和芯片进行电学测试、切割、封装，确保芯片性能与可靠性。
body.en: Electrically test, dice, and package wafers and chips to ensure performance and reliability.

body.zh: 流程：晶圆电学测试（CP）→ 标记合格/不合格 → 晶圆切割 → 芯片贴装 → 引线键合/倒装焊 → 塑封/封装 → 成品测试（FT）→ 老化与可靠性测试 → 包装出货。关键设备：测试机、切割机、贴片机、封装机。作用：保证芯片性能，提供机械保护与电气连接。
body.en: Flow: wafer electrical test (CP) → mark pass/fail → dice → die attach → wire bonding/flip-chip bonding → molding/packaging → final test (FT) → burn-in and reliability tests → ship. Key equipment: tester, dicer, die bonder, packaging tool. Purpose: ensure performance, mechanical protection, and electrical connection.

uncertain: 右下角水印与末项正文邻接；完整图表保留，不能以裁切同时彻底去水印。

title.zh: CMP：把表面磨平但不磨坏
title.en: CMP: planarize without damage

subtitle.zh: 平坦度、去除率、缺陷要平衡
subtitle.en: Balance planarity, removal rate, and defects

body.zh: 1. 晶圆面朝下固定，贴合垫片，施加压力。2. 供给抛光液，通过抛光垫和抛光液的化学与机械作用去除材料。3. 表面被平坦化；原图表述为“高点被去除，低点被填充，实现全局平坦化”。4. 检查刮伤、颗粒、腐蚀等缺陷。
body.en: 1. Fix the wafer face down against the pad and apply pressure. 2. Supply slurry; chemical and mechanical action of the pad and slurry removes material. 3. Planarize the surface; the source states “high points are removed and low points are filled to achieve global planarization.” 4. Inspect scratches, particles, corrosion, and other defects.

body.zh: 平坦度：降低全局/局部不平坦度，均匀性为关键。去除率：材料去除应稳定、可控、均匀；图中纵轴为厚度（Å）、横轴为时间，厚度随时间下降。
body.en: Planarity: reduce global/local nonplanarity; uniformity is essential. Removal rate: stable, controllable, uniform material removal. The plot shows thickness (Å) decreasing with time.

body.zh: 缺陷控制：凹陷/蚀损（Dishing/Erosion）与刮伤（Scratch）；控制刮伤、颗粒、腐蚀，避免引入新缺陷。
body.en: Defect control: dishing/erosion and scratches. Control scratches, particles, and corrosion to avoid new defects.

body.zh: 测量薄膜厚度、全局/局部平坦度及颗粒/刮伤/腐蚀。根据反馈调整下压力、抛光垫类型/状态、抛光液配方/流量、转速（晶圆/垫）及抛光时间。
body.en: Measure film thickness, global/local planarity, and particles/scratches/corrosion. Use feedback to adjust downforce, pad type/condition, slurry formulation/flow, wafer/pad speed, and polishing time.

notes.zh: 原图的“低点被填充”是需要核实的机制表述；这里保留原话，不能将其作为所有 CMP 过程的通用机理。
notes.en: The source statement that “low points are filled” needs verification; it is retained here and should not be treated as the universal mechanism of CMP.

title.zh: 离子注入：把掺杂打进硅里
title.en: Ion implantation: introducing dopants into silicon

subtitle.zh: 剂量、能量、角度影响器件电性
subtitle.en: Dose, energy, and angle affect device electrical properties

body.zh: 1. 离子源：气体电离产生掺杂离子。2. 质量选择：质量分析器筛选目标离子。3. 离子束：通过加速电压形成高能离子束。4. 通过光刻掩膜：掩膜定义注入区域；截面标注为光刻掩膜、氧化层、硅片（Si）。5. 掺杂进入硅中：离子在硅中减速，形成掺杂分布。
body.en: 1. Ion source: ionize gas to produce dopant ions. 2. Mass selection: a mass analyzer selects target ions. 3. Ion beam: an accelerating voltage creates a high-energy beam. 4. Pass through a lithographic mask defining implantation areas; the cross-section labels mask, oxide, and silicon wafer. 5. Ions slow in silicon and form a dopant distribution.

body.zh: 分布标注：高浓度峰值（Rp 附近）、掺杂尾部；通道效应风险指离子沿晶向深穿；结深在原图标为 Rj，影响结深与器件隔离。退火激活用于修复晶格损伤、激活掺杂并扩散。
body.en: Profile labels: high-concentration peak near Rp and dopant tail. Channeling risk means ions penetrate deeply along crystal directions. Junction depth is labeled Rj in the source and is associated with junction depth and device isolation. Activation annealing repairs lattice damage, activates dopants, and causes diffusion.

body.zh: 剂量决定掺杂浓度，影响片阻与阈值电压。能量决定离子穿透深度（Rp），影响结深与横向扩散；曲线纵轴为浓度、横轴为深度。
body.en: Dose determines dopant concentration and affects sheet resistance and threshold voltage. Energy determines ion penetration depth (Rp), affecting junction depth and lateral diffusion. The plot axes are concentration and depth.

body.zh: 角度影响投影分布与通道效应，倾角注入可减轻通道效应。图中 θ 为相对法线的入射角。
body.en: Angle affects the projected distribution and channeling; tilted implantation can reduce channeling. θ is the angle relative to the surface normal.

body.zh: 反馈项目：片阻（Rs）、SIMS（浓度—深度分布）、电性测试（I–V 曲线）。量测结果用于调整剂量、能量、角度，闭环优化工艺。
body.en: Feedback: sheet resistance (Rs), SIMS concentration-versus-depth profiles, and electrical I–V tests. Results guide dose, energy, and angle adjustments in a closed optimization loop.

uncertain: 底部反馈箭头或文字接近水印，裁切优先保留完整实质内容。

title.zh: 光刻：把图形投到晶圆上
title.en: Lithography: projecting patterns onto a wafer

subtitle.zh: 核心看 CD、overlay 与工艺窗口
subtitle.en: Focus on CD, overlay, and process window

body.zh: 涂胶 → 曝光 → 显影 → 图形化胶层。图中堆栈为光刻胶/SiO₂/Si 晶圆，UV 光通过掩模板（Mask）照射光刻胶。
body.en: Coat resist → expose → develop → patterned resist. The illustrated stack is resist/SiO₂/Si wafer; UV light passes through a mask onto the resist.

body.zh: CD 控制：检查线宽（CD）过大或过小。Overlay 对准：比较参考层与目标图形，检查图形偏移。焦深窗口：关注偏离焦点（Z）时的工艺窗口（焦深）。
body.en: CD control: check whether linewidth is too large or too small. Overlay alignment: compare reference layer and target pattern for displacement. Depth-of-focus window: monitor the process window as focus offset Z changes.

body.zh: CD-SEM 量测图像与线形信号用于确定 CD；overlay 量测给出 ΔX、ΔY 偏移量。量测反馈用于优化工艺。
body.en: CD-SEM images and signal profiles determine CD; overlay metrology reports offsets ΔX and ΔY. Feed these measurements back to optimize the process.

uncertain: 底部反馈箭头或文字接近水印，裁切优先保留完整实质内容。

title.zh: 薄膜沉积：把材料长到该长的位置
title.en: Thin-film deposition: growing material where needed

subtitle.zh: 厚度、均匀性、覆盖性与应力
subtitle.en: Thickness, uniformity, coverage, and stress

body.zh: 1. 晶圆进入沉积腔体。2. 前驱体/等离子体/靶材源提供材料。3. 材料在表面沉积，薄膜生长并覆盖形貌。4. 覆盖性检查：区分理想覆盖、不理想的侧壁覆盖及粒子缺陷。
body.en: 1. Load the wafer into the deposition chamber. 2. Precursors/plasma/target sources provide material. 3. Material deposits and grows over surface topography. 4. Inspect coverage: distinguish ideal coverage from inadequate sidewall coverage and particle defects.

body.zh: 厚度均匀性：全片厚度一致性，色阶由厚到薄。覆盖性：台阶覆盖/缝隙填充能力；图中标注 Ttop、Tbottom。膜应力：拉应力/压应力影响翘曲与可靠性。
body.en: Thickness uniformity: consistent thickness across the wafer, shown by a thick-to-thin color scale. Coverage: step coverage/gap-fill capability, labeled Ttop and Tbottom. Film stress: tensile/compressive stress affects bow and reliability.

body.zh: 膜厚量测（椭偏/反射率）、厚度均匀性映射（全片扫描）、应力量测（翘曲/激光曲率）、缺陷检测（颗粒/表面缺陷）。反馈调节工艺参数。
body.en: Measure thickness by ellipsometry/reflectometry, map uniformity over the wafer, measure stress using bow/laser curvature, and inspect particles/surface defects. Feed results back to adjust process parameters.

uncertain: 底部反馈箭头或文字接近水印，裁切优先保留完整实质内容。

title.zh: 量测检测：让工艺闭环
title.en: Metrology and inspection: closing the process loop

subtitle.zh: 用数据判断窗口、波动与良率风险
subtitle.en: Use data to assess windows, variation, and yield risk

body.zh: 1. 执行刻蚀、沉积、光刻、清洗等工艺步骤。2. 线内量测（Inline Metrology）：CD/线宽、overlay/套刻、膜厚（Film）。3. 缺陷检测（Defect Inspection）：晶圆缺陷图（Defect Map）以蓝色表示随机缺陷、红色表示簇状缺陷（Cluster）。
body.en: 1. Execute etch, deposition, lithography, cleaning, or other steps. 2. Inline metrology measures CD/linewidth, overlay, and film thickness. 3. Defect inspection produces a wafer defect map: blue for random defects and red for clusters.

body.zh: 4. SPC 趋势（Statistical Process Control）：跟踪关键尺寸（CD）与膜厚随时间的变化；图中有均值、±2σ、±3σ 标线，CD 末点到达约 +3σ 并标红，膜厚围绕均值波动。
body.en: 4. Statistical process control (SPC): track CD and film thickness over time. Plots show the mean, ±2σ, and ±3σ; the final CD point reaches about +3σ and is highlighted red, while thickness fluctuates around its mean.

body.zh: 5. 工程师判定超出控制限/异常，分析设备、工艺、材料等根因，并评估良率风险。
body.en: 5. Engineers identify out-of-control or abnormal behavior, analyze equipment/process/material root causes, and assess yield risk.

body.zh: 6. 调整配方/窗口：调整功率、压力、时间等工艺参数；收窄窗口以提升稳定性；优化工艺窗口以提升良率。随后回到工艺执行，执行更新后的配方并进入下一批次，形成反馈闭环。
body.en: 6. Adjust recipe/window: modify power, pressure, time, and other parameters; narrow the window to improve stability and optimize the process window for yield. Return to processing with the updated recipe for the next batch to close the loop.

title.zh: 刻蚀：不是简单挖洞
title.en: Etching: more than making holes

subtitle.zh: 选择比、形貌、残留要一起看
subtitle.en: Consider selectivity, profile, and residue together

body.zh: 1. 图形化后的掩膜/硬掩膜；堆栈为光刻胶、硬掩膜、目标层、衬底。2. 等离子体刻蚀；图中标注 RF 与气体（Cl₂/Ar 等）。3. 形成沟槽，检查刻蚀后形貌。4. 刻蚀后残留检查。
body.en: 1. Patterned mask/hard mask; stack: resist, hard mask, target layer, substrate. 2. Plasma etching, with RF and gases such as Cl₂/Ar. 3. Form trenches and examine the etched profile. 4. Inspect post-etch residue.

body.zh: 选择比：目标层刻蚀速率远大于掩膜刻蚀速率。侧壁形貌：角度、弯曲度、粗糙度影响器件性能。残留损伤：残留聚合物/原生氧化层影响后续工艺与可靠性。
body.en: Selectivity: the target layer etches much faster than the mask. Sidewall profile: angle, bowing, and roughness affect device performance. Residue/damage: residual polymers or native oxide affect subsequent processes and reliability.

body.zh: 以截面（SEM/FIB）、CD（临界尺寸）及缺陷检测为反馈，进行工艺调整和持续优化。
body.en: Use cross-sections (SEM/FIB), critical dimension (CD), and defect inspection to adjust and continuously optimize the process.

title.zh: 氧化：长出关键绝缘层
title.en: Oxidation: growing a critical insulating layer

subtitle.zh: 关注厚度、均匀性与界面质量
subtitle.en: Monitor thickness, uniformity, and interface quality

body.zh: 裸硅片（Si）→ 炉管热氧化 → 在硅上生长 SiO₂。
body.en: Bare silicon wafer (Si) → thermal oxidation in a furnace tube → SiO₂ growth on silicon.

body.zh: 控制厚度、SiO₂/Si 界面质量及热预算。厚度图横轴为位置、纵轴为厚度；热预算由温度计与时钟示意。量测反馈包含膜厚、EOT、电性；电性图为 I–V 曲线。
body.en: Control thickness, SiO₂/Si interface quality, and thermal budget. The thickness plot uses position and thickness axes; a thermometer and clock illustrate thermal budget. Feedback includes film thickness, EOT, and electrical properties, illustrated by an I–V curve.

title.zh: 清洗：不是简单洗干净
title.en: Cleaning: more than washing a wafer

subtitle.zh: 控制颗粒、金属污染与表面残留
subtitle.en: Control particles, metal contamination, and surface residue

body.zh: 晶圆盒（进片）→ 化学浴/喷淋清洗（去污染）→ DI 水漂洗（去残留）→ 干燥（去水迹）。
body.en: Wafer cassette/loading → chemical bath or spray clean to remove contamination → DI-water rinse to remove residues → drying to remove watermarks.

body.zh: 颗粒控制：减少颗粒附着与再沉积。残留去除：去除化学残留与金属离子。表面状态：获得洁净、稳定的表面。
body.en: Particle control: reduce adhesion and redeposition. Residue removal: remove chemical residues and metal ions. Surface condition: obtain a clean, stable surface.

body.zh: 以缺陷图和表面检查反馈清洗结果。原图缺陷密度色阶由蓝色（低）到红色（高）。
body.en: Use defect maps and surface inspection as cleaning feedback. The source color scale runs from blue (low defect density) to red (high).

title.zh: 一张图看懂功函数
title.en: Work function at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从真空能级、费米能级到 Vth 与金属栅选择
subtitle.en: From vacuum and Fermi levels to Vth and metal-gate selection

heading.zh: 01 核心定义与 02 半导体差异

body.zh: 真空能级减费米能级才是功函数：Φ = E_vac − E_F。电子逸出需要克服功函数。掺杂、表面态和能带弯曲都会改变测得值；图中对比 n 型、本征、p 型，并标注 E_C、E_F、E_V。
body.en: Work function is vacuum level minus Fermi level: Φ = E_vac − E_F. Electron emission must overcome this energy. Doping, surface states, and band bending affect measured values; the diagrams compare n-type, intrinsic, and p-type materials with E_C, E_F, E_V labels.

heading.zh: 03 接触机制与 04 栅极作用

body.zh: 接触前金属与半导体各有费米能级；接触后费米能级对齐，界面重新分配电荷。有效功函数通过平带电压参与调节 Vth。栅结构为金属栅（功函数 Φ_M）/High-k/Si，配有 C–V 与 I_d–V_g 曲线，后者标出 Vth 及 10⁻³、10⁻⁶、10⁻⁹ 电流刻度。
body.en: Before contact, metal and semiconductor have separate Fermi levels; after contact, Fermi levels align and interface charge redistributes. Effective work function contributes to Vth through flat-band voltage. The illustrated gate is metal (Φ_M)/high-k/Si, with C–V and I_d–V_g curves; the latter marks Vth and current ticks 10⁻³, 10⁻⁶, 10⁻⁹.

heading.zh: 05 工艺调控与 06 异常诊断

body.zh: 材料、界面偶极、厚度和热预算共同塑造 EWF。堆栈从上到下为填充金属、功函数金属（WFM）、界面偶极层、高介电常数层（High-k）、硅衬底。
body.en: Materials, interface dipoles, thickness, and thermal budget jointly shape EWF. From top to bottom: fill metal, work-function metal (WFM), interface-dipole layer, high-k layer, silicon substrate.

body.zh: Vth 漂移要区分栅堆栈（功函数/界面）、介质（电荷/陷阱）与沟道（掺杂/应力）的贡献。图中以初始与漂移后直方图、晶圆 Vth 热图（红色高、蓝色低）展示分布。
body.en: Vth drift requires separating gate-stack (work function/interface), dielectric (charge/traps), and channel (doping/stress) contributions. Initial and shifted histograms and a wafer Vth heatmap (red high, blue low) illustrate the distributions.

heading.zh: 07 整合权衡与 08 工艺选择

body.zh: Vth、变异性、可靠性和填充能力一起优化；图中给出 GAA 栅槽填充示意。先判断控制的是表面、接触还是栅堆栈。
body.en: Optimize Vth, variability, reliability, and fill capability together; a GAA gate-trench fill schematic illustrates the trade-off. First decide whether the target is a surface, contact, or gate stack.

body.zh: 表面表征：表面能级、表面态密度、能带弯曲。接触工程：界面电荷、接触势垒、费米能级钉扎。MOS 栅堆栈：金属栅功函数、介质厚度与质量、界面偶极工程。
body.en: Surface characterization: surface energy levels, surface-state density, band bending. Contact engineering: interface charge, contact barrier, Fermi-level pinning. MOS gate stack: metal-gate work function, dielectric thickness/quality, and interface-dipole engineering.

title.zh: 核心定义：离开材料需要多少能量
title.en: Definition: energy required to leave a material

subtitle.zh: E_vac / E_F / Φ
subtitle.en: E_vac / E_F / Φ

body.zh: 功函数是电子从费米能级到真空能级所需的最小能量。Φ = E_vac − E_F；E_vac 为真空能级，E_F 为费米能级。
body.en: Work function is the minimum energy needed to move an electron from the Fermi level to the vacuum level. Φ = E_vac − E_F, where E_vac is vacuum level and E_F is Fermi level.

body.zh: 别混淆：功函数 Φ = E_vac − E_F；电子亲和势 χ = E_vac − E_C；带隙 E_g = E_C − E_V。功函数不等于导电率或电阻。
body.en: Do not confuse work function Φ = E_vac − E_F, electron affinity χ = E_vac − E_C, and bandgap E_g = E_C − E_V. Work function is not conductivity or resistance.

body.zh: 晶面、吸附物、氧化、污染都会改变测得的功函数值。不同晶面原子排布不同，表面偶极不同；吸附分子形成表面偶极；表面氧化产生界面偶极；有机污染和残留物等改变表面势垒。
body.en: Crystal planes, adsorbates, oxidation, and contamination affect measured work function. Different crystal planes have different atomic arrangements and surface dipoles; adsorbed molecules create surface dipoles; oxidation creates interface dipoles; organic contamination and residues change the surface barrier.

body.zh: 参考点不同，讨论的物理量就不同。
body.en: Different reference levels define different physical quantities.

body.zh: 不同测试方法和表面状态会影响测得的功函数值。UPS 二次电子截止用于获得功函数，图中纵轴为信号强度、横轴为动能。Kelvin 接触电势差（ΔV_CPD）用于推算功函数。表面越洁净，测得的功函数越可靠。
body.en: Measurement method and surface condition affect measured work function. UPS secondary-electron cutoff is used to obtain work function; the axes are signal intensity and kinetic energy. Kelvin contact-potential difference (ΔV_CPD) is used to infer work function. Cleaner surfaces yield more reliable results.

body.zh: 反馈动作：校准参考 → 控制表面历史 → 复测确认。
body.en: Feedback: calibrate the reference → control surface history → repeat measurement to confirm.

body.zh: 功函数是表面敏感量，不应脱离测试环境与表面状态讨论。
body.en: Work function is surface sensitive and must be discussed together with measurement environment and surface condition.

title.zh: 半导体差异：掺杂会移动费米能级
title.en: Semiconductor differences: doping shifts the Fermi level

subtitle.zh: 电子亲和势 / 掺杂 / 表面态 / 能带弯曲
subtitle.en: Electron affinity / doping / surface states / band bending

heading.zh: 01 不同掺杂类型的能带图

body.zh: 掺杂会移动费米能级，从而改变表面功函数。n 型（施主掺杂）：E_F 上移，Φ 趋小；本征（未掺杂）；p 型（受主掺杂）：E_F 下移，Φ 趋大。图中标注真空能级 E_vac、电子亲和势 χ、导带 E_C、费米能级 E_F、价带 E_V。
body.en: Doping shifts the Fermi level and changes surface work function. For n-type donor doping, E_F rises and Φ tends to decrease; intrinsic material is undoped; for p-type acceptor doping, E_F falls and Φ tends to increase. Diagrams label E_vac, χ, E_C, E_F, and E_V.

heading.zh: 02 表面功函数的理想关系

body.zh: 理想、无表面态时，表面功函数由电子亲和势和费米能级位置决定：Φ_S = χ + (E_C − E_F)。这是理想表面下的能带关系。
body.en: For an ideal surface without surface states, work function is set by electron affinity and Fermi-level position: Φ_S = χ + (E_C − E_F). This is the ideal-surface band relationship.

body.zh: 表面态、固定电荷、原生氧化层和吸附物会引入能带弯曲、费米能级钉扎，改变实测功函数。表面态（能级密度）导致弯曲并可能钉扎 E_F；固定电荷引发空间电荷区；原生氧化层（SiO₂ 等）引入界面态和固定电荷，改变表面势垒；吸附分子（如 H₂O、O₂）带电或形成偶极，诱导弯曲。
body.en: Surface states, fixed charge, native oxide, and adsorbates introduce band bending and Fermi-level pinning, changing measured work function. Surface states may bend bands and pin E_F; fixed charge creates a space-charge region; native oxide such as SiO₂ introduces interface states and fixed charge, changing the surface barrier; adsorbates such as H₂O/O₂ carry charge or create dipoles that induce bending.

heading.zh: 04 核心判断与 05 常见误区

body.zh: 同一种半导体，也可能因掺杂与表面状态表现出不同功函数。误区：只按体掺杂判断表面功函数；把 KPFM 对比直接当作绝对材料常数。
body.en: The same semiconductor can exhibit different work functions because of doping and surface condition. Mistakes: predicting surface work function from bulk doping alone, or treating KPFM contrast as an absolute material constant.

body.zh: 多种手段结合，区分体掺杂与表面贡献：UPS/XPS 看表面能级与功函数；KPFM 看表面功函数分布；以已知掺杂类型与趋势为参考；对比表面处理前后（去除/钝化表面态），并复测。
body.en: Combine methods to distinguish bulk-doping and surface contributions: UPS/XPS for surface energy levels and work function; KPFM for spatial work-function distribution; known doping type/trend as a reference; before/after surface-treatment comparison (removing/passivating states), followed by repeat measurement.

body.zh: n 型趋低、p 型趋高是理想趋势，表面态和能带弯曲可能改变实测结果。
body.en: Lower work function for n-type and higher for p-type is an ideal trend; surface states and band bending may change measured results.

title.zh: 接触机制：费米能级对齐后会发生什么
title.en: Contact mechanism: what happens after Fermi-level alignment

subtitle.zh: 电荷转移 / 能带弯曲 / 界面偶极 / 势垒
subtitle.en: Charge transfer / band bending / interface dipoles / barriers

body.zh: Φ_Bn ≈ Φ_M − χ。这是理想 Schottky–Mott 模型，仅用于理解趋势，不适用于所有真实界面。接触前，金属与 n 型半导体分开，分别标有 Φ_M、Φ_S、χ、E_F^M、E_F^S；接触后形成平衡界面、统一的 E_F，半导体侧出现空间电荷区（耗尽层）与电子势垒 Φ_Bn。能带标注 E_vac、E_C、E_V。
body.en: Φ_Bn ≈ Φ_M − χ is the ideal Schottky–Mott model, useful for trends but not valid for every real interface. Before contact, metal and n-type semiconductor are separate, labeled Φ_M, Φ_S, χ, E_F^M, E_F^S. After equilibrium contact, they share E_F and the semiconductor has a space-charge/depletion region and electron barrier Φ_Bn. Band labels include E_vac, E_C, E_V.

body.zh: 功函数差（Φ_M 与 χ、Φ_S 不同）→ 电荷重新分布（电子从低功函数一侧流向高功函数一侧，界面形成空间电荷）→ E_F 对齐（热平衡时金属和半导体具有统一费米能级）→ 能带弯曲/界面偶极（半导体侧能带弯曲，原子层偶极改变局部能级）→ 势垒形成（半导体侧电子势垒影响注入与传输）。
body.en: Work-function difference (different Φ_M, χ, Φ_S) → charge redistribution (electrons flow from lower to higher work function, creating interface space charge) → E_F alignment at thermal equilibrium → semiconductor band bending/interface dipoles that alter local energy levels → an electron barrier affecting injection and transport.

heading.zh: 03 真实界面偏离与 04 判断边界

body.zh: 界面态在禁带中引入能级，影响势垒；界面化学反应生成新相或化合物，改变界面能级与势垒；缺陷、空位、位错等引入局域能级并改变电荷分布；强界面态使费米能级钉扎，势垒对金属功函数不敏感。
body.en: Interface states introduce gap levels and affect the barrier; chemical reactions create new phases/compounds and change interface levels; defects, vacancies, and dislocations create localized levels and redistribute charge; strong interface states pin E_F so the barrier becomes insensitive to metal work function.

body.zh: 功函数差 ≠ 接触电阻：即使差大，接触电阻也可能很小（如高掺杂、隧穿）。势垒降低 ≠ 接触一定最佳：势垒过低可能导致反向漏电或可靠性问题。还需考虑半导体掺杂浓度、隧穿距离与界面厚度、界面损伤与缺陷。
body.en: Work-function difference is not contact resistance: a large difference can coexist with low resistance, for example with heavy doping/tunneling. A lower barrier is not automatically best: an excessively low barrier can cause reverse leakage or reliability problems. Also consider doping concentration, tunneling distance/interface thickness, and interface damage/defects.

body.zh: I–V：反向受势垒控制，正向受势垒与串联电阻影响。C–V：提取内建电势与势垒高度。温度依赖：ln(I) 对 1/T 的 Arrhenius 图提取势垒高度。TLM：分离接触电阻与片电阻。XPS：通过结合能测界面能带偏移与化学态变化。
body.en: I–V: reverse behavior is barrier controlled; forward behavior depends on barrier and series resistance. C–V extracts built-in potential and barrier height. Temperature dependence uses an Arrhenius ln(I) versus 1/T plot to extract barrier height. TLM separates contact and sheet resistance. XPS binding energies probe interface band offsets and chemical-state changes.

body.zh: 反馈动作：复测 → 区分势垒与串联电阻 → 联查界面。
body.en: Feedback: repeat measurement → distinguish barrier and series resistance → investigate the interface together.

body.zh: 理想 Schottky–Mott 关系是起点，不是所有接触的最终答案。
body.en: The ideal Schottky–Mott relation is a starting point, not a complete answer for all contacts.

title.zh: 栅极作用：先影响平带，再参与决定 Vth
title.en: Gate effects: flat-band voltage and then Vth

subtitle.zh: Φ_MS / V_FB / 氧化层电荷 / Vth
subtitle.en: Φ_MS / V_FB / oxide charge / Vth

body.zh: 金属栅有效功函数与半导体功函数的差值，决定平带电压。堆栈为金属栅（Φ_M,eff）、High-k 或氧化层（厚度 t_ox、电容 C_ox）、半导体 Si（Φ_S）；能带标出 E_vac、E_F、E_C、E_V。功函数差 Φ_MS = Φ_M,eff − Φ_S。
body.en: The difference between effective metal-gate and semiconductor work functions determines flat-band voltage. Stack: metal gate (Φ_M,eff), high-k/oxide (thickness t_ox, capacitance C_ox), and Si semiconductor (Φ_S). Band labels: E_vac, E_F, E_C, E_V. Φ_MS = Φ_M,eff − Φ_S.

heading.zh: 02 因果链与 03 关键公式

body.zh: 栅极与半导体功函数差 → 平带电压 V_FB（受栅、氧化层电荷影响）→ 阈值电压 Vth（还受沟道、C_ox、界面/固定电荷、器件结构影响）→ 器件电流 I_on/I_off。
body.en: Gate–semiconductor work-function difference → V_FB (also affected by gate/oxide charge) → Vth (also affected by channel, C_ox, interface/fixed charge, and device structure) → device I_on/I_off.

body.zh: Φ_MS = Φ_M,eff − Φ_S；V_FB ≈ (Φ_M,eff − Φ_S)/q − Q_eff/C_ox。Vth 同时受沟道、C_ox、界面与固定电荷、器件结构影响。
body.en: Φ_MS = Φ_M,eff − Φ_S; V_FB ≈ (Φ_M,eff − Φ_S)/q − Q_eff/C_ox. Vth also depends on channel, C_ox, interface/fixed charge, and device structure.

body.zh: MOSCAP C–V 图示 V_FB 左移/右移；器件 I_d–V_g 图示 Vth 左移/右移，电流标度为 10⁻³、10⁻⁶、10⁻⁹。nFET 与 pFET 需要不同方向的 EWF 调节，不能把“功函数越高，Vth 一定越高”概括所有情况。
body.en: MOSCAP C–V illustrates left/right V_FB shifts; device I_d–V_g illustrates left/right Vth shifts with current ticks 10⁻³, 10⁻⁶, 10⁻⁹. nFET and pFET require different directions of EWF tuning; “higher work function always means higher Vth” is not universal.

body.zh: nFET（NMOS）通常需要较低的 Φ_M,eff 以降低 Vth，易形成 n 型沟道；pFET（PMOS）通常需要较高的 Φ_M,eff 以降低 |Vth|，易形成 p 型沟道。
body.en: nFET/NMOS usually needs lower Φ_M,eff to reduce Vth and facilitate an n-channel; pFET/PMOS usually needs higher Φ_M,eff to reduce |Vth| and facilitate a p-channel.

heading.zh: 06 量测反馈与 07 核心判断

body.zh: 量测 MOSCAP C–V、V_FB、器件 I_d–V_g、Vth、n–p 分布。通过 C–V 与 I–V 对照，区分 EWF 与介质电荷贡献。有效功函数是 Vth 的重要输入，但不是唯一决定项。下游影响包括 I_on、I_off、静态功耗、速度与噪声容限。
body.en: Measure MOSCAP C–V, V_FB, device I_d–V_g, Vth, and n–p distributions. Compare C–V with I–V to separate EWF and dielectric-charge contributions. EWF is an important input to Vth but not its sole determinant. Downstream effects include I_on, I_off, static power, speed, and noise margin.

notes.zh: 原图“差值，决定平带电压”为原文措辞；同页公式也包含氧化层有效电荷项 Q_eff/C_ox，应结合公式理解，不能忽略该项。
notes.en: “The difference determines flat-band voltage” preserves the source wording. The equation on the same page also includes the effective oxide-charge term Q_eff/C_ox; that term must not be neglected.

title.zh: 工艺调控：调的是整套栅堆栈
title.en: Process tuning: the entire gate stack matters

subtitle.zh: WFM / High-k 界面 / 偶极 / 热预算
subtitle.en: WFM / high-k interfaces / dipoles / thermal budget

body.zh: 从上到下：填充金属、功函数金属（WFM）、界面偶极或 Vth shifter、High-k、界面层、半导体沟道。器件看到的是有效功函数 EWF，不是孤立金属的手册值。能带图从金属（WFM）跨 High-k 与界面到半导体沟道，以 E_vac 标示 EWF。
body.en: Top to bottom: fill metal, WFM, interface dipole or Vth shifter, high-k, interfacial layer, semiconductor channel. The device experiences EWF, not a handbook value for isolated metal. The band diagram runs from metal through high-k/interface to channel and references EWF to E_vac.

body.zh: 1. 确定 n/p 目标、Vth 与 EWF 方向。2. 选择 WFM 材料、成分、厚度。3. 控制共形沉积与连续性。4. 双功函数区域选择性保留或去除（n 区、p 区）。5. 偶极/盖层/填充与热处理。6. MOSCAP 与器件分片验证。
body.en: 1. Define n/p targets and Vth/EWF direction. 2. Select WFM material, composition, thickness. 3. Control conformal deposition and continuity. 4. Selectively retain/remove material in dual-work-function n/p regions. 5. Process dipoles/caps/fill and thermal treatment. 6. Validate using MOSCAP and device splits.

body.zh: WFM 厚度与成分影响 EWF、连续性和工艺窗口。High-k/WFM 界面化学包括界面反应、界面态密度、电荷与偶极。偶极元素位置与扩散涉及位置精确性、扩散控制、稳定性。退火历史与氧迁移涉及界面化学变化、氧迁移与缺陷、EWF 稳定性。
body.en: WFM thickness/composition affect EWF, continuity, and process window. High-k/WFM chemistry involves interface reactions, state density, charge, and dipoles. Dipole-element position/diffusion require positional precision, diffusion control, and stability. Annealing history and oxygen migration affect interface chemistry, defects, and EWF stability.

heading.zh: 04 耦合权衡与 05 常见失效

body.zh: 调节能力增加 ↔ 栅槽填充与选择性更难；偶极与热处理窗口 ↔ 缺陷、扩散与可靠性。常见失效：EWF 偏移、平带电压 roll-off、WFM 局部缺失、界面互混、氧空位增加。
body.en: Greater tuning capability ↔ harder gate-trench fill and selectivity; dipole/thermal windows ↔ defects, diffusion, and reliability. Common failures: EWF shifts, flat-band-voltage roll-off, local WFM loss, intermixing, and increased oxygen vacancies.

body.zh: 量测膜厚与成分、XPS、截面 TEM-EDS、MOSCAP C–V，并对比退火前后。反馈动作：复测 → Hold → 区分沉积与热处理贡献。
body.en: Measure thickness/composition, XPS, cross-sectional TEM-EDS, and MOSCAP C–V; compare before and after annealing. Feedback: remeasure → hold → separate deposition and thermal-treatment contributions.

body.zh: 有效功函数是材料、界面与热历史共同形成的堆栈结果。Gate-first、Gate-last、FinFET 与 GAA 的堆栈顺序和空间约束不同。
body.en: EWF is a stack-level result of materials, interfaces, and thermal history. Gate-first, gate-last, FinFET, and GAA differ in stack sequence and spatial constraints.

title.zh: 异常诊断：Vth 漂移不只看金属
title.en: Diagnosis: Vth drift is not solely a metal issue

subtitle.zh: 均值偏移 / 片内分布 / 局部变异 / 时间漂移
subtitle.en: Mean shifts / within-wafer distribution / local variation / time drift

heading.zh: 01 V_FB 与 Vth 全片同向偏移

body.zh: 同一片晶圆上，V_FB 与 Vth 整体向高或向低偏移。优先检查 WFM 成分与厚度、退火、界面偶极。示意堆栈为 WFM/高 k 介质/界面层/硅衬底；直方图以蓝色表示 V_FB、橙色表示 Vth。
body.en: V_FB and Vth shift together higher or lower across a wafer. First check WFM composition/thickness, annealing, and interface dipoles. Stack: WFM/high-k/interfacial layer/Si; blue histogram denotes V_FB and orange denotes Vth.

heading.zh: 02 片内或器件间离散增大

body.zh: 同片不同位置或不同器件间，Vth 分布变宽、出现双峰等。优先检查膜层连续性、金属晶粒取向、局部缺失、图形尺寸。片内热图颜色从蓝色低值到红色高值。
body.en: Vth broadens or becomes bimodal across positions/devices on the same wafer. First check film continuity, metal-grain orientation, local missing material, and pattern dimensions. The wafer map runs blue-low to red-high.

body.zh: 多次扫描出现 C–V 曲线漂移或迟滞，或随测试历史变化。优先检查固定电荷（Q_f）、氧空位（V_O）、界面态（D_it）、测试历史。图中区分初次与后续扫描。
body.en: Repeated scans show C–V shifts or hysteresis, or depend on test history. First check fixed charge Q_f, oxygen vacancies V_O, interface states D_it, and test history. The figure distinguishes initial and later scans.

heading.zh: 04 Vth 漂移伴随 SS 或迁移率变化
heading.en: 04 Vth shifts with SS or mobility changes

body.zh: Vth 变化同时，SS 变差或迁移率 μ 下降，提示沟道/界面问题。优先检查沟道、界面损伤、器件结构；图示界面损伤、沟道散射增强与器件结构影响（S、D）。
body.en: Vth change accompanied by worse SS or reduced mobility μ points to channel/interface issues. First check channel, interface damage, and device structure; schematics show interface damage, increased channel scattering, and source/drain structure effects.

heading.zh: 05 空气暴露后表面量测变化
heading.en: 05 Surface measurements change after air exposure

body.zh: 样品暴露空气后，表面功函数或 Vth 发生变化。优先检查吸附、原生氧化、参考探针漂移。吸附图中标有 H₂O 与 O₂。
body.en: Surface work function or Vth changes after air exposure. First check adsorption, native oxidation, and reference-probe drift. Adsorbates shown are H₂O and O₂.

heading.zh: 06 首次出现节点与 07 核心判断

body.zh: 结合流程定位异常首次出现的环节：WFM 沉积 → 选择性去除/保留 → 填充 → 退火 → MOSCAP 电学量测 → 器件电学量测。Vth 异常是一种器件表现，需要沿栅堆栈、介质和沟道分支定位根因。
body.en: Locate where the anomaly first appears: WFM deposition → selective removal/retention → fill → anneal → MOSCAP electrical measurement → device electrical measurement. Vth abnormality is a device symptom; trace gate-stack, dielectric, and channel branches to find its root cause.

heading.zh: 08 标签、09 反馈、10 处置

body.zh: 常见标签：n–p 失配、晶圆边缘漂移、双峰分布、C–V 迟滞、退火前后反向变化。量测反馈：C–V 与 I–V、V_FB–Vth 分布、XPS、TEM-EDS、KPFM、晶圆图。
body.en: Common labels: n–p mismatch, wafer-edge drift, bimodal distribution, C–V hysteresis, and opposite shifts before/after annealing. Feedback: C–V and I–V, V_FB–Vth distributions, XPS, TEM-EDS, KPFM, and wafer maps.

body.zh: 处置动作：复测 → Hold → C–V 与 I–V 对照 → 材料/界面分析 → 分片验证。
body.en: Actions: remeasure → hold → compare C–V and I–V → analyze materials/interfaces → validate splits.

body.zh: 未区分 EWF 与介质电荷前，不直接回调单一 WFM 配方。
body.en: Do not directly retune a single WFM recipe before separating EWF and dielectric-charge effects.

title.zh: 工艺选择：先分清要控制哪一种功函数
title.en: Route selection: identify which work function to control

subtitle.zh: 表面表征 / 接触工程 / 栅堆栈 EWF
subtitle.en: Surface characterization / contact engineering / gate-stack EWF

heading.zh: A 材料与表面功函数
heading.en: A Material and surface work function

body.zh: 目标：研究表面电子状态、吸附、晶面或材料变化。手段：UPS、Kelvin Probe、KPFM。证据：二次电子截止（表面功函数）、接触电势差（表面电势）、空间分布（表面不均匀性）。图中标注 E_vac、V_CPD、信号强度与动能。
body.en: Goal: study surface electronic states, adsorption, crystal planes, or material changes. Methods: UPS, Kelvin probe, KPFM. Evidence: secondary-electron cutoff (surface work function), contact-potential difference (surface potential), spatial distributions (surface nonuniformity). Diagram labels include E_vac, V_CPD, intensity, kinetic energy.

body.zh: 边界：半导体结果还包含表面态与能带弯曲，不等同于孤立材料的功函数。
body.en: Limit: semiconductor results include surface-state and band-bending effects and do not equal an isolated-material work function.

body.zh: 目标：优化势垒与接触电阻。结构：金属、经清洁/钝化的界面层、掺杂可调的半导体。手段：金属选择（图示 Ti、Ta、W、Co）、界面清洁或钝化、掺杂工程、退火协同。
body.en: Goal: optimize barrier and contact resistance. Structure: metal, cleaned/passivated interface, semiconductor with adjustable doping. Methods: metal choice (Ti, Ta, W, Co illustrated), interface cleaning/passivation, doping engineering, coordinated annealing.

body.zh: 证据：I–V（接触电阻与势垒）、温度依赖（热激发/隧穿机制）、TLM（传输线法，提取接触电阻）、界面成分（XPS/TEM-EDS 等）。边界：功函数只是输入之一，界面钉扎与化学反应可能主导实际势垒高度与接触电阻。
body.en: Evidence: I–V (contact resistance/barrier), temperature dependence (thermal activation/tunneling), TLM for contact resistance, and interface composition (XPS/TEM-EDS). Limit: work function is one input; interface pinning and chemistry can dominate actual barrier height/contact resistance.

body.zh: 目标：调节 V_FB 与 Vth。结构：金属栅（WFM）、偶极层或 Vth shifter、高 k、Si 衬底。手段：WFM 材料与厚度（图示 TiN/TaN、厚度 t）、双功函数 n/p 区域设计、偶极或 Vth shifter、热处理。
body.en: Goal: tune V_FB and Vth. Stack: WFM, dipole layer or Vth shifter, high-k, Si. Methods: WFM material/thickness (TiN/TaN and thickness t shown), dual-work-function n/p regions, dipole/Vth shifter, thermal treatment.

body.zh: 证据：MOSCAP C–V、I_d–V_g、EWF 与可靠性分布。边界：Vth 还受介质电荷、沟道特性与器件结构影响，不能仅用 WFM 功函数概括。
body.en: Evidence: MOSCAP C–V, I_d–V_g, EWF and reliability distributions. Limit: dielectric charge, channel properties, and device structure also affect Vth; WFM work function alone is insufficient.

heading.zh: D 三种调控方式对比

body.zh: WFM 成分/厚度：目标为调节 V_FB、Vth；n/p 独立调节能力中等（材料选择）；金属堆栈与退火要求较高；界面敏感性高（界面反应、扩散）；栅槽空间方面原图写“容易整合”；变异性与可靠性受界面与工艺影响；成本中等。
body.en: WFM composition/thickness: tune V_FB and Vth; medium independent n/p capability through material selection; demanding stack/anneal requirements; high interface sensitivity to reaction/diffusion; the source describes trench-space integration as easy; variability/reliability depend on interfaces/processes; medium cost.

body.zh: 偶极或 Vth shifter：微调 Vth、补偿工艺偏移；n/p 调节能力中等（偶极方向与强度）；热预算相对较低；界面敏感性高（偶极稳定性）；容易整合；变异性与可靠性取决于偶极层稳定性；成本中等。
body.en: Dipole or Vth shifter: fine-tune Vth and compensate process offsets; medium n/p capability through dipole direction/strength; relatively low thermal budget; high interface sensitivity to dipole stability; easy integration; variability/reliability depend on dipole stability; medium cost.

body.zh: 双 WFM 选择性整合：n/p 独立调节、Vth 窗口控制；调节能力强（分区不同 WFM）；热预算中等（需多道工艺）；界面敏感性高（跨区隔离与界面工程）；栅槽空间整合较复杂（选择性工艺）；需评估跨区一致性与长期可靠性；成本较高（多步与选择性工艺）。
body.en: Selective dual-WFM integration: independent n/p tuning and Vth-window control; strong capability via region-specific WFM; medium thermal budget with multiple steps; high interface sensitivity involving regional isolation/interface engineering; complex trench integration due to selectivity; assess cross-region consistency and long-term reliability; higher cost.

body.zh: 先定义工程目标，再选择调控手段与验证证据。量测反馈包括实验分片、物性—电性相关、热稳定性、可靠性。反馈动作：实验分片 → 物性与电性相关 → 热稳定性 → 决策评审。不同层级可以采用不同路线，不用单一材料功函数概括整套器件。
body.en: Define the engineering goal before selecting controls and evidence. Feedback includes experimental splits, physical–electrical correlation, thermal stability, and reliability. Actions: splits → physical/electrical correlation → thermal stability → decision review. Different levels may use different routes; a single material work function cannot represent the entire device.

notes.zh: 对比表中的“容易整合”、相对热预算及成本等级为原图的概括判断，未给出具体材料、结构和流程条件。
notes.en: The table’s ease-of-integration, relative thermal-budget, and cost ratings are source generalizations without specified materials, structures, or process conditions.

title.zh: 一张图看懂 SADP
title.en: SADP at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从 Mandrel、Spacer 倍频到 Pitch Walk 与工艺选择
subtitle.en: Self-aligned double patterning: mandrels, spacers, pitch walk, and route selection

heading.zh: 01 工艺位置与 02 核心结构

body.zh: SADP 位于光刻与最终图形转移之间：光刻形成稀疏 Mandrel → SADP 形成高密度 Spacer → 转移到目标层得到更密图形。结构标注：Spacer（侧墙）、Mandrel（牺牲层）、硬掩膜、目标层（硅或介质等）。
body.en: SADP sits between lithography and final pattern transfer: lithography forms sparse mandrels → SADP creates dense spacers → transfer produces a denser target-layer pattern. Labels: spacer, sacrificial mandrel, hard mask, target layer such as silicon/dielectric.

heading.zh: 03 倍频机制与 04 完整流程

body.zh: 一条 Mandrel 的两侧形成 Spacer，拉除 Mandrel 后留下两条 Spacer。完整链：形成 Mandrel（光刻）→ Spacer 成核/沉积（原图称“各向同性”）→ Spacer 各向异性刻蚀（仅保留侧墙）→ 拉除 Mandrel → Cut/Block 图形编辑 → 转移到目标层。
body.en: Spacers form on both sides of one mandrel; removing it leaves two spacers. Full chain: lithographic mandrel formation → spacer nucleation/deposition (called “isotropic” in the source) → anisotropic spacer etch retaining sidewalls → mandrel removal → cut/block editing → target-layer transfer.

heading.zh: 05 关键窗口与 06 异常诊断

body.zh: Mandrel 与 Spacer 必须联动控制：Mandrel CD 与侧壁形貌；Spacer 厚度与包覆一致性；Spacer 刻蚀偏差（线宽/斜率）；材料选择性与刻蚀止点。
body.en: Control mandrel and spacer together: mandrel CD/profile; spacer thickness/coverage consistency; spacer etch bias in width/slope; material selectivity and etch endpoint.

body.zh: 从晶圆 CD 分布、Pitch Walk（交替间距偏移）、断线（Spacer 不连续）、桥连（残留或刻蚀不足）追查根因。
body.en: Trace causes using wafer CD distribution, pitch walk (alternating spacing shifts), breaks (discontinuous spacers), and bridges (residue or insufficient etch).

heading.zh: 07 整合影响与 08 工艺选择

body.zh: SADP 先形成连续规则线网，再通过 Cut/Block 定义保留/去除区域，得到非连续线段的目标图形。LELE：二维图形较灵活、overlay 更敏感；SADP：规则线网倍频、需 Cut 与 Block；SAQP：更高线密度，流程与误差传播更复杂。
body.en: SADP first forms a continuous regular grid; cut/block then defines retained/removed areas to create discrete target line segments. LELE: more flexible 2D patterns, greater overlay sensitivity. SADP: doubles regular grids, requires cut/block. SAQP: higher line density with more complex flow and error propagation.

title.zh: 工艺位置：先印稀疏母图形，再做倍频
title.en: Process position: print sparse parent patterns, then double density

subtitle.zh: 初始光刻 / 侧墙倍频 / 目标层转移
subtitle.en: Initial lithography / spacer doubling / target-layer transfer

body.zh: 01 光刻定义稀疏 Mandrel → 02 刻蚀形成 Mandrel → 03 SADP 侧墙倍频 → 04 转移到硬掩膜或目标层。整体分为初始光刻、SADP 倍频模块、最终图形转移。
body.en: 01 Lithographically define sparse mandrels → 02 etch mandrels → 03 SADP spacer doubling → 04 transfer to hard mask or target. Overall stages: initial lithography, SADP doubling module, final transfer.

body.zh: SADP 不是两次相同线图形曝光，也不只是多沉积一层 Spacer。它位于初始光刻与最终目标层之间，把部分分辨率压力转移给薄膜与刻蚀控制。
body.en: SADP is neither two identical line-pattern exposures nor merely an extra spacer deposition. Between initial lithography and final target layer, it transfers part of the resolution burden to film and etch control.

body.zh: 量测 Mandrel CD、Pitch、侧壁、CDU。使用顶视图 CD-SEM、截面轮廓与晶圆 CD 分布（红色 CD 大、蓝色 CD 小）。反馈流程：复测 → Hold → 判断是否进入 Spacer 模块。
body.en: Measure mandrel CD, pitch, sidewalls, and CDU using top-down CD-SEM, cross-sectional profiles, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → decide whether to enter the spacer module.

body.zh: Fin、存储结构与 BEOL 金属层的材料堆栈可能不同。
body.en: Material stacks may differ for fins, memory structures, and BEOL metal layers.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 核心结构：Mandrel 是模具，Spacer 才留下
title.en: Structure: the mandrel is the mold; spacers remain

subtitle.zh: 牺牲核心 / 侧墙间隔层 / 硬掩膜 / 目标材料
subtitle.en: Sacrificial core / sidewall spacer / hard mask / target material

body.zh: Mandrel 提供侧壁位置，后续移除。Spacer 复制 Mandrel 边缘，形成倍频图形。Hard Mask 承接图形，支持后续转移。Target Layer 形成最终线、沟槽或器件结构。
body.en: The mandrel sets sidewall positions and is later removed. Spacers copy its edges to form a doubled pattern. The hard mask receives the pattern for later transfer. The target layer becomes final lines, trenches, or device structures.

body.zh: Cut/Block 材料用于删除多余线段或定义线端，不负责产生倍频。
body.en: Cut/block material removes unwanted segments or defines line ends; it does not create density doubling.

body.zh: 材料关系链：沉积选择 → Spacer 刻蚀选择性 → Mandrel 拉除选择性 → 硬掩膜转移。材料分工失配可表现为 Mandrel 残留、Spacer 受损、界面残留、硬掩膜转移失真。
body.en: Material chain: deposition choice → spacer-etch selectivity → mandrel-removal selectivity → hard-mask transfer. Mismatches can leave mandrel/interface residue, damage spacers, or distort hard-mask transfer.

body.zh: Mandrel 负责定义位置，Spacer 负责保留倍频边缘，二者不能互换。量测膜厚、侧壁轮廓、选择性、残留；工具包括 OCD 侧壁轮廓、截面 SEM、沉积/刻蚀/拉除选择性评估、残留检查。反馈：复测 → Hold → 联查沉积、刻蚀与拉除。
body.en: Mandrels define positions; spacers retain doubled edges; their roles are not interchangeable. Measure thickness, profile, selectivity, and residue using OCD profiles, cross-sectional SEM, deposition/etch/removal-selectivity assessment, and residue inspection. Feedback: remeasure → hold → investigate deposition, etch, and removal together.

body.zh: Spacer-is-mask、Spacer-is-dielectric 等语境的材料职责可能不同。
body.en: Material roles may differ in spacer-is-mask and spacer-is-dielectric contexts.

title.zh: 倍频机制：一条核心留下两条侧墙
title.en: Doubling mechanism: one core leaves two sidewalls

subtitle.zh: 共形沉积 / 各向异性刻蚀 / 自对准边缘
subtitle.en: Conformal deposition / anisotropic etch / self-aligned edges

body.zh: 01 形成 Mandrel → 02 共形沉积 Spacer → 03 各向异性刻蚀 → 04 移除 Mandrel。规则线网中，一条 Mandrel 左右侧壁各留下一个 Spacer，线密度约增加一倍。
body.en: 01 Form mandrel → 02 conformally deposit spacer → 03 anisotropically etch → 04 remove mandrel. Each sidewall leaves one spacer, approximately doubling line density in a regular grid.

body.zh: 两条 Spacer 相对同一 Mandrel 定位；Mandrel 对前层、Cut/Block 对线网仍需 overlay 控制。P1 在图中称“Mandrel 内部间距”，P2 为相邻 Mandrel 之间间距。P1 与 P2 失衡表现为 Pitch Walk。
body.en: Both spacers are positioned relative to the same mandrel; mandrel-to-previous-layer and cut/block-to-grid overlay still need control. The source calls P1 the internal mandrel spacing and P2 the spacing between adjacent mandrels. P1/P2 imbalance appears as pitch walk.

body.zh: 常见风险：Pitch Walk、Even–Odd 间距偏差、左右 Spacer 不对称。SADP 靠侧墙复制完成倍频，自对准不等于全流程无 overlay。
body.en: Risks: pitch walk, even–odd spacing errors, left/right spacer asymmetry. SADP doubles density by sidewall replication; self-alignment does not remove overlay requirements from the entire flow.

body.zh: 量测 P1、P2、Spacer CD 与左右对称性，使用顶视 CD-SEM、截面轮廓及晶圆 CD 分布（红大、蓝小）。反馈：复测 → Hold → 区分 Mandrel、沉积与刻蚀贡献。
body.en: Measure P1, P2, spacer CD, and left/right symmetry with top-down CD-SEM, cross-sections, and wafer CD maps (red large, blue small). Feedback: remeasure → hold → separate mandrel, deposition, and etch contributions.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 完整流程：成核只是第一步
title.en: Full process: nucleation is only the first step

subtitle.zh: Mandrel 形成 / Spacer 沉积 / 拉除 / Cut 与转移
subtitle.en: Mandrel formation / spacer deposition / removal / cut and transfer

body.zh: 01 光刻定义 Mandrel：以光刻胶或可刻蚀材料形成图形。02 Mandrel 刻蚀：去除多余材料。03 共形沉积 Spacer：覆盖顶面、两侧壁及暴露水平面。
body.en: 01 Lithographically define mandrels in resist or etchable material. 02 Etch mandrels, removing excess material. 03 Conformally deposit spacer over tops, both sidewalls, and exposed horizontal surfaces.

body.zh: 04 各向异性 Spacer 刻蚀：去除水平向 Spacer，保留侧墙。05 选择性移除 Mandrel：留下两条 Spacer，形成双倍频图形。06 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端，并转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
body.en: 04 Anisotropically etch horizontal spacer material while retaining sidewalls. 05 Selectively remove mandrels, leaving two spacers and a doubled pattern. 06 Use cut/block to remove unwanted segments or define line ends, then transfer to hard mask/target.

body.zh: Mandrel 侧壁轮廓决定后续 Spacer 厚度与位置。Spacer 要良好共形，均匀覆盖顶面与侧壁。Spacer 刻蚀需清除水平膜并保证侧墙形貌与尺寸。Mandrel 拉除需选择性移除核心，不损伤 Spacer 与下层。
body.en: Mandrel sidewall profile sets subsequent spacer thickness/position. Spacer deposition must conformally and uniformly cover tops/sidewalls. Etching must clear horizontal film while preserving sidewall shape/dimensions. Mandrel removal must protect spacer and underlying layers.

body.zh: 水平膜去除充分 ↔ 侧墙损失：清除不足会有顶部残留，过刻会损失侧墙。Mandrel 完全拉除 ↔ 保护 Spacer 与下层：拉除不完全会残留，过度氧化/刻蚀会损伤 Spacer 或下层。
body.en: Complete horizontal-film removal ↔ sidewall loss: insufficient clearing leaves top residue; overetch removes sidewall material. Complete mandrel removal ↔ spacer/underlayer protection: incomplete removal leaves residue; excess oxidation/etch damages spacer or lower layers.

body.zh: 风险表现包括顶帽或残留、Footing、Mandrel 残留、Spacer 变薄与转移偏差。
body.en: Risk signatures include top caps/residue, footing, mandrel residue, spacer thinning, and transfer bias.

body.zh: SADP 是连续整合链，前段轮廓误差会带入后续转移。量测 Mandrel CD、Spacer 轮廓、拉除残留、最终 CD，以截面检查各阶段。反馈：分段复测 → Hold → 锁定误差首次出现节点。Cut/Block 插入顺序与硬掩膜堆栈随整合方案变化。
body.en: SADP is a continuous integration chain; early profile errors propagate into later transfer. Measure mandrel CD, spacer profiles, removal residue, and final CD with stage-by-stage cross-sections. Feedback: remeasure stages → hold → identify the first appearance of error. Cut/block sequence and hard-mask stack depend on integration.

title.zh: 关键窗口：CD 不是一个旋钮决定的
title.en: Process window: CD is not set by one control

subtitle.zh: Mandrel CDU / Spacer 厚度 / 刻蚀偏差 / 选择比
subtitle.en: Mandrel CDU / spacer thickness / etch bias / selectivity

body.zh: 01 Mandrel CD 与侧壁轮廓决定侧墙起始位置：需看 CD/CDU、侧壁斜率与粗糙度。02 Spacer 厚度与共形性决定保留线宽及左右一致性：控制沉积厚度、侧壁/顶部共形性、左右厚度一致性。
body.en: 01 Mandrel CD/profile determines the starting sidewall positions: assess CD/CDU, slope, roughness. 02 Spacer thickness/conformality determines retained linewidth and left/right consistency: control thickness, top/sidewall conformality, and symmetry.

body.zh: 03 Spacer 刻蚀方向性与偏差决定水平膜清除、底部 Footing、侧墙损失；刻蚀偏差导致 CD 变化。04 选择比与图形转移决定拉除、硬掩膜和目标层的 CD 保真；控制 Spacer/硬掩膜/目标层（硅或介质）的刻蚀选择比，选择比不足会引入 CD 偏差。
body.en: 03 Spacer etch directionality/bias determines horizontal clearing, bottom footing, and sidewall loss; etch bias changes CD. 04 Selectivity/transfer controls CD fidelity through removal, hard mask, and target. Control selectivity among spacer/hard mask/Si or dielectric target; inadequate selectivity introduces CD error.

body.zh: Mandrel CD/CDU + Spacer 厚度/均匀性 + 刻蚀偏差/选择比 → 最终 Spacer CD、P1/P2 平衡、最终图形 CD。常见表现：Pitch Walk、Even–Odd CD 偏差、Footing、线宽漂移、Line Wiggling。
body.en: Mandrel CD/CDU + spacer thickness/uniformity + etch bias/selectivity → final spacer CD, P1/P2 balance, final-pattern CD. Typical signatures: pitch walk, even–odd CD errors, footing, linewidth shifts, and line wiggling.

body.zh: 先确定异常首次出现的节点，再区分来料、沉积、刻蚀与转移贡献。最终 CD 与节距平衡由多步共同决定，单看终点 CD 无法定位根因。
body.en: Identify where the abnormality first appears, then separate incoming-material, deposition, etch, and transfer contributions. Multiple steps determine final CD/pitch balance; endpoint CD alone cannot locate the cause.

body.zh: 量测：顶视 CD-SEM、OCD（光学 CD）、截面轮廓、晶圆空间分布。动作：复测 → Hold → 前后节点相关性 → 小范围分片验证。量产窗口必须依据材料堆栈、设计规则与设备能力建立，不套用通用数值。
body.en: Measurements: top-down CD-SEM, OCD, cross-sections, wafer spatial distributions. Actions: remeasure → hold → correlate preceding/following stages → small-scale split validation. Production windows must reflect stack, design rules, and equipment capability rather than generic numerical values.

title.zh: 异常诊断：Pitch Walk 从哪里来
title.en: Diagnosis: where pitch walk comes from

subtitle.zh: 交替间距 / 线宽粗糙 / 断线桥连 / 拉除残留
subtitle.en: Alternating spacing / roughness / breaks and bridges / removal residue

heading.zh: 01 交替间距与 02 左右不对称

body.zh: 相邻线间距高低交替（Pitch Walk）：优先检查 Mandrel CD/Pitch、Spacer 厚度、转移偏差。同一条线两侧 Spacer 宽度不一致：优先检查 Mandrel 侧壁、沉积共形性、刻蚀方向性。
body.en: Alternating large/small spacing (pitch walk): first check mandrel CD/pitch, spacer thickness, transfer bias. Unequal spacer widths on opposite sides: first check mandrel sidewall, deposition conformality, etch directionality.

heading.zh: 03 断线变薄与 04 桥连残留

body.zh: 图形断线或局部明显变薄：优先检查 Spacer 连续性、图形坍塌、过刻。相邻图形桥连或拉除后残留：优先检查水平膜去除、Footing、Mandrel 拉除残留。
body.en: Breaks or pronounced local thinning: first check spacer continuity, pattern collapse, overetch. Bridges or post-removal residue: first check horizontal-film clearing, footing, mandrel-removal residue.

body.zh: 线边缘或线宽粗糙度恶化：对比 Mandrel 刻蚀、Spacer、硬掩膜、目标层刻蚀与清洗。线端位置偏移或 Cut/Block 尺寸异常：优先检查 Cut/Block 的 overlay、CD 与刻蚀。
body.en: Worse line-edge/linewidth roughness: compare mandrel etch, spacer, hard mask, target etch, and cleaning. Line-end shifts or abnormal cut/block size: first check cut/block overlay, CD, and etch.

body.zh: 沿流程排查：Mandrel（光刻/刻蚀）→ Spacer 沉积（原图称各向同性）→ Spacer 各向异性刻蚀 → Mandrel 拉除 → 硬掩膜/目标层转移 → Cut/Block。
body.en: Trace stages: mandrel lithography/etch → spacer deposition (called isotropic in the source) → anisotropic spacer etch → mandrel removal → hard-mask/target transfer → cut/block.

body.zh: 工具：顶视 CD-SEM、截面 SEM/TEM、OCD、缺陷图、overlay 与 EPE。反馈项目：P1/P2、Spacer CD、LER/LWR、残留、缺陷位置。Pitch Walk 是图形签名，不对应唯一根因。动作：复测 → Hold → 分节点检查 → 根因分析。未定位根因前，不直接以终点 CD 回调单一配方。
body.en: Tools: top-down CD-SEM, cross-sectional SEM/TEM, OCD, defect maps, overlay/EPE. Track P1/P2, spacer CD, LER/LWR, residue, defect locations. Pitch walk is a pattern signature, not a unique root cause. Actions: remeasure → hold → inspect stages → analyze cause. Do not tune one recipe from endpoint CD before locating the cause.

title.zh: 整合影响：规则线网还不是最终图形
title.en: Integration: a regular grid is not the final pattern

subtitle.zh: Cut/Block / Line End / EPE / 图形转移
subtitle.en: Cut/block / line end / EPE / pattern transfer

body.zh: A：SADP 生成连续等距 Spacer 的规则密集线网。B：通过 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端。C：得到断开的线段和受控线端，并转移到硬掩膜或目标层。Cut/Block 负责图形编辑，不负责产生倍频。
body.en: A: SADP forms a dense regular grid of continuous, equally spaced spacers. B: cut/block removes unwanted segments or defines line ends. C: disconnected segments and controlled ends transfer to hard mask/target. Cut/block edits the pattern; it does not create density doubling.

body.zh: Cut CD 与 Block CD：满足删除效果与线端定义需求。Cut/Block overlay：控制与前层对准偏差。Line-End Bias：保证线端位置与形貌。下层形貌与图形转移：考虑下层形貌影响，保证正确转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
body.en: Cut/block CD must satisfy removal and line-end definition. Cut/block overlay controls alignment to prior layers. Line-end bias controls end position/profile. Underlying topography and transfer must support correct hard-mask/target replication.

body.zh: 规则线网与自对准关键边，需要与二维复杂度、Cut 数量、EPE 和设计限制权衡。漏切：应切未切，残留连接。过切：切除过多导致线段缺失。线端回缩：线端后退、尺寸偏小。桥连：相邻线段异常连接。Cut 残留：去除不完全，影响后续工艺。最终 CD 偏差：尺寸偏大或偏小。
body.en: Balance regular grids/self-aligned critical edges against 2D complexity, cut count, EPE, and design restrictions. Missed cuts leave connections; overcuts remove segments; end pullback shortens ends; bridges connect neighbors; incomplete cut removal leaves residue affecting later processing; final-CD bias produces oversized/undersized patterns.

body.zh: 关键边自对准不会消除 Cut/Block 与前层对准误差。量测 Cut/Block overlay、Tip-to-Tip、Line End、最终硬掩膜 CD、缺陷。反馈动作：图谱对齐 → 相关性判断 → 分片验证。
body.en: Self-aligned critical edges do not eliminate cut/block-to-prior-layer overlay error. Measure cut/block overlay, tip-to-tip, line ends, final hard-mask CD, and defects. Actions: align maps → assess correlations → validate splits.

body.zh: Cut/Block 曝光次数、插入顺序和材料体系随设计与整合方案变化。
body.en: Cut/block exposure count, sequence, and materials depend on design and integration scheme.

title.zh: 工艺选择：不是所有密集图形都选 SADP
title.en: Route selection: SADP is not for every dense pattern

subtitle.zh: LELE / SADP / SAQP
subtitle.en: LELE / SADP / SAQP

body.zh: 两次独立光刻与刻蚀形成交错线条：第一次形成第一组线，第二次形成第二组线，再得到交错图形。二维图形较灵活，对 overlay 更敏感，需要两套光刻/刻蚀图形。
body.en: Two independent lithography/etch cycles form interleaved lines: the first forms one set and the second forms the other. LELE is more flexible for 2D patterns, more overlay sensitive, and requires two lithography/etch patterns.

body.zh: 光刻形成 Mandrel → 沉积 Spacer 并各向异性刻蚀 → 去除 Mandrel 得到倍频线网 → Cut/Block 图形编辑。适合规则密集线网倍频，关键边由侧墙自对准，但增加沉积、刻蚀与 Cut/Block 整合。
body.en: Lithographically form mandrels → deposit spacers and anisotropically etch → remove mandrels for a doubled grid → cut/block editing. Suited to doubling regular dense grids, with self-aligned sidewall edges, but adds deposition, etch, and cut/block integration.

body.zh: 在 SADP 基础上再进行一次自对准循环：第一次形成 Spacer，第二次再次形成 Spacer，得到更高线密度。重复自对准循环使流程更长，误差传播、缺陷与成本更复杂。
body.en: Add another self-aligned cycle to SADP: first form spacers, then form spacers again for higher line density. Repeated cycles lengthen the flow and complicate error propagation, defects, and cost.

heading.zh: 04 选择轴与 05 选择逻辑

body.zh: 综合评估目标 Pitch、一维/二维图形复杂度、Cut/Block 数量、EPE 预算、材料选择性、成本与周期。二维灵活性优先则评估 LELE；规则线网与自对准关键边则评估 SADP；更高线密度且接受更长流程则评估 SAQP。
body.en: Assess target pitch, 1D/2D complexity, cut/block count, EPE budget, material selectivity, cost, and cycle time. Evaluate LELE for 2D flexibility; SADP for regular grids/self-aligned edges; SAQP for higher density when a longer flow is acceptable.

body.zh: EUV 可用于形成 Mandrel 或 Block，路线仍需按层级、图形与成本评估。工艺选择由 Pitch、图形复杂度、EPE、材料窗口与成本共同决定。
body.en: EUV can form mandrels or blocks; routes still require layer-, pattern-, and cost-specific assessment. Pitch, complexity, EPE, material window, and cost jointly determine the choice.

heading.zh: 08 量测、09 反馈、10 边界

body.zh: 反馈项目：最终 EPE/CDU、LER/LWR、缺陷、电性。动作：实验分片 → 图形与电性相关 → 决策评审。不同层级可能采用不同路线，不以单一曝光方式概括整套工艺。
body.en: Track final EPE/CDU, LER/LWR, defects, electrical properties. Actions: experimental splits → pattern/electrical correlation → decision review. Different layers may use different routes; one exposure method does not describe the whole process.

title.zh: 一张图看懂 Gate 工艺发展史
title.en: Gate-process development at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从早期金属栅，到自对准、HKMG 与环栅
subtitle.en: From early metal gates to self-alignment, HKMG, and gate-all-around

body.zh: 金属隔着介质，用电场控制沟道。结构标注：金属栅、SiO₂ 栅介质、源极、漏极、硅沟道（反型层）；箭头标示栅控电场与沟道电流。时间标记：1960，MOS 公开演示。
body.en: A metal gate controls a channel through a dielectric using an electric field. Labels: metal gate, SiO₂ dielectric, source, drain, silicon inversion channel; arrows show gate field and channel current. Timeline: public MOS demonstration in 1960.

body.zh: 让栅成为源漏形成的几何参照。标注：多晶硅栅、源极/源极掺杂、栅下沟道、漏极/漏极掺杂。时间标记：1967–1968，重要阶段。
body.en: The gate becomes the geometric reference for source/drain formation. Labels: polysilicon gate, source/doping, channel beneath gate, drain/doping. Timeline: 1967–1968, an important period.

heading.zh: 03 栅氧极限与 04 高 k 金属栅

body.zh: 栅介质超薄化后，栅漏电与短沟道问题逐渐显现；图中标出金属栅、超薄介质、硅沟道、栅漏电、关断漏电。高 k 金属栅通过介质与电极协同升级：金属栅/高 k 介质/界面层/硅沟道。时间标记：2007，Intel 45 nm 代表节点。
body.en: With ultrathin gate dielectrics, gate leakage and short-channel issues emerge. Labels show metal gate, ultrathin dielectric, Si channel, gate leakage, off-state leakage. HKMG upgrades dielectric and electrode together: metal/high-k/interfacial layer/Si channel. Timeline: Intel 45 nm as a representative node in 2007.

body.zh: 用假栅衔接高温步骤与最终栅：1. 形成多晶硅假栅；2. 移除假栅形成栅槽，保留栅侧墙；3. 填充最终金属栅。这条流程线与结构演进并行。
body.en: Use a dummy gate to bridge high-temperature steps and the final gate: 1. form polysilicon dummy gate; 2. remove it to form a trench while retaining spacers; 3. fill the final metal gate. This process route evolves alongside device structures.

body.zh: 从更多侧面控制立起的沟道。标注：三面环绕的金属栅、侧壁与顶面栅介质、硅鳍（沟道）、浅沟槽隔离、硅衬底，以及源极、栅极、漏极。时间标记：2011 公布/2012 相关产品。
body.en: Control an upright channel from more sides. Labels: three-sided metal gate, sidewall/top dielectric, silicon fin channel, shallow-trench isolation, Si substrate, source/gate/drain. Timeline: announced in 2011, related products in 2012.

body.zh: 让栅围绕纳米片沟道。标注：四面环绕的金属栅、每片四周连续的栅介质、硅纳米片沟道、源极与漏极。时间标记：2022，三星宣布初始生产。
body.en: Surround nanosheet channels with a gate. Labels: four-sided metal gate, continuous dielectric around each sheet, silicon nanosheet channels, source/drain. Timeline: Samsung announced initial production in 2022.

body.zh: 平面：成熟工艺、成本友好。FinFET：更强栅控，适合先进节点。GAA：进一步提升栅控，面向更高性能。按“材料 × 流程 × 结构”，根据应用目标、工艺平台和设计需求综合权衡。
body.en: Planar: mature and cost-friendly. FinFET: stronger gate control for advanced nodes. GAA: further gate-control improvement for higher performance. Balance materials × process × structure against application, platform, and design requirements.

notes.en: Dates/nodes are representative milestones listed by the source; they are retained without presenting them as a complete industry history.

title.zh: 一张图看懂芯片制造中的 Plasma
title.en: Plasma in chip manufacturing at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从粒子分工，到刻蚀、成膜与损伤控制
subtitle.en: Particle roles, etching, deposition, and damage control

heading.zh: 01 认识 Plasma 与 02 粒子分工

body.zh: 把工艺气体（气体分子）送入放电腔，形成等离子体作用于晶圆。电子（能量高）通过碰撞解离气体分子；中性自由基参与多方向化学反应；正离子通过鞘层，沿电场加速轰击晶圆。
body.en: Feed process-gas molecules into a discharge chamber to create plasma acting on a wafer. Energetic electrons dissociate gas molecules by collision; neutral radicals react chemically from multiple directions; positive ions accelerate through the sheath along the electric field toward the wafer.

heading.zh: 03 图形刻蚀与 04 薄膜沉积

body.zh: 刻蚀将掩膜图形转移到目标材料中；图中标有掩膜、目标层、衬底、离子轰击与挥发产物。沉积通过活化反应或提供溅射材料成膜，路线包括 PECVD、PEALD、溅射 PVD；后者图示 Ar⁺ 轰击靶材形成溅射原子。
body.en: Etching transfers a mask pattern into the target; labels include mask, target, substrate, ion bombardment, volatile products. Deposition activates reactions or supplies sputtered material through PECVD, PEALD, or sputter PVD; the latter shows Ar⁺ bombarding a target to generate sputtered atoms.

heading.zh: 05 去胶清洗与 06 表面改性

body.zh: 去胶去掉有机物，同时保护底层；处理前后的有机胶/目标层/衬底图展示等离子体去除和挥发产物。表面改性调整最表层，为后续界面服务；化学基团、材料表面、衬底的变化用于后续键合。
body.en: Resist removal removes organics while protecting underlying layers; before/after resist/target/substrate diagrams show plasma removal and volatile products. Surface modification changes the top surface for later interfaces; chemical groups on material/substrate prepare for bonding.

heading.zh: 07 损伤控制与 08 路线选择

body.zh: 效率、均匀性与损伤一起管理，控制能量、输运、温度，并关注晶圆分布中的工艺窗口与损伤风险。直接路线：等离子体在晶圆附近，用于刻蚀或沉积。远程路线：上游产生等离子体，中性物种到达晶圆。热/湿法：加热或化学反应去除或改性表面。
body.en: Manage efficiency, uniformity, and damage together through energy, transport, and temperature, checking wafer distributions and damage risk. Direct plasma forms near the wafer for etch/deposition. Remote plasma forms upstream and delivers neutral species. Thermal/wet routes use heat or chemistry to remove or modify surfaces.

title.zh: 认识 Plasma：让气体参与精密制造
title.en: Plasma: making gases useful for precise manufacturing

subtitle.zh: 部分电离的气体，提供活性粒子与能量
subtitle.en: Partially ionized gas supplies reactive species and energy

body.zh: 具体作用取决于气体、设备与表面反应。工艺气体（中性分子）输入后，能量输入产生中性分子、离子、自由基、电子等物种；晶圆置于加热/控温台，气体与反应产物排出。
body.en: The action depends on gas, equipment, and surface reactions. Energy input into neutral process gas generates a mixture of neutral molecules, ions, radicals, and electrons. The wafer rests on a heated/temperature-controlled stage, while gas and reaction products are exhausted.

body.zh: 输入能量产生多种活性粒子；电子能量较高，晶圆仍需控温；等离子体可在多道工艺中反复使用。
body.en: Energy generates multiple reactive species. High electron energy does not remove the need for wafer temperature control. Plasma can be used repeatedly across many process steps.

body.zh: 刻蚀：去除目标材料。成膜：形成所需薄膜。去胶：清除有机胶层。改性：调整表面状态。也用于腔体清洁、等离子体掺杂。
body.en: Etch removes target material; deposition forms required films; stripping removes organic resist; modification adjusts surface condition. Plasma is also used for chamber cleaning and plasma doping.

body.zh: 比较处理前后膜厚变化及有机胶层残留是否显著减少，用晶圆上的目标变化验证作用。看见发光不足以判定工艺合格。气体、温度与放电方式随工艺路线变化。
body.en: Compare film thickness and organic-resist residue before/after treatment to verify the intended wafer change. Visible glow alone does not establish process acceptance. Gases, temperatures, and discharge methods vary with the route.

title.zh: 粒子分工：化学活性与定向能量
title.en: Particle roles: chemical activity and directional energy

subtitle.zh: 电子帮助产生粒子，自由基参与反应，离子传递能量
subtitle.en: Electrons generate species, radicals react, ions transfer energy

body.zh: 电子通过碰撞推动气体分子的激发、解离、电离。自由基是中性活性物种，参与表面化学反应。正离子在表面附近的电势过渡区（鞘层）获得能量，促进反应或轰击。光子也可能参与反应或引入损伤。图中层次为材料表面、薄膜层、衬底。
body.en: Electron collisions excite, dissociate, and ionize gas molecules. Radicals are reactive neutral species participating in surface chemistry. Positive ions gain energy in the near-surface potential transition (sheath), promoting reactions or bombardment. Photons may also react or cause damage. The stack labels material surface, film, substrate.

body.zh: 自由基提供化学活性，正离子提供定向能量，共同促成表面反应与材料去除。活性供给与能量输入需要配合；过强轰击、充电或辐射可能损伤材料与器件。
body.en: Radicals supply chemical activity and positive ions supply directional energy, together driving surface reaction/removal. Reactive supply and energy input must match; excessive bombardment, charging, or radiation can damage materials/devices.

body.zh: 气体种类与压力改变电子碰撞、自由基生成、离子能量分布。结构与几何形貌通过遮蔽和传输效应，使不同位置各类物种的作用占比不同。
body.en: Gas species/pressure alter electron collisions, radical generation, and ion-energy distribution. Geometry causes shadowing/transport effects that change relative species contributions at different locations.

body.zh: 比较加工前后厚度变化（去除速率），检查截面侧壁、底部和表面形貌。加工结果用于验证效果；机理归因需结合放电诊断。
body.en: Compare before/after thickness for removal rate, and inspect sidewall, bottom, and surface profiles. Processed-wafer results verify outcomes; mechanism attribution also requires discharge diagnostics.

title.zh: 图形刻蚀：把图形转移到目标层
title.en: Pattern etching: transferring into the target layer

subtitle.zh: 去除速率、方向性、选择比和轮廓共同受控
subtitle.en: Control removal rate, directionality, selectivity, and profile together

body.zh: 带掩膜晶圆进腔 → 通气与放电 → 表面反应 → 轮廓控制 → 产物排出 → 终点与检查。RIE（反应性离子刻蚀）结合化学反应与离子作用。
body.en: Load masked wafer → supply gas/discharge → surface reaction → profile control → product exhaust → endpoint/inspection. Reactive-ion etching (RIE) combines chemistry and ion action.

body.zh: 图示标注：正离子、中性自由基（多方向入射）、挥发产物；掩膜/目标层/停止层；侧壁保护抑制侧向刻蚀；底部去除由离子与化学反应共同完成。
body.en: Diagram labels: positive ions, neutral radicals arriving from multiple directions, volatile products; mask/target/stop layer; sidewall protection suppresses lateral etch; ions plus chemistry remove the bottom.

body.zh: 气体控制反应与钝化，偏压控制离子能量，压力控制输运与碰撞，温度影响反应与挥发。偏压过低可能去除不足，过高可能增加掩膜消耗与底层损伤。
body.en: Gas controls reaction/passivation; bias controls ion energy; pressure controls transport/collisions; temperature affects reactions/volatility. Too little bias can under-remove; too much can consume masks and damage lower layers.

body.zh: 常见形貌：侧蚀（侧向去除）、底部残留（去除不完全）、微沟槽（底部两侧深蚀）。侧壁保护随化学体系变化；既有各向异性刻蚀（侧壁受保护），也有各向同性刻蚀（侧向也去除）。
body.en: Typical profiles: lateral etching, bottom residue from incomplete removal, and microtrenches deep along bottom corners. Sidewall protection depends on chemistry; etching can be anisotropic with sidewall protection or isotropic with lateral removal.

body.zh: 量测 CD（关键尺寸）、截面侧壁角与深度、片内均匀性。异常先复测并检查设备状态。轮廓会影响后续填充与接触形成。
body.en: Measure CD, cross-sectional sidewall angle/depth, and wafer uniformity. Remeasure abnormalities and inspect equipment first. Etched profiles affect subsequent fill and contact formation.

title.zh: 薄膜沉积：等离子体也能帮助长膜
title.en: Deposition: plasma can also grow films

subtitle.zh: 化学活化与靶材溅射，是不同的成膜路径
subtitle.en: Chemical activation and target sputtering are distinct deposition routes

body.zh: 长膜还是去膜，取决于材料供给与表面净反应。
body.en: Net growth versus removal depends on material supply and the net surface reaction.

body.zh: 等离子体增强化学气相沉积：气体前驱体供给 → 等离子体活化 → 晶圆表面长膜 → 挥发副产物排出。在适合体系中，可降低相对热 CVD 的成膜温度。
body.en: Plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition: supply gaseous precursor → activate with plasma → grow film on wafer → exhaust volatile byproducts. Suitable systems can lower growth temperature relative to thermal CVD.

body.zh: 等离子体增强原子层沉积以脉冲供给前驱体，循环执行：前驱体吸附 → 吹扫 → 等离子体表面反应 → 吹扫。通过自限表面反应逐周期控制生长。
body.en: Plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition supplies precursor pulses in cycles: adsorption → purge → plasma surface reaction → purge. Self-limiting reactions control growth cycle by cycle.

body.zh: 物理气相沉积的一类：Ar⁺ 轰击靶材 → 溅出材料飞行 → 到达晶圆表面 → 形成薄膜。供给、等离子体条件、温度、暴露时间需匹配；降低温度后仍要验证杂质、致密性与应力。
body.en: A physical vapor deposition route: Ar⁺ bombards target → sputtered material travels → reaches wafer → forms film. Match supply, plasma conditions, temperature, and exposure time; lower temperatures still require impurity, density, and stress validation.

body.zh: 量测膜厚图、成分或键合状态、应力（晶圆曲率）；按用途追加电阻或漏电验证。三条路线的步骤和覆盖能力不能通用；PEALD 需验证深结构输运与表面饱和。
body.en: Measure thickness maps, composition/bonding state, and stress through wafer curvature; add resistance or leakage validation as needed. The three routes do not share interchangeable steps/coverage capabilities; PEALD requires verification of deep-feature transport and surface saturation.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 去胶清洗：去掉目标物，也要保护底层
title.en: Stripping and cleaning: remove targets while protecting underlayers

subtitle.zh: 分清大量去胶、薄残胶清除与刻后残留处理
subtitle.en: Distinguish bulk stripping, descum, and post-etch residue removal

body.zh: 灰化/去胶去除主体有机胶层，将有机物转为挥发性产物并排出。Descum 仅清除显影后开口底部的薄残胶，保留光刻胶图形。图中下层为目标层和衬底。
body.en: Ashing/stripping removes bulk organic resist by converting it to volatile products and exhausting them. Descum removes only thin residual resist at developed opening bottoms while retaining the resist pattern. Underlayers are target and substrate.

body.zh: 氧活性物种使有机组分转化为可排出的挥发性产物。流程：辨认胶与底层 → 选择化学体系 → 控制温度与暴露 → 必要后清洗 → 检查残留与膜损失。控制化学体系、温度、处理时间、离子暴露。
body.en: Reactive oxygen converts organic material into exhaustible volatile products. Flow: identify resist/underlayer → choose chemistry → control temperature/exposure → post-clean if needed → inspect residue/film loss. Control chemistry, temperature, treatment time, and ion exposure.

body.zh: 风险：金属氧化、底层材料损失、含碳低 k 介质损伤。刻后残留可能含有机物、无机物或金属组分，需要选择干法、湿法或组合路线。
body.en: Risks: metal oxidation, underlayer loss, damage to carbon-containing low-k dielectrics. Post-etch residue can include organics, inorganics, or metals, requiring dry, wet, or combined removal.

body.zh: 以表面形貌看残留缺陷、表面成分辨认残留类型、膜厚变化评估底层膜损失。异常先复核残留类型与材料相容性。要同时满足残留去除与材料保护，为后续接触和成膜提供合适表面。
body.en: Use surface morphology to inspect residue defects, composition to identify residue type, and thickness change to assess underlayer loss. First recheck residue type and material compatibility when abnormal. Meet both residue removal and material-protection goals to prepare surfaces for contacts/deposition.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 表面改性：为下一道界面做好准备
title.en: Surface modification: preparing the next interface

subtitle.zh: 调整表面化学状态，关注后续成膜与键合结果
subtitle.en: Tune surface chemistry and verify later deposition/bonding

body.zh: 改变最表层反应能力与界面条件。处理前的表面基团，经受控等离子体活化改变反应位点，产生新的表面基团与改性表面，为后续界面服务。结构标注介质材料、衬底。
body.en: Change the topmost surface reactivity and interface conditions. Controlled plasma activation modifies reaction sites and surface groups, preparing a modified surface for the next interface. Labels include dielectric material and substrate.

body.zh: 以适用的介质直接键合为例：前清洗 → 受控活化 → 按路线准备表面 → 规定等待时间内贴合 → 热处理与验证。关键参数：气体组成、能量输入、暴露时间、处理后等待时间。
body.en: For suitable dielectric direct bonding: preclean → controlled activation → route-specific surface preparation → contact within the specified wait time → thermal treatment/validation. Parameters: gas composition, energy input, exposure time, post-treatment wait.

body.zh: 活化需配合颗粒、粗糙度和平坦度控制，保持表面平整洁净。过度处理可能粗糙化或损伤材料。污染与状态漂移可能在上下介质界面形成键合空洞，导致强度不稳。
body.en: Activation must accompany particle, roughness, and flatness control for clean, flat surfaces. Overtreatment can roughen or damage materials. Contamination/state drift can create voids at the dielectric interface and unstable bond strength.

body.zh: 量测接触角、表面成分、粗糙度，最终验证键合空洞与键合强度。接触角仅表征润湿状态的一部分；不同介质、混合键合与金属界面要求不同。
body.en: Measure contact angle, surface composition, and roughness, then validate bond voids/strength. Contact angle captures only part of wetting behavior; requirements differ among dielectrics, hybrid bonding, and metal interfaces.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 损伤控制：把效率与器件结果一起管
title.en: Damage control: manage efficiency and device outcomes together

subtitle.zh: 活性粒子、离子能量、输运和热负荷共同决定窗口
subtitle.en: Reactive species, ion energy, transport, and heat load jointly set the window

body.zh: 气体组成与供给：反应物种、钝化、选择性。源功率与偏压：放电/粒子产生与离子能量，仍可能耦合。压力与输运：碰撞、到达方向、产物排出。晶圆温度与暴露：吸附、反应、累积热负荷；图中标有热传导与热辐射。
body.en: Gas composition/supply controls species, passivation, selectivity. Source power/bias controls discharge/species generation and ion energy, which may remain coupled. Pressure/transport controls collisions, arrival direction, exhaust. Wafer temperature/exposure controls adsorption, reactions, accumulated heat; conduction/radiation are illustrated.

body.zh: 物理轰击：高能离子造成表面和近表面缺陷，并产生溅射产物。充电：等离子体使正离子/电子电荷积累，引发电场与薄介质损伤。活性物种与 UV/VUV（紫外/真空紫外）：引发表面反应、键断裂、材料及界面变化。需检查片内分布，关注漏电和可靠性。
body.en: Physical bombardment: high-energy ions create surface/near-surface defects and sputtered products. Charging: ion/electron accumulation induces electric fields and thin-dielectric damage. Reactive species and UV/VUV trigger surface reactions, bond breaking, and material/interface changes. Check wafer distributions, leakage, and reliability.

body.zh: 过程信号 + 晶圆结果 + 电学验证。速率、形貌、均匀性、材料损失与可靠性需同时满足。OES 用于趋势与适用终点；RF 电压/电流反映放电状态；分布图与监控结构反映实际结果。
body.en: Combine process signals, wafer results, and electrical validation. Meet rate, profile, uniformity, material-loss, and reliability requirements together. OES supports trends/applicable endpoint detection; RF voltage/current indicates discharge state; maps/monitor structures show actual results.

body.zh: 复测 → 按风险暂扣 → 设备检查与根因分析 → 验证后恢复。光强不能直接等同于粒子密度；远程放电仍需评估离子、光子与化学损伤。
body.en: Remeasure → hold according to risk → inspect equipment/analyze cause → resume after validation. Optical intensity is not directly particle density; remote discharge still requires ion, photon, and chemical-damage assessment.

title.zh: 工艺选择：先看任务，再选等离子体路线
title.en: Route selection: define the task before selecting plasma

subtitle.zh: 方向性、材料相容性、热预算和损伤预算一起考虑
subtitle.en: Consider directionality, compatibility, thermal budget, and damage budget

body.zh: 从目标结构与材料约束出发，由晶圆和器件验证决定路线。
body.en: Start from target structure/material constraints and decide using wafer/device validation.

body.zh: 射频电极在晶圆附近放电产生离子与中性物种，正离子定向轰击晶圆。适合需要离子能量或方向性的任务，如典型 RIE；需控制充电、轰击、辐射和材料损失。直接放电也可用于成膜。
body.en: An RF electrode generates ions/neutral species near the wafer; positive ions bombard directionally. Suitable for tasks needing ion energy/directionality, such as typical RIE; control charging, bombardment, radiation, material loss. Direct discharge also supports deposition.

body.zh: 上游远程放电源产生等离子体，经管道输运，使中性活性物种到达表面。适当结构可减少直接离子暴露，利用活性物种反应；输运与复合可能限制到达量。减少离子暴露后仍需验证损伤。
body.en: An upstream source generates plasma and transports reactive neutrals through a line to the surface. Suitable geometry reduces direct ion exposure while using reactive chemistry; transport/recombination may limit delivery. Reduced ion exposure still requires damage validation.

body.zh: 加热晶圆进行热反应，或使用化学溶液进行湿法处理。化学与热预算适合时，可规避部分等离子体损伤机制，但仍受温度、选择性、形貌与界面条件限制。
body.en: Heat wafers for thermal reactions or use chemical solutions for wet processing. When chemistry/thermal budget permit, these avoid some plasma-damage mechanisms but remain constrained by temperature, selectivity, profile, interfaces.

body.zh: 依次判断：要去除、成膜还是改性？是否需要方向性与离子能量？暴露材料能承受什么？深结构输运和产物排出可行吗？量测与器件验证通过吗？
body.en: Ask in sequence: removal, deposition, or modification? Is directionality/ion energy needed? What can exposed materials tolerate? Are deep-feature transport/exhaust feasible? Do metrology/device validation pass?

body.zh: 按任务比较线宽与截面、膜厚与膜质、残留与材料损失、电学或键合结果，同时评价均匀性、重复性与产能。直接/远程描述放电区与晶圆的关系，同一流程可组合多条路线。
body.en: Compare linewidth/cross-section, thickness/film quality, residue/material loss, electrical/bonding outcomes, along with uniformity, repeatability, throughput. Direct/remote describe discharge-to-wafer geometry; one flow can combine routes.

title.zh: 一张图看懂 VDMOS
title.en: VDMOS at a glance

subtitle.zh: 双扩散工艺 → 器件机理 → 功率开关
subtitle.en: Double diffusion → device mechanism → power switching

body.zh: 传统硅基 N 沟道、平面栅结构。栅极控制表面沟道，主导电路径穿过芯片厚度。
body.en: Conventional silicon N-channel planar-gate VDMOS: the gate controls a surface channel and the main conduction path crosses the chip thickness.

body.zh: 1. 衬底与外延：N⁺ 衬底低阻导电，N⁻ 漂移区轻掺杂并支撑耐压。2. 栅氧与栅极：SiO₂ 氧化层绝缘，多晶硅栅极施加电场。3. P 体区形成：注入与扩散形成体区。4. N⁺ 源区形成：两种扩散轮廓共同定义沟道。5. 接触与金属：正面源—体短接，背面漏极；金属分别标 S、D。
body.en: 1. Substrate/epitaxy: N⁺ substrate gives low-resistance conduction; lightly doped N⁻ drift region supports voltage. 2. Gate oxide/gate: SiO₂ insulates and polysilicon gate applies field. 3. Form P-body by implantation/diffusion. 4. Form N⁺ source; two diffusion profiles jointly define the channel. 5. Contacts/metal: short source to body on top, drain on back; metal labels S/D.

body.zh: 这是代表性流程，实际顺序随工艺平台变化。工艺反馈：外延厚度与掺杂、结深与片阻、栅氧厚度。
body.en: This is a representative flow; actual sequence depends on platform. Process feedback: epitaxial thickness/doping, junction depth/sheet resistance, gate-oxide thickness.

body.zh: 栅极 G：电场控制沟道。栅氧：隔开栅与硅。N⁺ 源区：电子入口。P 体区：沟道形成区。源极 S：连接源区与体区。反型沟道：电子通路。JFET 区：导电路径收窄。N⁻ 漂移区：支撑耐压。N⁺ 衬底：低阻导电基础。漏极 D：背面电极。
body.en: Gate G controls channel electrostatically; oxide separates gate and Si. N⁺ source is the electron entry; P-body hosts the channel; source S connects source/body. The inversion channel carries electrons; the JFET region narrows the path; N⁻ drift supports voltage; N⁺ substrate provides low-resistance conduction; drain D is the rear electrode.

body.zh: 橙色箭头表示电子从两侧流入，再向下至漏极。表面形成沟道，内部承担耐压，背面连接漏极。
body.en: Orange arrows show electrons entering from both sides and then moving downward to the drain. The channel forms at the surface, the interior supports voltage, and the drain connects at the rear.

body.zh: 导通：足够的正栅源电压形成反型沟道，路径为 N⁺ 源区 → 沟道 → JFET 区 → 漂移区 → 漏极。Vth 仅代表开始形成沟道，不等于充分导通。
body.en: On: sufficient positive gate–source voltage forms an inversion channel; path: N⁺ source → channel → JFET region → drift → drain. Vth marks channel onset, not full enhancement.

body.zh: 关断：沟道消失，体区—漂移区结反偏，耗尽区主要向轻掺杂 N⁻ 漂移区扩展；边缘终端管理电场，避免提前击穿。漂移区更厚、掺杂更低，通常耐压提高，导通电阻也增加。
body.en: Off: channel disappears, body–drift junction is reverse biased, depletion expands mainly into lightly doped N⁻ drift. Edge termination manages field to prevent premature breakdown. Thicker/lower-doped drift usually increases voltage capability and on-resistance.

body.zh: R_DS(on) ≈ 沟道电阻 + 积累区电阻 + JFET 区电阻 + 漂移区电阻 + 衬底及接触电阻。导通损耗 ≈ I²R_DS(on)；开关过程电压与电流重叠产生损耗。原图还提示电阻、电容与栅电荷同时受到影响，该条开头小字待复核。
body.en: R_DS(on) ≈ channel + accumulation + JFET + drift + substrate/contact resistances. Conduction loss ≈ I²R_DS(on); voltage/current overlap causes switching loss. The source also notes simultaneous effects on resistance, capacitance, and gate charge; the opening small-print words of that item require verification.

body.zh: 电性反馈：Vth、指定栅压与温度下的 R_DS(on)、击穿电压、漏电电流、栅电荷 Q_g。
body.en: Electrical feedback: Vth, R_DS(on) at specified gate voltage/temperature, breakdown voltage, leakage current, gate charge Q_g.

body.zh: 体二极管位于源侧阳极与漏侧阴极之间，由 P 体区—N⁻ 漂移区结形成，需关注反向恢复。N⁺ 源区—P 体区—N⁻ 漂移区可形成寄生 NPN，分别对应发射极、基极、集电极；源—体短接有助于抑制触发。
body.en: The body diode has its anode at source and cathode at drain, formed by the P-body/N⁻ drift junction; consider reverse recovery. N⁺ source/P-body/N⁻ drift forms a parasitic NPN emitter/base/collector; source–body shorting helps suppress triggering.

body.zh: 驱动器根据控制信号控制栅极 G，VDMOS 通过 D–S 通路开关负载电流。图示负载为电机、灯等，电源正端经负载到 D，S 接电源负端。用途：电机控制、灯光调节、开关电源。
body.en: A driver applies control signals to gate G; VDMOS switches load current through D–S. In the diagram the positive supply feeds a motor/lamp load then D, with S tied to negative supply. Uses: motor control, lighting control, switching power supplies.

title.zh: 一张图看懂 OCD 量测
title.en: OCD metrology at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从光学响应到模型反演与工艺选择
subtitle.en: From optical response to model inversion and method selection

heading.zh: 01 量测定位与 02 光学机理

body.zh: 先测光学响应，再反演结构：晶圆周期测试图形 → 实测光谱（反射率—波长）→ 模型反演截面。结构与材料共同改变光响应；入射光产生镜面反射与可选级次的衍射光。
body.en: Measure optical response first, then infer structure: periodic wafer target → measured reflectance-versus-wavelength spectrum → model-inverted cross-section. Structure and materials jointly alter optical response, including specular reflection and selectable diffraction orders.

heading.zh: 03 目标结构与 04 模型建立

body.zh: 测试图形要匹配模型与光斑。图示匹配光栅的完整光斑，以及边缘混入周边结构的非理想情况。几何与材料假设决定解释方式，模型包含 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈。
body.en: Targets must match model and optical spot. The figure contrasts a matched grating/spot with unwanted neighboring structures entering the spot edge. Geometry/material assumptions define interpretation, including CD, height, sidewall angle, and stack.

heading.zh: 05 参数反演与 06 可信验证

body.zh: 找到匹配不等于找到唯一答案：不同模型 A/B 与参数组合可能产生相似实测光谱。重复性、偏差和不确定度要分开看；图示一种重复好但偏离参考，另一种重复好且接近参考，坐标为参考值和量测结果。
body.en: A match is not necessarily unique: different models A/B and parameter combinations may yield similar spectra. Separate repeatability, bias, uncertainty; plots compare repeatable-but-biased results with repeatable results near the reference, using reference and measured axes.

heading.zh: 07 异常诊断与 08 方法选择

body.zh: 异常要区分定位/设备问题、模型问题、真实工艺变化。按控制问题组合 OCD（光学量测）、CD-SEM（电子显微镜）、AFM/截面方法（形貌量测）。
body.en: Distinguish positioning/equipment issues, model issues, and true process changes. Combine OCD (optical), CD-SEM (electron microscopy), and AFM/cross-section morphology methods according to the control problem.

title.zh: 量测定位：先测光学响应，再反演结构
title.en: Positioning OCD: measure optical response, then infer structure

subtitle.zh: 分清直接观测量与模型提取量
subtitle.en: Distinguish direct observations from model-extracted quantities

body.zh: 仪器采集光学响应；CD、高度等是模型提取结果。通用晶圆周期图形 → 实测光学响应随波长变化的曲线 → 模型 → 反演截面（CD、高度）。
body.en: The instrument collects optical response; CD/height are model-extracted results. Periodic wafer target → measured response versus wavelength → model → inverted cross-section/CD/height.

body.zh: 用于光刻、刻蚀等图形控制节点，并连接后续工艺。流程：明确需要解决的图形控制问题 → 选择量测位置与目标结构 → 仪器采集光学响应 → 模型反演结构参数 → 验证结果并反馈图形控制。
body.en: Used at lithography/etch pattern-control nodes and linked to subsequent processing. Flow: define pattern-control issue → select position/target → collect optical response → invert structural parameters → validate and feed back to pattern control.

body.zh: 目标位置需准确并匹配图形；响应需有足够信号质量；模型需在适用范围内；CD、高度等需有明确尺寸定义。
body.en: Locate the correct target accurately; ensure adequate signal quality; remain within model applicability; explicitly define CD, height, and other dimensions.

body.zh: 结构与材料共同影响入射光的反射/散射响应。量测位置错位、目标区域污染、实际结构与模型失配，都可能造成异常。
body.en: Structure and materials jointly affect reflected/scattered response. Mispositioning, target contamination, and mismatch between actual structure/model can cause anomalies.

body.zh: 综合原始响应、拟合残差（随波长）、提取参数判断可靠性。异常先复测并核查定位、目标状态、模型是否匹配。输出参数支持工艺监控、图形优化与异常分析，但 CD、高度等必须经过可识别性与准确性验证。
body.en: Assess reliability using raw response, wavelength-dependent fit residuals, and extracted parameters. Remeasure anomalies and check location, target condition, model match. Outputs support process monitoring, pattern optimization, anomaly analysis, but CD/height require identifiability and accuracy validation.
