title.zh: 光学机理：结构与材料共同改变光响应
title.en: Optical mechanism: geometry and materials change the response

subtitle.zh: 波长、角度与偏振提供不同信息
subtitle.en: Wavelength, angle, and polarization provide different information

body.zh: 几何和材料改变电磁响应，是尺寸反演的基础。斜入射光对平行周期光栅作用，入射角与镜面反射角相对法线均为 θ；还有其他衍射方向。较大与较小高宽比结构呈现不同光学响应—波长曲线，响应形式依设备配置而变。
body.en: Geometry/materials alter electromagnetic response, enabling dimensional inversion. Oblique light interacts with a periodic parallel grating; incident/specular angles are θ relative to normal, with other diffraction directions. High/low aspect-ratio structures show different response-versus-wavelength curves; response type depends on equipment configuration.

heading.zh: 配置选择与灵敏度分析

body.zh: 照明条件（波长、角度、偏振）→ 结构相互作用（几何与材料改变电磁响应）→ 收集不同方向光信号 → 形成随条件变化的响应数据 → 评估对结构参数的灵敏度。
body.en: Illumination wavelength/angle/polarization → geometry/material interaction → collect signals from different directions → response data across conditions → assess structural-parameter sensitivity.

body.zh: 波长范围提供不同信息；入射角改变相互作用；偏振激发不同响应；材料光学常数影响电磁响应。增加数据维度可能改善参数区分，但不保证全部可识别。弱灵敏度、校准偏差、材料误差都会影响结果。
body.en: Wavelength range provides different information; angle changes interaction; polarization excites different responses; optical constants affect electromagnetic behavior. More data dimensions can improve parameter separation without guaranteeing identifiability. Weak sensitivity, calibration bias, and material errors affect results.

body.zh: 检查响应稳定性、噪声与灵敏度，判断配置是否提供有效信息，并影响模型能力。不同设备响应形式不同，不能把所有 OCD 都描述为只测高阶衍射。
body.en: Check response stability, noise, and sensitivity to judge useful information and model capability. Equipment configurations differ; OCD cannot universally be described as measuring only higher diffraction orders.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 目标结构：测试图形要匹配模型与光斑
title.en: Targets: matching test patterns to model and optical spot

subtitle.zh: 位置、尺寸、周期性与代表性共同决定可测性
subtitle.en: Position, size, periodicity, and representativeness determine measurability

body.zh: 常见 OCD 目标采用周期结构，目标需可测且能代表关注的工艺。图示规则矩形光栅，比较光斑完整在目标内部与边缘混入周边结构。
body.en: Common OCD targets are periodic and must be measurable and representative of the relevant process. Rectangular gratings illustrate a spot fully inside the target versus contamination by neighboring structures at the edge.

body.zh: 用于测试结构设计、版图整合与选点。流程：结构问题 → 设计目标 → 光斑覆盖 → 对应模型 → 代表性验证。关键控制：目标面积、节距与方向、周边结构、与产品结构的对应关系。
body.en: Used in target design, layout integration, and site selection. Flow: structural issue → target design → spot coverage → matching model → representativeness validation. Control target area, pitch/orientation, surroundings, and correspondence to product structures.

body.zh: 规整目标便于建模，但可能与产品环境不同。风险包括边缘混入、定位偏差、目标损伤、代表性不足。
body.en: Regular targets simplify modeling but can differ from product environments. Risks include edge contamination, positioning error, target damage, inadequate representativeness.

body.zh: 核查目标位置、重复测量、目标间相关性；必要时与产品结构表征比较。目标代表性决定工艺判断能否迁移到产品，测试光栅不等于产品全部结构。
body.en: Check location, repeated measurements, inter-target correlation; compare with product characterization when needed. Representativeness determines whether process conclusions transfer to products; a test grating is not the entire product structure.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。

title.zh: 模型建立：几何与材料假设决定解释方式
title.en: Model building: geometry and material assumptions define interpretation

subtitle.zh: 将真实结构转为可计算、可验证的参数模型
subtitle.en: Turn real structures into computable, verifiable parameter models

body.zh: 保留影响响应的关键特征，避免无依据增加自由参数。图示顶部 CD、底部 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈与材料光学常数 n/k（随波长变化）。几何存在约束关系，不应全部独立拟合。
body.en: Retain response-relevant features without unjustified free parameters. Labels include top/bottom CD, height, sidewall angle, stack, wavelength-dependent optical constants n/k. Geometric constraints mean these should not all be fitted independently.

body.zh: 堆栈与形貌 → 几何参数 → 材料 n/k → 电磁计算 → 灵敏度与参考验证。关键控制为层堆栈、几何参数化、光学常数 n/k、参数约束。
body.en: Stack/profile → geometry parameters → material n/k → electromagnetic calculation → sensitivity/reference validation. Control stack, geometric parameterization, n/k, and parameter constraints.

body.zh: 过简会遗漏形貌而无法正确解释响应；过复杂会增加参数相关性，降低稳定性。漏层、错误 n/k、不合理参数约束都可能造成偏差。
body.en: Oversimplification omits profile features and misinterprets response; excessive complexity increases parameter correlation and reduces stability. Missing layers, wrong n/k, or unreasonable constraints can cause bias.

body.zh: 检查残差形态、参考偏差和不同模型版本的参数稳定性，支持修订与重新验证。模型适用性影响跨批次可比性；结构或材料变化时，需评估旧模型是否仍适用。
body.en: Inspect residual shape, reference bias, and parameter stability across model versions to support revisions/revalidation. Applicability affects cross-lot comparability; reevaluate old models after structure/material changes.

title.zh: 参数反演：找到匹配，不等于找到唯一答案
title.en: Parameter inversion: a match is not necessarily unique

subtitle.zh: 看拟合质量、参数相关性与物理合理性
subtitle.en: Assess fit quality, correlation, and physical plausibility

body.zh: 相似响应可能对应不同参数组合，低残差不能单独证明结构正确。图示较高结构与较低结构通过不同高度/CD 组合产生相似光学响应；紫色实线和橙色虚线为几何一/二，横轴为波长。CD—高度参数空间中的倾斜长椭圆表示相关性。
body.en: Similar responses may correspond to different parameter combinations; low residual alone does not prove structural correctness. Taller/shorter geometries with different height/CD combinations yield similar spectra: purple solid/orange dashed denote geometry 1/2 versus wavelength. Tilted elongated ellipses in CD–height space show correlation.

body.zh: 载入数据 → 范围与约束 → 搜索匹配 → 相关性与稳定性 → 验证报告。控制参数范围、噪声权重、初始条件与搜索策略、参数相关性。
body.en: Load data → ranges/constraints → search matches → correlation/stability → validation report. Control parameter ranges, noise weighting, initialization/search strategy, and correlation.

body.zh: 参数可能相互补偿；局部最优、边界解、过度拟合、多解均是风险。综合残差、多起点结果、相关性与不确定度，判断参数是否值得报告。反演影响趋势与决策，库匹配、回归等实现都需验证。
body.en: Parameters may compensate for each other; local optima, boundary solutions, overfitting, multiple solutions are risks. Combine residuals, multi-start results, correlation, and uncertainty to decide whether a parameter should be reported. Inversion affects trends/decisions; library matching, regression, and other implementations require validation.

title.zh: 可信验证：重复性、偏差与不确定度分开看
title.en: Validation: separate repeatability, bias, and uncertainty

subtitle.zh: 测得稳定，还要证明接近可信参考
subtitle.en: Stable measurements must also agree with a credible reference

body.zh: 高重复性不等于高准确度，模型与系统误差仍需评估。图示橙色结果重复好但有偏，蓝色结果重复好且接近参考；参考值本身也有不确定度。
body.en: High repeatability does not imply high accuracy; model/systematic errors need assessment. Orange results are repeatable but biased, blue results repeatable and close to reference; the reference itself has uncertainty.

body.zh: 用于方法导入、设备匹配与模型变更验收。流程：统一定义 → 重复性测试 → 参考比较 → 偏差与不确定度 → 适用范围。关键控制：重复性、系统偏差、参考不确定度、机台间匹配。
body.en: Used for method introduction, tool matching, model-change acceptance. Flow: unify definitions → repeatability tests → reference comparison → bias/uncertainty → applicability range. Control repeatability, systematic bias, reference uncertainty, tool matching.

body.zh: 参考方法也有误差；位置、CD 高度定义、采样范围不同会产生不一致。根据残差、偏差趋势、不确定度决定通过、限制使用或重新验证。验证影响规格可信度，CD-SEM、AFM、截面需明确各自定义。
body.en: References also have error; differences in position, CD measurement-height definition, or sampling can cause disagreement. Use residuals, bias trends, uncertainty to accept, restrict use, or revalidate. Validation affects specification credibility; define CD-SEM, AFM, and cross-section measurements explicitly.

title.zh: 异常诊断：区分工艺变化与量测问题
title.en: Diagnosis: distinguish process changes from metrology problems

subtitle.zh: 连接原始信号、模型状态与工艺记录
subtitle.en: Connect raw signals, model state, and process records

body.zh: 尺寸漂移可能来自工艺，也可能来自定位、光学系统或模型。定位/设备分支检查定位、光学系统、设备状态；模型分支检查模型状态、模型与参考、残差形态；真实工艺分支检查工艺变化、材料变化、工艺记录。三方证据交叉判断。
body.en: Dimensional drift may arise from process, positioning, optical system, or model. Position/equipment branch: location, optics, tool state. Model branch: model state, reference agreement, residual shape. Process branch: actual process/material changes and records. Cross-check all three.

body.zh: 用于在线监控异常后的判断与处置。按规则 Hold → 复测 → 根因分析。具体链路：发现异常 → 复测与定位 → 信号与设备 → 模型与参考 → 工艺记录，定位根因。
body.en: For anomalies in online monitoring: hold according to rules → remeasure → analyze cause. Detailed chain: detect anomaly → repeat/location check → signals/equipment → model/reference → process records to locate root cause.

body.zh: 关注信号稳定性、残差形态、参数是否触边、空间与时间趋势（片内、片间、时间）。材料变化可能被误解为尺寸变化；污染、设备漂移、模型失配可能同时出现。
body.en: Monitor signal stability, residual shape, parameters hitting bounds, spatial/time trends within/across wafers and over time. Material changes may masquerade as dimension changes; contamination, equipment drift, and model mismatch may coexist.

body.zh: 结合原始响应、晶圆分布、复测与交叉量测，按规则 Hold 并分析根因。目标是避免错误放行和调参；量测异常不直接等于改工艺配方。
body.en: Combine raw response, wafer maps, repeats, cross-metrology; hold by rules and investigate. Avoid incorrect release or tuning; a metrology anomaly does not automatically justify changing the process recipe.

title.zh: 工艺选择：按控制问题组合量测方法
title.en: Method selection: combine metrology for the control problem

subtitle.zh: 量测能力匹配结构、节拍与风险
subtitle.en: Match capability to structure, throughput, and risk

body.zh: OCD 用于经过验证的模型化监控，其他方法补充局部图像、表面与截面信息。OCD 依赖光学灵敏度与模型，输出光谱及反演截面；图示强度—波长曲线和反演结构。
body.en: OCD provides validated model-based monitoring; other methods add local images, surface, cross-section data. OCD depends on optical sensitivity/model and yields spectra/inverted cross-sections; diagrams show intensity versus wavelength and inferred structure.

body.zh: CD-SEM 提供局部图像与尺寸信息，需考虑边缘定义与电子束影响。AFM/截面补充形貌，需评估探针可达性、制样与采样限制；图示 AFM 表面轮廓和截面形貌。
body.en: CD-SEM provides local images/dimensions, with edge definition and electron-beam effects considered. AFM/cross-sections add morphology, requiring probe-access, preparation, sampling-limit assessment; diagrams show surface profiles and cross-sections.

body.zh: 用于量测方案、工艺开发与在线控制：控制问题 → 结构与指标 → 比较方法 → 交叉验证 → 采样反馈规则。
body.en: Used in metrology planning, process development, online control: control problem → structure/metrics → compare methods → cross-validate → sampling/feedback rules.

body.zh: 控制结构适用性、准确度与不确定度、采样范围、节拍与样品影响。覆盖不足、定义不一致、代表性不足可能误导控制。使用尺寸趋势、形貌证据与不确定度支持工艺验收与异常定位。
body.en: Control structural applicability, accuracy/uncertainty, sampling range, throughput/sample impact. Insufficient coverage, inconsistent definitions, poor representativeness can mislead control. Use dimension trends, morphology evidence, uncertainty for process acceptance and diagnosis.

body.zh: 按结构和风险组合方法；通用规则不能替代具体方法验证。
body.en: Combine methods according to structure/risk; generic rules cannot replace validation of the specific method.

title.zh: 一张图看懂轻掺杂与重掺杂
title.en: Light and heavy doping at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从浓度、电阻到电场与工艺选择
subtitle.en: From concentration and resistance to electric fields and process choice

body.zh: 轻重看程度，N/P看类型。N型与P型都可以轻掺杂（浓度低）或重掺杂（浓度高）；晶格图中的粒子密度仅为示意。
body.en: Light/heavy describes degree; N/P describes type. Either N-type or P-type material may be lightly or heavily doped. Particle densities in the lattice drawings are illustrative.

body.zh: 载流子增多，也要看迁移率：σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ)。定性曲线显示，掺杂浓度增加时，载流子浓度通常增加，而杂质散射会影响迁移率。
body.en: More carriers must be considered together with mobility: σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ). The qualitative curves show carrier concentration generally increasing with doping, while impurity scattering affects mobility.

body.zh: 耗尽区宽度改变电压分布。图示重掺杂P型与轻掺杂N型结，耗尽区向轻掺杂侧伸展；下图以位置为横轴、电场强度为纵轴，均为定性示意。
body.en: Depletion width changes the voltage distribution. In the illustrated heavily doped P/lightly doped N junction, depletion extends toward the lightly doped side. The lower plot shows qualitative field strength versus position.

body.zh: 同一器件需要不同掺杂区：P型衬底上有重掺杂源区、重掺杂漏区、两侧轻掺杂扩展区，以及源极、漏极、栅极和栅氧化层。
body.en: A device requires different doped regions: heavily doped source/drain and lightly doped extensions in a P-type substrate, with source, drain, gate and gate oxide.

body.zh: 注入多少不等于最终浓度。离子束决定注入剂量；注入后与退火后的浓度—深度定性曲线不同，热处理可改变分布。
body.en: Implanted amount does not equal final concentration. The ion beam supplies the implant dose; the qualitative concentration–depth profiles differ before and after annealing because thermal treatment can change the distribution.

body.zh: 掺进去，还要形成电学作用。注入后存在晶格损伤、杂质未激活；退火后晶格修复，杂质得到电学激活。
body.en: Dopants must become electrically active. Implantation leaves lattice damage and inactive dopants; annealing repairs the lattice and activates dopants.

body.zh: 电阻、电场（耐压）与漏电相互牵制，需要在多重目标间权衡。
body.en: Resistance, electric field (voltage withstand) and leakage are coupled and require trade-offs.

body.zh: 按区域职责选择掺杂路线。离子注入控制剂量与区域，但需处理损伤；热扩散依赖源与热历程，要关注横向扩散；原位掺杂外延在生长中形成掺杂层，要控制生长与界面。
body.en: Select the doping route for each region’s role. Implantation controls dose and location but requires damage treatment. Thermal diffusion depends on the source and thermal history and requires attention to lateral diffusion. In-situ doped epitaxy forms a doped layer during growth and requires growth/interface control.

title.zh: 浓度定义：轻重不等于N型P型
title.en: Concentration: light/heavy is distinct from N/P type

subtitle.zh: 分清导电类型、化学浓度与有效掺杂
subtitle.en: Distinguish conductivity type, chemical concentration and effective doping

body.zh: N/P与轻/重是两个维度。N型或P型描述导电类型（施主或受主）；轻掺杂或重掺杂描述掺杂浓度相对高低。n⁺、p⁺通常表示重掺杂区。图示N型轻掺杂、N型重掺杂、P型轻掺杂与P型重掺杂；灰色为Si原子，紫色为施主杂质（如P类），橙色为受主杂质（如B类）。粒子密度仅为示意，杂质原子数量远少于硅原子。
body.en: N/P and light/heavy are separate dimensions. N/P describes conductivity type (donor or acceptor); light/heavy describes relative doping concentration. n⁺ and p⁺ usually denote heavily doped regions. The diagrams show all four combinations. Gray denotes Si, purple donor impurities such as P, and orange acceptors such as B. Densities are illustrative; dopant atoms are far fewer than silicon atoms.

body.zh: 1. 区域职责：按器件功能确定N/P型及掺杂强度。2. 施主或受主：施主形成N型、提供额外电子；受主形成P型、产生空穴。3. 目标分布：设定化学浓度及表面峰值、结深、横向范围等空间分布。4. 形成掺杂区：注入或扩散引入杂质，经退火激活。5. 电学验证：确认导电类型与掺杂强度符合设计。
body.en: 1. Define the region’s function, N/P type and doping strength. 2. Select donors (N-type, extra electrons) or acceptors (P-type, holes). 3. Set chemical concentration and spatial profile, including surface peak, junction depth and lateral extent. 4. Introduce dopants by implantation/diffusion and activate them by annealing. 5. Electrically verify conductivity type and doping strength against the design.

body.zh: 控制杂质种类、化学浓度、净有效掺杂和空间分布。杂质种类决定导电类型并影响激活；化学浓度是工艺引入的杂质总量分布；净有效掺杂考虑激活与补偿后的电学有效浓度。净有效掺杂 = 施主贡献 − 受主贡献。
body.en: Control impurity species, chemical concentration, net effective doping and spatial profile. Species determines type and affects activation; chemical concentration describes total introduced dopants; net effective doping accounts for activation and compensation. Net effective doping = donor contribution − acceptor contribution.

body.zh: 施主与受主可相互补偿，使净有效掺杂降低。未激活杂质使化学浓度与电学结果不同。剖面峰值仅反映局部信息，不能代表整个掺杂区平均浓度。
body.en: Donors and acceptors can compensate and reduce net effective doping. Inactive dopants cause chemical and electrical results to differ. A profile peak is local information and does not represent the entire region’s average concentration.

body.zh: SIMS化学剖面获得化学浓度随深度的分布，验证注入/扩散后的浓度与分布。Hall表征载流子类型、浓度与迁移率，反映电学有效掺杂。适用的电学剖面（如C–V）获得有效掺杂的深度分布。
body.en: SIMS measures chemical concentration versus depth to verify implantation/diffusion profiles. Hall measurements characterize carrier type, concentration and mobility and reflect electrically effective doping. Applicable electrical profiling, such as C–V, obtains effective doping versus depth.

body.zh: 掺杂类型、浓度与分布影响区域电阻、结的位置与特性及器件性能。轻重掺杂没有跨材料、器件的统一阈值，需依材料体系与结构定义。异常时先复测排除误差与样品差异，再检查退火激活、施主/受主补偿，结合SIMS、Hall与电学剖面判断。
body.en: Doping type, concentration and distribution affect regional resistance, junction location/properties and device performance. No universal light/heavy threshold spans all materials and devices. For anomalies, remeasure to exclude measurement/sample differences; check anneal activation and compensation, then compare SIMS, Hall and electrical profiles.

title.zh: 导电差异：浓度与迁移率一起决定电阻
title.en: Conductivity: concentration and mobility jointly determine resistance

subtitle.zh: 载流子数量与运动能力共同作用
subtitle.en: Carrier number and transport ability work together

body.zh: 重掺杂通常降低电阻率，但增益并非简单线性。σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ)。重掺杂引入更多载流子，载流子浓度通常增加；掺杂引入的杂质散射会影响载流子迁移率。
body.en: Heavy doping usually reduces resistivity, but the improvement is not simply linear. σ = q(nμₙ + pμₚ). Heavy doping introduces more carriers and generally increases their concentration, while impurity scattering affects carrier mobility.

body.zh: 流程：电阻目标 → 有效浓度 → 评估迁移率 → 结构电阻 → 量测验证。关键控制为有效载流子浓度、迁移率、层厚和温度。
body.en: Flow: resistance target → effective concentration → mobility evaluation → structural resistance → measurement verification. Control effective carrier concentration, mobility, layer thickness and temperature.

body.zh: 浓度升高伴随杂质散射增强；激活不足、厚度偏差或不均匀可导致电阻异常。
body.en: Increasing concentration strengthens impurity scattering. Insufficient activation, thickness deviation or nonuniformity can cause resistance anomalies.

body.zh: 通过四探针量测片电阻与片内分布，并结合厚度与Hall量测。异常先复测，并检查工艺。
body.en: Measure sheet resistance and within-wafer distribution using four-point probing, together with thickness and Hall measurements. Remeasure anomalies and inspect the process.

body.zh: 影响压降、发热和串联电阻。片电阻不等于电阻率，非均匀层不能直接套用均匀层换算。图中标注压降、发热、串联电阻及Hall磁场B。
body.en: These factors affect voltage drop, heating and series resistance. Sheet resistance is not resistivity, and uniform-layer conversions cannot be directly applied to nonuniform layers. Diagram labels include voltage drop, heating, series resistance and Hall magnetic field B.

title.zh: 电场分布：轻掺杂侧承担更多耗尽宽度
title.en: Electric field: more depletion width lies on the lightly doped side

subtitle.zh: 联系耗尽区、电场与耐压
subtitle.en: Connecting depletion, electric field and voltage withstand

body.zh: 简单突变PN结近似下，耗尽区更多伸入轻掺杂侧。图中重掺杂P侧中性区以空穴为主，耗尽区为固定负离子，Wₚ较窄；轻掺杂N侧耗尽区为固定正离子，Wₙ较宽，中性区以电子为主。电场幅值|E|随位置变化，在结界面达到峰值，两侧耗尽区边界为零。
body.en: Under a simple abrupt PN-junction approximation, depletion extends farther into the lightly doped side. The heavily doped P side has a hole-dominated neutral region and fixed negative ions in a narrower depletion width Wₚ. The lightly doped N side has fixed positive ions across a wider Wₙ and an electron-dominated neutral region. Field magnitude |E| peaks at the junction and reaches zero at depletion boundaries.

body.zh: 电压目标 → 两侧掺杂 → 耗尽宽度 → 峰值电场 → 击穿与漏电验证。关键控制为有效浓度、掺杂梯度、区域厚度和结边缘几何。
body.en: Voltage target → doping on both sides → depletion width → peak field → breakdown and leakage verification. Control effective concentration, doping gradient, region thickness and junction-edge geometry.

body.zh: 降低浓度有利于承压，却提高电阻；厚度不足、边缘电场集中可引发穿通或提前击穿。
body.en: Lower concentration helps voltage withstand but increases resistance. Insufficient thickness and field crowding at edges can cause punch-through or premature breakdown.

body.zh: 适用条件下使用C–V、I–V和击穿测试；异常检查结边缘、缺陷与剖面。耐压还受终端结构、材料和缺陷影响，以上仅为简单结示意。
body.en: Use C–V, I–V and breakdown testing where applicable; inspect junction edges, defects and profiles for anomalies. Voltage withstand also depends on termination, material and defects; this is only a simple-junction illustration.

uncertain: 原图右下方水印与页底图文区域重叠；保留完整图表时不能仅靠矩形裁剪无损去除，未猜补被覆盖像素。 / The lower-right watermark overlaps the lower-page content region; a rectangular crop cannot remove it while preserving every diagram. Covered pixels have not been reconstructed.

title.zh: 器件分工：轻重掺杂在不同位置协作
title.en: Device regions: light and heavy doping cooperate

subtitle.zh: 源漏、扩展区与漂移区各有职责
subtitle.en: Source/drain, extensions and drift regions have different roles

body.zh: 掺杂浓度服务于区域职责，不能整颗器件统一重掺杂。传统平面NMOS图以P型衬底为基础，包括n⁺源区、n⁺漏区、较轻n型扩展区、P型沟道区、栅氧、栅极和源漏电极。
body.en: Doping concentration serves the region’s function; an entire device cannot simply be heavily doped uniformly. The conventional planar NMOS diagram shows a P-type substrate, n⁺ source/drain, lighter n-type extensions, a P-type channel region, gate oxide, gate and source/drain electrodes.

body.zh: 功率器件图从上到下为金属电极、p⁺阳极区、n⁻较轻掺杂漂移区、n⁺重掺杂衬底、金属电极；仅示意区域职责，不是完整终端结构。
body.en: The power-device diagram shows, top to bottom, metal electrode, p⁺ anode, n⁻ lightly doped drift region, n⁺ heavily doped substrate and metal electrode. It illustrates regional roles, not a complete termination structure.

body.zh: 划分功能区 → 电阻与电场目标 → 分区掺杂 → 热处理整合 → 器件验证。控制区域位置、浓度梯度、横向尺寸和结深。
body.en: Define functional regions → resistance/field targets → regional doping → thermal integration → device verification. Control region position, concentration gradient, lateral dimensions and junction depth.

body.zh: 较轻扩展区缓和局部电场，但增加串联电阻。错位、横向扩散和梯度偏差会破坏设计。以剖面表征、器件I–V、漏电与可靠性量测联合定位空间分布问题。
body.en: Lighter extensions reduce local field but increase series resistance. Misalignment, lateral diffusion and gradient errors compromise the design. Combine profile characterization, device I–V, leakage and reliability measurements to locate spatial-distribution problems.

body.zh: 掺杂分工影响驱动、热载流子风险及耐压。传统平面MOS示例不代表所有FinFET、GAA或功率结构。
body.en: Regional doping affects drive, hot-carrier risk and voltage withstand. This conventional planar MOS example does not represent all FinFET, GAA or power structures.

title.zh: 剂量与浓度：注入剂量不是最终浓度
title.en: Dose versus concentration: implant dose is not final concentration

subtitle.zh: 总量、深度与热处理共同塑造分布
subtitle.en: Amount, depth and thermal treatment jointly shape the profile

body.zh: 剂量通常用cm⁻²，浓度通常用cm⁻³。相同剂量可以有不同深度分布：较浅的紫色分布与较深的橙色分布，浓度—深度曲线下面积近似相同。注入示意包括离子束、掩膜、开口与晶圆。
body.en: Dose is usually expressed in cm⁻² and concentration in cm⁻³. The same dose can produce different depth distributions: the shallower purple and deeper orange concentration–depth curves have approximately equal areas. The implantation diagram labels the ion beam, mask, openings and wafer.

body.zh: 1. 掩膜与表面。2. 选择离子（图示B、P、As）。3. 设定剂量、能量和入射角θ。4. 注入。5. 去掩膜、热处理与验证。
body.en: 1. Prepare mask and surface. 2. Select ions (B, P and As illustrated). 3. Set dose, energy and incidence angle θ. 4. Implant. 5. Remove the mask, thermally process and verify.

body.zh: 控制剂量、能量、入射角和掩膜阻挡能力。能量改变深度，剂量影响总量；沟道效应、掩膜不足、充电和损伤可使结果偏离目标。
body.en: Control dose, energy, incidence angle and mask stopping capability. Energy changes depth; dose changes total amount. Channeling, inadequate masking, charging and damage can shift results away from the target.

body.zh: 使用SIMS化学剖面与退火后片电阻；异常检查束流记录、掩膜与热处理。结果影响结深、激活及漏电。不同离子与材料射程不同，扩散与原位掺杂另设控制逻辑。
body.en: Use SIMS chemical profiles and post-anneal sheet resistance. For anomalies, inspect beam records, masking and thermal treatment. Results affect junction depth, activation and leakage. Ion ranges depend on species and material; diffusion and in-situ doping require their own control logic.

title.zh: 激活与退火：掺入的原子不都贡献载流子
title.en: Activation and annealing: not every dopant contributes carriers

subtitle.zh: 管理激活、损伤修复与扩散
subtitle.en: Managing activation, damage repair and diffusion

body.zh: 注入后通常需要热处理促进激活与损伤修复，同时控制再分布。主图从注入损伤晶格，经热处理到修复与替位激活晶格，再到扩散风险定性分布。图例：紫色为掺入原子/替位激活原子，橙色为注入损伤/缺陷，虚线圆为残余缺陷；再分布图标注表面、深度及定性掺杂浓度。
body.en: After implantation, thermal treatment usually promotes activation and damage repair while redistribution must be controlled. The main sequence shows the damaged lattice, thermal treatment, repair/substitutional activation, then qualitative diffusion-risk distribution. Purple denotes dopants/substitutionally active atoms, orange implantation damage/defects, and dashed circles residual defects. The distribution diagram labels surface, depth and qualitative dopant concentration.

body.zh: 表面检查 → 热处理方式 → 升温与热历程 → 冷却 → 化学与电学对比。控制温度历程、时间、气氛和累计热预算。
body.en: Surface inspection → thermal-treatment method → ramp and thermal history → cooling → chemical/electrical comparison. Control temperature history, time, ambient and cumulative thermal budget.

body.zh: 激活修复需要热预算，扩散可能扩大结深。激活不足、残余缺陷、团簇和过度扩散均为风险。
body.en: Activation and repair require thermal budget, while diffusion can deepen junctions. Insufficient activation, residual defects, clustering and excessive diffusion are risks.

body.zh: 结合片电阻、载流子表征及SIMS，必要时补充缺陷分析，不能只凭电阻改变退火条件。退火影响接触、漏电与短沟道控制，依赖元素、浓度、材料及既有结构。
body.en: Combine sheet resistance, carrier characterization and SIMS, adding defect analysis when needed. Do not change annealing solely on resistance results. Annealing affects contacts, leakage and short-channel control and depends on species, concentration, material and existing structures.

title.zh: 风险权衡：降电阻也要守住漏电与可靠性
title.en: Trade-offs: lower resistance while preserving leakage and reliability

subtitle.zh: 同时检查导通、阻断与结构边界
subtitle.en: Check conduction, blocking and structural boundaries together

body.zh: 低电阻只是目标之一，需与漏电、击穿、结位置及可靠性共同验收。电阻（导通）、耐压（阻断）、漏电（可靠性）需要三方权衡。高浓度与陡峭结可能增强局部电场和隧穿风险；损伤和缺陷也会增加漏电，不能全部归因于浓度。
body.en: Low resistance is only one goal and must be accepted together with leakage, breakdown, junction position and reliability. Balance resistance (conduction), voltage withstand (blocking), and leakage (reliability). High concentration and abrupt junctions can enhance local fields and tunneling risk. Damage and defects also increase leakage, so concentration is not the only cause.

heading.en: From targets to an acceptable window

body.zh: 1. 列出低电阻、低漏电、高耐压与可靠性目标。2. 调整关键工艺，进行工艺分裂实验。3. 查看电性分布与电阻变化。4. 评估器件电性与可靠性，包括正向导通和反向阻断。5. 在多项指标下确定可接受窗口，图示漏电—电阻窗口。
body.en: 1. List low-resistance, low-leakage, high-voltage and reliability targets. 2. Adjust key processes in split experiments. 3. Inspect electrical distributions and resistance changes. 4. Evaluate device electrical performance and reliability, including forward conduction and reverse blocking. 5. Establish an acceptable window across metrics, illustrated by a leakage–resistance window.

body.zh: 关键控制为串联电阻、反向漏电、击穿电压、结深与梯度。量测包括片电阻图、SIMS浓度—深度剖面、I–V测试与可靠性测试。异常处理流程：发现异常 → hold（暂扣）→ 复测 → 根因分析。
body.en: Control series resistance, reverse leakage, breakdown voltage, junction depth and gradient. Measurements include sheet-resistance maps, SIMS concentration–depth profiles, I–V and reliability tests. Anomaly handling: detect → hold → remeasure → root-cause analysis.

body.zh: 这些权衡影响良率、功耗与寿命。趋势需在可比结构、温度及测试条件下解释。
body.en: These trade-offs affect yield, power and lifetime. Interpret trends under comparable structures, temperatures and test conditions.

title.zh: 工艺选择：按职责选轻重，按结构选路线
title.en: Process choice: choose doping strength by function and route by structure

subtitle.zh: 目标分布、实施方法与验收指标对应
subtitle.en: Align target profiles, implementation and acceptance metrics

body.zh: 先明确导电、控场或承压职责，再选择浓度与形成方法。离子注入控制剂量与区域，需处理损伤与沟道效应；图示离子束及浓度—深度分布。
body.en: First establish whether the region conducts, controls fields or withstands voltage; then select concentration and formation method. Implantation controls dose and location but requires treatment of damage and channeling. The diagram shows the ion beam and a concentration–depth profile.

body.zh: 扩散依赖杂质源与热历程，关注横向扩散；图示杂质源、高温与浓度—深度分布。原位掺杂外延在生长中形成掺杂层，控制生长、界面与杂质引入；图示含杂质反应气体、掺杂外延层及浓度—深度分布。
body.en: Diffusion depends on the dopant source and thermal history, with attention to lateral diffusion. Its diagram shows the source, high temperature and depth profile. In-situ doped epitaxy forms the doped layer during growth and requires control of growth, interfaces and dopant incorporation; its diagram shows dopant-containing reactant gas, doped epitaxial layer and depth profile.

body.zh: 区域职责 → 目标剖面 → 路线比较 → 热预算与兼容性 → 试片验证。控制浓度与梯度、深度与位置、热预算和均匀性。
body.en: Regional function → target profile → route comparison → thermal budget and compatibility → test-wafer verification. Control concentration/gradient, depth/location, thermal budget and uniformity.

body.zh: 只追求峰值可能忽略接触区、承压区与结边界。路线不匹配会带来剖面或热预算问题。
body.en: Optimizing only the peak can neglect contact regions, voltage-supporting regions and junction boundaries. A mismatched route causes profile or thermal-budget problems.

body.zh: 通过SIMS进行区域规格验收，并以片电阻和器件测试定位异常。重掺杂常服务低阻区，轻掺杂常服务电场或承压设计；必须结合具体结构，不能互换替代。
body.en: Use SIMS for regional specification acceptance and sheet resistance/device tests to locate anomalies. Heavy doping often serves low-resistance regions; light doping often serves field or voltage-support design. Apply these choices to the specific structure; they are not interchangeable.

title.zh: 一张图看懂Deep N-well vs N-well
title.en: Deep N-well versus N-well at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从三阱结构到偏置、隔离与工艺选择
subtitle.en: From triple-well structures to bias, isolation and process choice

body.zh: 分清PMOS体区与局部P阱隔离：PMOS位于N阱，源漏为P⁺并设N阱接触；NMOS位于局部P阱，源漏为N⁺并设P阱接触。深N阱用于隔离局部P阱，外部为P衬底。
body.en: Distinguish the PMOS body from local P-well isolation. PMOS sits in an N-well with P⁺ source/drain and an N-well contact; NMOS sits in a local P-well with N⁺ source/drain and a P-well contact. A deep N-well isolates the local P-well from the P substrate.

body.zh: 底部隔离与侧向闭合缺一不可。截面与顶视图均示意局部P阱被深N阱围合，不能只看一个方向的隔离。
body.en: Both bottom isolation and lateral closure are required. Cross-section and top views show the local P-well enclosed by deep N-well; isolation cannot be judged from one direction alone.

body.zh: 注入与热处理共同形成阱区：光刻掩膜图形 → N型离子注入 → 热处理 → 形成连续阱区。
body.en: Implantation and thermal treatment jointly form wells: lithographic mask pattern → N-type implantation → thermal treatment → continuous well formation.

body.zh: 深度、浓度与电学结果一起看。图示N阱和P阱的掺杂浓度—深度曲线、电学量测对应，以及PN结I–V、C–V特性。
body.en: Evaluate depth, concentration and electrical results together. The diagrams show N/P-well concentration–depth curves, corresponding electrical measurements and PN-junction I–V/C–V characteristics.

body.zh: 隔离结构仍需要正确电连接：N⁺接触连接N型阱节点，P⁺接触分别连接局部P阱节点与P型衬底节点。
body.en: Isolation still requires correct connections: N⁺ contacts connect the N-type well node; separate P⁺ contacts connect the local P-well and P-substrate nodes.

body.zh: 隔离收益取决于频段与耦合路径。数字电路噪声源可通过结电容Cⱼ与衬底电阻耦合到模拟/射频受扰电路。
body.en: Isolation benefit depends on frequency band and coupling path. A digital noise source can couple through junction capacitance Cⱼ and substrate resistance to a sensitive analog/RF circuit.

body.zh: 深N阱不能代替护环和可靠性验证。图示VDD、VSS、护环接触，以及N阱/P阱/深N阱/P衬底中的寄生PNP和寄生NPN路径。
body.en: Deep N-well does not replace guard rings and reliability verification. The diagram labels VDD, VSS, guard-ring contact and parasitic PNP/NPN paths through the N-well, P-well, deep N-well and substrate.

body.zh: 按器件、隔离需求和平台能力，在标准N阱、评估三阱及联合隔离设计之间选择，并通过规则、模型与硅后验证。
body.en: Choose standard N-well, triple-well evaluation or combined isolation design according to device, isolation needs and platform capability, with rules, models and post-silicon verification.

title.zh: 结构定位：先分清体区与隔离
title.en: Structure: distinguish body regions from isolation first

subtitle.zh: P型衬底、N阱、局部P阱与器件位置
subtitle.en: P substrate, N-well, local P-well and device placement

body.zh: 常见体硅CMOS中，N-well常用于PMOS体区；Deep N-well可帮助隔离局部P-well，二者可以配合使用。PMOS位于N阱，具P⁺源极、栅极、P⁺漏极，N⁺阱接触接高电位。NMOS位于局部P阱，具N⁺源极、栅极、N⁺漏极，P⁺阱接触接低电位；外围深N阱用于隔离，其N⁺深阱接触接高电位。全局衬底为P型。结构为示意，非比例图。
body.en: In common bulk CMOS, N-well often provides the PMOS body, while deep N-well can isolate a local P-well; the two can be used together. PMOS in N-well has P⁺ source/drain, a gate and an N⁺ well contact at high potential. NMOS in local P-well has N⁺ source/drain, a gate and a P⁺ well contact at low potential; the enclosing deep N-well provides isolation and has an N⁺ contact at high potential. The global substrate is P-type. The diagram is not to scale.

body.zh: 器件与平台选择阶段先确定晶体管体区，再定义隔离需求。流程：确认衬底类型 → 找源漏与体区 → 标出N阱/P阱 → 判断是否有深N阱 → 核对器件及体端模型。控制衬底类型、器件体区、隔离边界与体端连接。
body.en: During device/platform selection, determine transistor bodies before defining isolation needs. Identify substrate type → find source/drain and body → label N/P wells → determine whether a deep N-well exists → verify device and body-terminal models. Control substrate type, body region, isolation boundary and body connection.

body.zh: 增加隔离结构支持更独立的体区管理，也增加版图空间与寄生网络。常见错误是把NMOS直接画在N型体区、选错器件模型、把局部P阱与全局衬底误当成同一节点。
body.en: Additional isolation enables more independent body management but increases layout area and parasitic networks. Common errors are placing NMOS directly in an N-type body, choosing the wrong model, or treating local P-well and global substrate as the same node.

body.zh: 设计端核对提取网络与模型端口；硅后比较体端相关I–V与漏电，异常时复核结构和连接。结构选择决定成阱整合、接触布局与偏置验证要求。本页限于常见P型衬底体硅CMOS，不能将同名DNW直接推广到所有高压、传感器或SOI结构。
body.en: Verify extracted networks and model ports in design; compare body-related I–V and leakage after fabrication and revisit structures/connections if abnormal. Structure choice determines well integration, contact layout and bias verification. This page covers common P-substrate bulk CMOS; the term DNW must not be generalized to all high-voltage, sensor or SOI structures.

title.zh: 三阱隔离：底部与侧边都要闭合
title.en: Triple-well isolation: close both bottom and sides

subtitle.zh: 深部N型区域、侧向边界与PN结隔离
subtitle.en: Deep N-type region, lateral boundaries and PN-junction isolation

body.zh: 局部P阱与P型衬底分开，既要有深部N型区域，也要有完整侧向隔离与正确偏置。横截面标注局部P阱、N型隔离区域（深N阱）、N型侧向连接、N⁺深N阱接触及P型衬底；俯视图中N型围合区域由深N阱加侧向N阱组成，围住局部P阱并设N⁺接触。
body.en: Separating a local P-well from the P substrate requires a deep N-type region, complete lateral isolation and correct bias. The cross-section labels local P-well, deep N-well isolation, lateral N-type connections, N⁺ deep-well contacts and P substrate. In top view, deep N-well plus lateral N-well encloses the local P-well and includes N⁺ contacts.

body.zh: 在结构及版图定义阶段，将隔离目标落实为可制造、可接触的阱区。圈定局部P阱 → 检查深部隔离 → 检查侧向闭合 → 核对包围及间距 → 提取阱区网络。控制底部与侧向连续性、掩膜包围关系、阱间距和接触可达性。
body.en: During structure/layout definition, realize isolation as manufacturable, contactable wells. Define local P-well → check deep isolation → check lateral closure → verify enclosure/spacing → extract well network. Control bottom/lateral continuity, mask enclosure, well spacing and contact accessibility.

body.zh: 放大隔离区域可能增加布局余量，也增加面积及相关结寄生，不能靠扩大DNW图形替代规则检查。常见失效：包围不足、非预期阱区连通、把截面闭合误当成整个平面均已闭合。
body.en: Larger isolation regions may add layout margin but also area and junction parasitics. Enlarging DNW shapes does not replace rule checks. Common failures include inadequate enclosure, unintended well connectivity and assuming a closed cross-section proves closure across the entire plane.

body.zh: 版图用DRC与LVS核对几何及网络；硅后以隔离测试结构检查结漏电，异常后复核边界与工艺实现。这影响局部体区能否按设计偏置，以及后续噪声耦合路径。本页以深N阱配合侧向N阱围合为例，实际掩膜组合、包围方向和连接关系以所用PDK为准。
body.en: Use DRC/LVS to check layout geometry and networks. After fabrication, use isolation test structures for junction leakage and review boundaries/process realization after anomalies. This affects intended local-body bias and later noise-coupling paths. Deep N-well plus lateral N-well is an example; actual masks, enclosure directions and connections follow the applicable PDK.

title.zh: 成阱工艺：靠掺杂形成阱区
title.en: Well formation: wells are formed by doping

subtitle.zh: 掩膜、注入能量、剂量与热预算
subtitle.en: Masks, implantation energy, dose and thermal budget

body.zh: 阱是硅中的掺杂区域；深部掺杂需要匹配的注入与热处理，不能理解为刻蚀后填出的深坑。代表流程：在P型硅衬底定义阱掩膜 → 代表性离子注入（仅进入开口区）→ 去除适用掩膜并清洗 → 按流程热处理 → 检查监控结构。N阱为N型掺杂区、用于PMOS体；P阱为P型掺杂区、用于NMOS体。
body.en: Wells are doped regions in silicon. Deep doping requires matched implantation and thermal treatment; it is not an etched pit that is later filled. Representative flow: define well masks on P-type silicon → representative implantation through openings only → remove applicable masks and clean → specified thermal treatment → inspect monitor structures. N-wells are N-doped PMOS bodies; P-wells are P-doped NMOS bodies.

body.zh: 属于前道阱形成模块，建立后续器件所需的掺杂与隔离基础。控制能量/离子种类、剂量、入射角与掩膜阻挡能力、累计热预算。
body.en: This front-end well-formation module establishes doping and isolation for subsequent devices. Control energy/species, dose, incidence angle, mask stopping capability and cumulative thermal budget.

body.zh: 实现更深分布时，仍需控制注入损伤、沟道效应与横向分布；热处理兼顾激活、损伤修复和掺杂再分布。常见失效是剂量或能量偏移、掩膜阻挡不足、沟道效应尾部异常、热处理后分布偏离目标。
body.en: Deeper profiles still require control of implantation damage, channeling and lateral distribution. Thermal treatment balances activation, damage repair and redistribution. Failures include dose/energy shifts, insufficient masking, channeling tails and post-thermal profiles off target.

body.zh: 结合设备记录、SIMS深度剖面、对应监控结构电阻及片内/片间均匀性，确认偏差后再复测或排查工序。影响阱连接、结特性及后续器件电学表现。可采用多次、多能量注入；N阱、P阱、深N阱与隔离模块顺序随平台变化，不能概括成单次注入配方。
body.en: Combine equipment records, SIMS depth profiles, monitor-structure resistance and within-/between-wafer uniformity. Confirm deviations before remeasurement or process troubleshooting. Well formation affects connectivity, junction properties and device electrical performance. Multiple implants and energies may be used; N-well, P-well, deep N-well and isolation sequencing varies by platform and is not a universal single-implant recipe.

title.zh: 掺杂剖面：剂量不等于有效浓度
title.en: Doping profiles: dose is not effective concentration

subtitle.zh: 总掺杂、有效载流子、结位置与阱电阻
subtitle.en: Total doping, effective carriers, junction position and well resistance

body.zh: 化学剖面（SIMS）检查元素浓度（总掺杂）随深度（从表面向下）的分布，不等于有效载流子。原图蓝线标“N元素（如P、As）”，紫线标“P元素（如B）”。电学分布/电阻由四探针电阻量测或SCM获取，反映有效净掺杂与电学结果；结构标N阱（PMOS体底）、P阱（NMOS体底）、P型衬底。
body.en: Chemical profiling (SIMS) measures elemental concentration (total doping) versus depth from the surface; it is not effective carrier concentration. The original labels the blue curve “N element (e.g. P, As)” and purple curve “P element (e.g. B).” Four-point resistance or SCM provides electrical distribution/resistance, reflecting net effective doping and electrical results. The structure labels N-well (PMOS body), P-well (NMOS body) and P substrate.

body.zh: 结特性I–V显示结漏电/击穿，横轴反向偏压、纵轴电流；C–V显示结电容，横轴偏压、纵轴电容。两图均对比局部P阱—Deep N-well与N阱/Deep N-well—P型衬底。
body.en: Junction I–V shows leakage/breakdown, plotting current against reverse bias; C–V plots junction capacitance against bias. Both compare local P-well–deep N-well and N-well/deep N-well–P-substrate junctions.

body.zh: 注入剂量是工艺输入，最终阱特性还取决于深度分布、补偿、激活与热历程。在工艺开发、监控与异常分析阶段，将掺杂分布对应到电学结果：定义目标剖面 → 获取化学深度分布 → 获取电学分布或电阻 → 对照结与器件特性 → 追溯注入及热历程。
body.en: Implant dose is a process input; final well properties also depend on depth distribution, compensation, activation and thermal history. During development, monitoring and failure analysis: define target profile → acquire chemical depth profile → acquire electrical distribution/resistance → compare junction/device properties → trace implantation and thermal history.

body.zh: 控制掺杂峰与尾部、有效净掺杂、结位置、阱电阻及跨片均匀性。降低阱电阻的掺杂调整也改变耗尽区、结电容与电场分布，不能只追求单一电阻指标。常见失效包括剖面位置偏移、非预期补偿、电阻异常、结漏电或击穿不达标。
body.en: Control peaks/tails, effective net doping, junction location, well resistance and across-wafer uniformity. Doping changes that reduce resistance also alter depletion, junction capacitance and fields; do not optimize resistance alone. Failures include shifted profiles, unintended compensation, abnormal resistance and failed leakage/breakdown specifications.

body.zh: SIMS结合适用的SCM、校准后的电阻量测及结I–V/C–V，区分掺杂分布与电学结果。影响体区电位稳定性、隔离结特性与模型校准。SIMS总浓度不直接等于有效净掺杂；单张普通截面SEM不能代替掺杂或载流子分布量测。
body.en: Combine SIMS with applicable SCM, calibrated resistance and junction I–V/C–V to distinguish doping profiles from electrical outcomes. This affects body-potential stability, isolation-junction properties and model calibration. SIMS total concentration does not directly equal effective net doping; a conventional cross-sectional SEM image cannot replace dopant/carrier profiling.

notes.zh: 原图“N元素/P元素”是按N型/P型掺杂用途标记的文字，并非化学元素符号的严谨写法；此处保留原意，避免将N理解为氮、P理解为磷。
notes.en: The original “N element/P element” labels refer to N-/P-type doping roles rather than rigorous elemental notation; do not read N as nitrogen or P as phosphorus in those labels.

title.zh: 偏置接触：阱电位必须接对
title.en: Bias contacts: connect well potentials correctly

subtitle.zh: N阱、局部P阱、深N阱与衬底节点
subtitle.en: N-well, local P-well, deep N-well and substrate nodes

body.zh: N阱与Deep N-well节点通过N⁺接触连接；局部P阱与P型衬底节点分别通过P⁺接触连接。图示硅表面下为连续硅材料。示意等效网络包括N阱/Deep N-well—P型衬底PN结，以及局部P阱—Deep N-well PN结，均有电容。
body.en: N-well and deep N-well nodes connect through N⁺ contacts; local P-well and P-substrate nodes each connect through P⁺ contacts. Silicon beneath the surface is continuous material. The schematic equivalent network includes capacitive N-well/deep-N-well–P-substrate and local-P-well–deep-N-well PN junctions.

body.zh: 形成隔离结构后，仍需为各阱提供合适接触与偏置，并核对所有相关PN结的工作范围。电路—版图整合阶段将体区、深N阱及衬底接到指定偏置网络：列出阱/衬底节点 → 指定允许偏置 → 配置tap与金属 → 检查启动和关断状态 → 验证连接及工作范围。
body.en: After forming isolation, provide appropriate contacts/bias to each well and check every relevant PN-junction operating range. During circuit/layout integration, connect bodies, deep N-wells and substrate to specified bias networks: list nodes → assign allowed bias → configure taps and metal → check startup/shutdown → verify connectivity and operating ranges.

body.zh: 控制节点电位关系、接触与阱路径阻抗、tap分布、供电时序和瞬态电压。增加接触可减小局部阱电位波动但占面积；允许独立引出体端不代表可以任意施加体偏置。失效包括阱悬空、接错电源域、局部压降过大、瞬态造成非预期PN结正向导通。
body.en: Control node potentials, contact/well-path impedance, tap distribution, power sequencing and transient voltages. More contacts reduce local potential variation but consume area; an independently accessible body does not permit arbitrary body bias. Failures include floating wells, wrong power domains, excessive local drop and transient unintended forward-biased PN junctions.

body.zh: 用LVS、ERC及偏置仿真检查连接；硅后验证体端漏电和供电瞬态，异常后复核接触与偏置网络。影响体效应、噪声耦合与可靠性。偏置值按PDK和器件模型确定；某些平台同一DNW内的N阱经DNW连通，不能仅凭版图分开就认为电位独立。
body.en: Use LVS, ERC and bias simulations to check connectivity; verify body leakage and supply transients after fabrication, revisiting contacts/bias networks if abnormal. This affects body effect, noise coupling and reliability. Bias values follow the PDK/device model. In some platforms, N-wells inside one DNW connect through it; separate layout shapes do not prove independent potentials.

notes.zh: PN结等效网络按原图示意保留，仅表达节点之间存在PN结及结电容，不应当作可直接仿真的完整等效电路。
notes.en: The original PN-junction network is retained as a conceptual illustration of junctions and capacitance between nodes, not a complete simulation-ready equivalent circuit.

title.zh: 噪声与寄生：隔离效果要按频段看
title.en: Noise and parasitics: evaluate isolation by frequency band

subtitle.zh: 衬底导电、结电容、阱阻抗与供电耦合
subtitle.en: Substrate conduction, junction capacitance, well impedance and supply coupling

body.zh: 深N阱可改变衬底噪声传播路径，但隔离效果仍受结寄生、偏置网络和工作频段影响。图中数字/开关电路为干扰源，模拟/高精度电路为敏感节点；P型衬底为连续硅体。红色实线路径表示衬底电阻Rsub的导电耦合；蓝色虚线表示PN结电容耦合，包含DNW—P型衬底与局部P阱—DNW的Cⱼ。DNW偏置经Zbias及N⁺接触连接，局部P阱具有P⁺接触。
body.en: Deep N-well changes substrate-noise propagation, but junction parasitics, bias networks and operating frequency still determine isolation. The diagram shows a digital/switching interferer and an analog/high-precision sensitive node in continuous P-type silicon. Red solid arrows denote conduction through substrate resistance Rsub; blue dashed arrows denote capacitive coupling through DNW–substrate and local-P-well–DNW junction capacitances Cⱼ. DNW bias connects through Zbias and an N⁺ contact; local P-well has a P⁺ contact.

body.zh: 在混合信号设计与验证阶段比较目标干扰源到敏感节点的耦合。确定干扰源与敏感节点 → 建立衬底/阱寄生网络 → 加入偏置与互连 → 扫描频率和工作状态 → 用测试结构校准。控制干扰频谱、阱结电容、偏置路径阻抗、接触/护环与布局。
body.en: During mixed-signal design and verification, compare coupling from the target interferer to sensitive nodes. Identify both → build substrate/well parasitic network → add bias/interconnect → sweep frequency/operating state → calibrate using test structures. Control interference spectrum, well-junction capacitance, bias-path impedance and contact/guard-ring layout.

body.zh: 改变隔离区域和接地安排会同时改变导电与电容耦合；隔离放噪声源侧还是敏感侧，需要结合电路验证。常见失效：局部体电位波动、模拟杂散或噪声增大、DNW偏置电源耦入干扰。
body.en: Changing isolation and grounding alters both conductive and capacitive coupling. Whether to isolate the source or the sensitive side requires circuit verification. Failures include local body-potential fluctuations, increased analog spurs/noise and interference coupled through the DNW bias supply.

body.zh: 向规定节点注入已知小信号扰动，量测耦合传递或敏感节点噪声，与模型对照定位主路径。影响混合信号精度、噪声裕量及版图安排。DNW只处理部分耦合路径，不能替代供电、金属布线与封装回流分析；不承诺固定dB收益，也不预设包住模拟电路总是最好。
body.en: Inject a known small-signal perturbation at specified nodes, measure transfer or sensitive-node noise and compare with models to locate dominant paths. This affects mixed-signal accuracy, noise margin and layout. DNW handles only some paths, not supply, metal-routing or package-return analysis. It promises no fixed dB benefit and enclosing the analog block is not assumed always best.

title.zh: 闩锁与可靠性：深N阱不能包办
title.en: Latch-up and reliability: deep N-well is not sufficient

subtitle.zh: 寄生反馈、载流子注入、护环与接触
subtitle.en: Parasitic feedback, carrier injection, guard rings and contacts

body.zh: 图示异常电流注入、P阱内NMOS与寄生NPN、N阱内PMOS与寄生PNP、阱电阻、衬底电阻和寄生正反馈路径。NPN集电极为N阱，PNP集电极为P衬底。P阱、N阱、Deep N-well及衬底接触偏置按PDK，护环按规则连接；寄生路径随结构变化，DNW不能完全切断。
body.en: The diagram shows abnormal current injection, NMOS/parasitic NPN in P-well, PMOS/parasitic PNP in N-well, well/substrate resistance and parasitic positive feedback. The NPN collector is N-well and PNP collector P-substrate. Bias P-well, N-well, DNW and substrate contacts per PDK, and connect guard rings per rules. Parasitic paths vary with structure and DNW does not fully interrupt them.

body.zh: 闩锁由寄生器件正反馈触发，可能产生持续异常电流与局部发热。ESD是静电放电导致的大电流注入，可能触发闩锁或损伤器件。结击穿由PN结反向偏置过高引起，是不同失效机理。
body.en: Latch-up is triggered by parasitic positive feedback and can produce sustained abnormal current and local heating. ESD injects large current from electrostatic discharge and can trigger latch-up or damage. Junction breakdown results from excessive reverse PN bias and is a different mechanism.

body.zh: 闩锁与寄生器件、电阻路径和触发条件有关；采用深N阱后仍需执行适用的接触、间距、护环及可靠性要求。在版图签核与硅后鉴定阶段：识别可能注入源 → 检查接触/护环/间距 → 分析偏置及寄生路径 → 按规范施加应力并监测 → 异常隔离及根因分析。
body.en: Latch-up depends on parasitic devices, resistive paths and triggering. Deep N-well does not remove applicable contact, spacing, guard-ring and reliability requirements. At layout signoff/post-silicon qualification: identify injection sources → check contacts/rings/spacing → analyze bias/parasitic paths → apply specified stress and monitor → isolate anomalies and analyze root causes.

body.zh: 控制注入位置与条件、阱/衬底路径电阻、护环及tap分布、供电和温度。增加接触、间距或护环占面积，有效性仍取决于其他连接及实际载流子收集路径。常见失效为持续异常电流、局部发热、应力后漏电增加或功能失效。
body.en: Control injection location/conditions, well/substrate-path resistance, guard-ring/tap distribution, supply and temperature. Extra contacts, spacing or rings consume area and work only in conjunction with other connections and actual carrier-collection paths. Failures include sustained abnormal current, heating, post-stress leakage or functional failure.

body.zh: 按规定鉴定条件监测应力期间与之后的供电电流、漏电和功能，结合失效分析定位寄生路径；不能仅凭电流突增认定闩锁。影响可靠性放行及异常条件下功能保持。DNW不是“免闩锁”证明，闩锁、ESD和结击穿需分别验证。
body.en: Monitor supply current, leakage and function during/after stress under specified qualification conditions; use failure analysis to locate paths. A current spike alone does not establish latch-up. This affects reliability release and function under abnormal conditions. DNW does not certify latch-up immunity; verify latch-up, ESD and junction breakdown separately.

title.zh: 工艺选择：按需求与平台能力选
title.en: Process selection: match requirements and platform capability

subtitle.zh: 器件体区、局部隔离、允许偏置与实现代价
subtitle.en: Device bodies, local isolation, allowed bias and implementation cost

heading.en: Three tasks and the verification chain

body.zh: 常规PMOS体区：采用平台支持的标准N阱，配置正确体接触。局部P阱隔离或受控体偏置：评估深N阱/三阱选项，核对侧向闭合和偏置范围。噪声敏感混合信号模块：联合评估隔离位置、接触护环、供电和布线，再比较完整电路表现。
body.en: Conventional PMOS body: use a supported standard N-well and correct body contacts. Local P-well isolation/controlled body bias: assess DNW/triple-well options and check lateral closure and bias range. Noise-sensitive mixed-signal blocks: jointly assess isolation location, contacts/guard rings, supply and routing, then compare complete-circuit performance.

body.zh: 验证链：PDK器件与规则 → 器件/寄生模型 → 隔离/偏置/护环版图方案 → 器件/耦合/可靠性测试。标准N阱、三阱评估和联合隔离设计都需要规则、模型与硅后验证。
body.en: Verification chain: PDK devices/rules → device/parasitic models → isolation/bias/guard-ring layout → device/coupling/reliability tests. Standard N-well, triple-well and combined isolation all require rules, models and post-silicon verification.

body.zh: N阱与深N阱职责有交集也有差异，先看器件和隔离目标，再看PDK允许实现。在平台及架构选型阶段：明确器件与体区 → 列出隔离及偏置需求 → 核对PDK器件和规则 → 评估寄生/面积/平台代价 → 完成仿真与测试验证。约束为模型及器件支持、允许偏置、目标隔离指标、面积与平台成本。
body.en: N-well and deep N-well roles overlap but differ. Start with device/isolation goals, then permitted PDK implementations. During platform/architecture selection: define devices/bodies → list isolation/bias needs → check PDK devices/rules → evaluate parasitics/area/platform cost → simulate and test. Constraints include model/device support, permitted bias, isolation targets, area and platform cost.

body.zh: DNW可能增加制造或版图代价，收益不足时不能只因名字更“深”就选用，也不能只凭面积判断隔离够用。用目标工作条件下器件电学、耦合测试和可靠性结果校准选择，检查规则与模型是否同时满足。选型约束后续版图、偏置与验证；设计端使用PDK批准结构，工艺端控制掺杂剖面，不能混淆两者可调项。
body.en: DNW can add fabrication/layout cost; do not select it merely because it is “deeper,” or judge isolation adequacy by area alone. Calibrate choices using device electrical, coupling and reliability results at target conditions, checking both rules and models. Selection constrains layout, bias and verification. Designers use PDK-approved structures; process engineers control dopant profiles—these adjustment spaces are distinct.

title.zh: 一张图看懂TSV vs TGV
title.en: TSV versus TGV at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从材料、制孔到金属化与工艺选择
subtitle.en: From materials and hole formation to metallization and process selection

body.zh: 先看通孔在哪一层、连接哪两面。TSV是硅通孔，TGV是玻璃通孔。
body.en: First identify the layer containing the via and the two surfaces it connects. TSV means through-silicon via; TGV means through-glass via.

body.zh: 硅与玻璃的材料差异影响寄生参数（图示R、C）、热变形和加工窗口。
body.en: Differences between silicon and glass affect parasitics (R and C illustrated), thermal deformation and the processing window.

body.zh: 成孔方法影响侧壁与后续覆盖。图示硅采用深硅刻蚀，玻璃采用激光改性后选择性湿刻。
body.en: Hole formation affects sidewalls and subsequent coverage. The diagrams show deep-silicon etching for silicon and laser modification followed by selective wet etching for glass.

body.zh: 绝缘、附着和阻挡各有职责。硅侧图强调电隔离，玻璃侧图强调附着/阻挡。
body.en: Insulation, adhesion and barrier layers have distinct roles. The silicon diagram emphasizes electrical isolation, while the glass diagram emphasizes adhesion/barrier functions.

body.zh: 种子层连续性与镀铜结构共同决定导通。图示全填铜、孔壁镀铜及种子连续性。
body.en: Seed continuity and plated-copper structure jointly determine conduction. The diagrams show full copper filling, wall plating and seed continuity.

body.zh: 通孔接上RDL才形成完整链路。图示TSV+RDL与TGV+RDL。
body.en: A via forms a complete link only when connected to redistribution layers (RDL). The diagrams show TSV+RDL and TGV+RDL.

body.zh: 铜与基材热失配考验长期可靠性，可能出现孔边裂纹、界面脱层与铜突出。
body.en: Thermal mismatch between copper and substrate challenges long-term reliability, with risks of via-edge cracks, interface delamination and copper protrusion.

body.zh: 同层级、同任务下再比较性能与成本。图示芯片内TSV、中介层同层比较、玻璃芯基板TGV，并进行共同验证。
body.en: Compare performance and cost only at the same hierarchy and task. The diagrams distinguish chip TSV, same-level interposer comparison and glass-core-substrate TGV, followed by common verification.

title.zh: 结构定位：先看通孔在哪一层
title.en: Structural location: first identify the via’s layer

subtitle.zh: 芯片、中介层、封装基板，先分层再比较
subtitle.en: Distinguish chip, interposer and package substrate before comparing

body.zh: TSV贯穿硅，TGV贯穿玻璃；能否替代取决于层级与连接任务。图示芯片内TSV（含TSV的硅芯片）、硅中介层TSV（含TSV的硅中介层）、玻璃层TGV（含TGV的玻璃基板）。这是层级示意，并非具体产品。
body.en: TSV passes through silicon and TGV through glass; substitutability depends on hierarchy and connection task. The illustration separates TSV in silicon chips, TSV in silicon interposers and TGV in glass substrates. It represents hierarchy, not a specific product.

body.zh: 封装架构定义阶段，明确通孔连接的上下端点，再交给基材、孔与布线设计并进入后续工艺。辨认流程：标出芯片/中介层/基板 → 找上下端点 → 确认贯穿材料 → 区分信号/电源/地 → 核对横向布线。
body.en: At package architecture definition, establish the upper/lower endpoints, then pass requirements to substrate, via and routing design before subsequent processing. Identify chip/interposer/substrate → locate endpoints → confirm traversed material → distinguish signal/power/ground → check lateral routing.

body.zh: 控制封装层级、端点间距、互连长度和横向布线密度。缩短垂直路径可能需要更薄基材，也增加搬运和后续加工难度。接口错位会开路；回流路径安排不当会导致串扰或链路劣化。
body.en: Control package hierarchy, endpoint spacing, interconnect length and lateral-routing density. Shorter vertical paths may require thinner substrates and more difficult handling/processing. Misaligned interfaces cause opens; poor return-path arrangement causes crosstalk or link degradation.

body.zh: 用截面确认层级和接续位置，结合导通检测核对完整路径；异常后复核接口与布线设计。架构决定制孔、RDL（重布线层）及组装接口要求。HBM内部硅芯片TSV不等同于玻璃芯基板TGV；同一封装可以在不同层级同时使用二者。
body.en: Verify hierarchy and junction positions in cross-section, and check complete paths with continuity tests; review interfaces/routing after anomalies. Architecture sets via, RDL and assembly-interface requirements. HBM’s internal silicon-chip TSV is not equivalent to glass-core-substrate TGV; one package can use both at different levels.

title.zh: 基材差异：绝缘优势也有边界
title.en: Substrate differences: insulation benefits have limits

subtitle.zh: 电介质特性、寄生参数与热变形
subtitle.en: Dielectric properties, parasitics and thermal deformation

body.zh: 玻璃本体绝缘，有利于减少衬底导电相关损耗；整条互连电容、损耗和串扰仍须按结构验证。TSV图含RDL、硅衬底和TSV；TGV图含RDL、玻璃基材和TGV。简化寄生电路仅为R（电阻）、C（电容）的概念图；完整链路包含孔、RDL和回流路径，橙色为信号路径，蓝色为回流路径。
body.en: Bulk glass is insulating and can reduce substrate-conduction losses, but complete-link capacitance, loss and crosstalk still require structural verification. TSV and TGV diagrams each label RDL, substrate and via. The R/C parasitic circuit is conceptual. The complete link includes via, RDL and return path; orange marks the signal and blue the return.

body.zh: 架构确定后选择基材，为孔、RDL与封装设计提供材料输入。明确频段和负载 → 确认材料特性 → 提取孔与RDL寄生 → 联合电热评估 → 用测试结构校准。
body.en: Select the substrate after architecture definition to supply material inputs for via, RDL and packaging design. Define frequency/load → confirm material properties → extract via/RDL parasitics → jointly evaluate electrical/thermal behavior → calibrate using test structures.

body.zh: 控制硅电阻率/玻璃介电特性、工作频段、热膨胀系数CTE、基材厚度和平整度。调整玻璃配方改变CTE，也可能改变介电与加工特性，不能分开选择指标。失效包括插入损耗超标、串扰增大、热变形影响接续。
body.en: Control silicon resistivity/glass dielectric properties, frequency, coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), substrate thickness and flatness. A glass formulation change to modify CTE can also change dielectric and processing properties; these cannot be chosen independently. Failures include excessive insertion loss, crosstalk and thermally distorted connections.

body.zh: 用矢量网络分析仪测链路S参数，结合材料表征与温变形测量校准模型。材料选择改变布线、接地、散热和工艺温度安排。不同玻璃及不同电阻率硅表现不同；玻璃不代表零电容，低损耗也不自动保证更好散热。
body.en: Measure link S-parameters with a vector network analyzer and calibrate using material and thermal-deformation characterization. Material choice changes routing, grounding, heat dissipation and process-temperature planning. Glass types and silicon resistivities differ; glass does not mean zero capacitance, and low electrical loss does not automatically ensure better cooling.

title.zh: 制孔路线：孔形会传到下一站
title.en: Hole formation: geometry carries into the next process

subtitle.zh: 孔径、锥度、深宽比与侧壁完整性
subtitle.en: Diameter, taper, aspect ratio and sidewall integrity

body.zh: 制孔不仅要达到目标深度，还需为后续薄膜覆盖与金属化留下可用孔形。深硅刻蚀DRIE图示掩膜、硅基材与硅盲孔。玻璃路线为激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀：激光使内部结构改变，改性区仍是玻璃、尚未去除；随后选择性湿刻去除改性区形成通孔。
body.en: Hole formation must meet depth targets and leave usable geometry for film coverage and metallization. The DRIE diagram labels mask, silicon substrate and silicon blind via. In glass, laser modification changes internal structure without removing the glass; selective wet etching then removes the modified region to form a through-hole.

body.zh: 制孔模块接收基材，输出合格孔结构供界面处理。TSV代表流程：掩膜定义 → 深硅刻蚀DRIE → 去掩膜/残留 → 清洗 → 孔形检查。TGV代表流程：玻璃与孔位确认 → 激光改性 → 选择性湿法刻蚀成孔 → 清洗干燥 → 孔形检查。
body.en: The via module receives substrates and delivers qualified holes for interface treatment. Representative TSV flow: mask definition → DRIE → mask/residue removal → cleaning → geometry inspection. TGV flow: confirm glass/locations → laser modification → selective wet etching → clean/dry → geometry inspection.

body.zh: 控制孔径及锥度、深宽比、侧壁粗糙度、损伤和裂纹范围。更高深宽比提高覆盖与传质难度；增加去除量可能改变孔口与侧壁尺寸。失效包括未贯通或深度不足、侧壁异常、崩边与微裂纹。
body.en: Control diameter/taper, aspect ratio, sidewall roughness and damage/crack extent. Higher aspect ratio complicates coverage and mass transport; more removal can alter mouth/sidewall dimensions. Failures include incomplete penetration/depth, abnormal sidewalls, chipping and microcracks.

body.zh: 用孔口与适用孔出口光学量测、截面SEM检查轮廓，按位置统计偏差并复核制孔条件。孔形异常会造成种子断点、镀铜空洞或界面应力集中。TSV可先做盲孔、后经减薄露出；TGV还存在其他激光或蚀刻路线，并非均采用此改性湿刻流程。
body.en: Use optical measurements at mouths/applicable exits and cross-sectional SEM for profiles; map deviations by location and review conditions. Bad geometry can cause seed breaks, plating voids or stress concentration. TSV may start as a blind via revealed by thinning. TGV has other laser/etch routes and does not always use modification plus wet etching.

title.zh: 绝缘界面：绝缘和附着是两回事
title.en: Interfaces: insulation and adhesion are different functions

subtitle.zh: 电隔离、金属附着、扩散控制与缓冲
subtitle.en: Electrical isolation, metal adhesion, diffusion control and buffering

body.zh: 铜TSV通常需要铜与硅之间的介电隔离；玻璃自身绝缘，仍需解决金属附着及按需配置的阻挡/缓冲功能。硅基TSV半剖面标铜、电隔离、硅；玻璃基TGV半剖面标铜、附着/阻挡等按需配置、玻璃。
body.en: Copper TSV usually requires dielectric isolation between copper and silicon. Glass is inherently insulating but still needs metal adhesion and applicable barrier/buffer functions. The TSV half-section labels copper, electrical isolation and silicon; the TGV half-section labels copper, optional adhesion/barrier functions and glass.

body.zh: 制孔与清洗后建立孔壁功能层，为种子层及镀铜提供界面。去残留 → 表面处理 → 按堆栈形成所需功能层 → 检查覆盖与界面 → 转入种子层工序。
body.en: After hole formation/cleaning, establish functional sidewall layers for seed deposition and copper plating. Remove residue → treat surface → form required stack layers → inspect coverage/interfaces → proceed to seed processing.

body.zh: 控制最薄处膜厚、附着强度、电隔离能力与热预算。增加隔离层厚度占用孔内空间；改善附着的表面处理也要控制粗糙度和损伤。常见失效为隔离层针孔或击穿、界面脱层、扩散控制不足。
body.en: Control minimum film thickness, adhesion strength, electrical isolation and thermal budget. Thicker isolation consumes via space; adhesion-enhancing treatments must control roughness/damage. Common failures are dielectric pinholes/breakdown, delamination and inadequate diffusion control.

body.zh: 适当截面分析检查孔口、孔壁及底部/出口，结合漏电与附着测试，判断能否进入镀铜。界面缺陷会导致镀层剥离、漏电或后续可靠性失效。绝缘层、粘附层、阻挡层职责不同；材料与层数按基材及整合路线确定，部分功能可由同一层承担。
body.en: Inspect mouths, walls and bottoms/exits with suitable cross-sectional analysis; combine leakage and adhesion tests before plating. Interface defects can cause plating peel, leakage or later reliability failures. Insulation, adhesion and barrier layers have distinct roles; material/layer count depends on substrate/integration, and one layer may serve multiple functions.

title.zh: 孔内金属化：连续导通比表面镀亮更重要
title.en: Via metallization: continuous conduction matters more than a shiny surface

subtitle.zh: 种子连续性、镀铜分布与填充结构
subtitle.en: Seed continuity, copper distribution and fill structure

body.zh: 孔内导电层要连续，最终金属结构符合设计。TGV可以全填铜，也可孔壁镀铜。全填铜是孔内完全填充；孔壁镀铜中间有设计留空、由铜壁导电；非设计空洞是未填充空间的工艺缺陷。连续种子层有利于镀铜均匀生长，断点可能导致镀铜不连续和缺陷。
body.en: The via conductor must be continuous and the final metal structure must match design. TGV can be fully copper-filled or wall-plated. Full fill fills the hole; wall plating intentionally leaves an empty center with a conductive copper wall; unintended voids are process defects. Continuous seed supports uniform plating, whereas breaks can cause discontinuous copper and defects.

body.zh: 结构图的透明蓝色体标注为玻璃基板，橙色标注为铜或孔壁铜；红色圈出非设计空洞。
body.en: The transparent blue body is labeled glass substrate, the orange material copper or via-wall copper, and the red circle marks an unintended void.

body.zh: 接收合格孔壁界面，形成垂直金属通路，再交给整平与互连接续。形成种子层 → 润湿排气 → 受控镀铜 → 按需热处理 → 整平/去多余金属 → 检查。
body.en: Receive qualified sidewall interfaces, form vertical metal paths and hand off to planarization/interconnect. Form seed → wet/degas → controlled copper plating → thermal treatment as needed → planarize/remove excess metal → inspect.

body.zh: 控制种子连续性、电流分布、药液与孔内传质、填充形态/孔壁铜厚。相同长度及孔外径下，更多铜截面积有利于降电阻，但可能增加热失配和加工时间。失效包括种子断点、提前封口空洞、接缝、孔壁局部过薄。
body.en: Control seed continuity, current distribution, chemistry/in-via mass transport and fill shape/wall thickness. At equal length and outer diameter, more copper cross-section lowers resistance but may increase thermal mismatch and processing time. Failures include seed breaks, pinch-off voids, seams and locally thin copper walls.

body.zh: 用截面及分辨率适用的X射线检查内部结构，结合四线或导通链电阻定位异常，并复核前处理和镀铜条件。内部缺陷会带来局部发热、电阻漂移与开路。盲孔和通孔镀铜策略不同；设计为孔壁镀铜时，中心留空不能直接判为填充缺陷。
body.en: Inspect internals using cross-sections and X-ray with suitable resolution, combining four-wire/daisy-chain resistance to locate issues and review pretreatment/plating. Internal defects can cause heating, resistance drift and opens. Blind/through vias require different strategies; an intentionally empty wall-plated center is not automatically a fill defect.

title.zh: 互连整合：接上RDL才形成链路
title.en: Interconnect integration: RDL completes the link

subtitle.zh: 减薄露出、双面接续、平整度与对准
subtitle.en: Thinning/reveal, two-sided connections, flatness and alignment

body.zh: 垂直通孔与表面布线要正确接续；一个孔导通不代表整个封装链路合格。硅TSV盲孔路线从铜填充及正面RDL开始，背面减薄露出通孔，再做背面钝化、接触开口和背面RDL。玻璃TGV通孔路线构建双面RDL与端口接续，图中标顶面RDL、玻璃基板、铜通孔和底面RDL。
body.en: Vertical vias must connect correctly to surface routing; one conducting via does not qualify the complete package link. A silicon blind-TSV route starts with copper fill/front RDL, then back thinning/reveal, backside passivation, contact openings and back RDL. A glass through-TGV route builds two-sided RDL and terminal connections, labeled top RDL, glass, copper via and bottom RDL.

body.zh: 通孔与表面互连整合为后续芯片组装提供端口。TSV：填孔及正面处理 → 临时键合支撑 → 背面减薄并露出通孔 → 背面钝化与接触开口 → 布线/端口接续与测试。TGV：完成通孔金属化 → 支撑与搬运控制 → 双面RDL构建 → 端口形成与接续 → 平整度及链路测试。
body.en: Via/surface integration supplies terminals for later chip assembly. TSV: fill/front processing → temporary bonding support → back thinning/reveal → backside passivation/contact openings → routing/terminal connection and testing. TGV: metallize via → support/handling control → build two-sided RDL → form/connect terminals → flatness/link testing.

body.zh: 控制最终厚度与均匀性、端口高度/平整度、对准偏差、基板翘曲。减薄缩短互连路径但降低机械余量；更密端口收紧对准和整平窗口。常见失效包括露出不足或过度去除、RDL错位开路、局部非平整与裂纹。
body.en: Control final thickness/uniformity, terminal height/flatness, alignment error and substrate warpage. Thinning shortens paths but reduces mechanical margin; denser terminals tighten alignment/planarization windows. Failures include incomplete reveal/over-removal, RDL misalignment opens, local unevenness and cracks.

body.zh: 结合厚度、表面轮廓、翘曲、对准量测与导通链测试；异常后先核对接续位置和工序来源。影响键合接触、组装良率和链路完整性。以上是代表流程，TSV形成时点不同会改变顺序；TGV有通孔与盲孔路线，双面RDL和孔金属化也可协同制作。
body.en: Combine thickness, surface profile, warpage, alignment and daisy-chain continuity measurements; review connection locations/process origin first when abnormal. This affects bonding contact, assembly yield and link integrity. These flows are representative; TSV timing changes order. TGV may be blind or through, and two-sided RDL/via metallization can be co-fabricated.

title.zh: 热应力风险：冷热循环会考验界面
title.en: Thermal stress: temperature cycling tests interfaces

subtitle.zh: 热膨胀失配、铜突出、裂纹与脱层
subtitle.en: Thermal-expansion mismatch, copper protrusion, cracks and delamination

body.zh: 铜与硅、铜与玻璃都可能产生热失配应力；初始导通合格不能替代长期可靠性验证。热变形图分别标铜、界面层、硅基底（有源硅）与玻璃基底；局部放大显示铜突出、界面脱层和孔边裂纹。
body.en: Both copper/silicon and copper/glass can develop thermal-mismatch stress. Passing initial continuity does not replace long-term reliability verification. Thermal-deformation diagrams label copper, interface layers, active silicon and glass substrates; close-ups show copper protrusion, delamination and via-edge cracks.

body.zh: 贯穿镀铜后热处理、后续加工及服役验证，检查界面与结构稳定性。建立初始电性/形貌基线 → 施加规定热历程 → 分阶段量测 → 异常截面分析 → 反馈材料、结构与工艺控制。
body.en: Assess interface/structural stability throughout post-plating thermal treatment, later processing and service verification. Establish electrical/morphology baseline → apply specified thermal history → measure in stages → cross-section anomalies → feed findings into material, structure and process controls.

body.zh: 控制热失配与温度历程、铜量/孔形、界面附着、孔间距与整体变形约束。减少铜量可能降低部分结构热变形，也减少导电截面积，不能只追求低电阻或低应力之一。失效包括铜突出、界面脱层、孔边裂纹和电阻漂移。
body.en: Control mismatch/temperature history, copper volume/via shape, adhesion, via spacing and global deformation constraints. Less copper may reduce deformation in some structures but also reduces conducting area; neither low resistance nor low stress should be optimized alone. Failures include protrusion, delamination, edge cracks and resistance drift.

body.zh: 热循环前后比较电阻、表面轮廓和翘曲，结合截面定位失效，按结果隔离、复测或分析根因。可能破坏RDL接续、键合平面与长期电连接。有源硅中需评估TSV应力对邻近器件和禁布区KOZ影响；玻璃CTE可选，不代表与铜自然匹配或没有裂纹风险。
body.en: Compare resistance, surface profile and warpage before/after thermal cycling; locate failures in cross-section and isolate, remeasure or analyze root causes. Failures can disrupt RDL, bonding planes and long-term connections. Active silicon requires assessment of TSV stress on nearby devices and keep-out zones (KOZ). Selectable glass CTE does not imply natural matching to copper or freedom from cracking.

title.zh: 工艺选择：同任务再比较路线
title.en: Process selection: compare routes for the same task

subtitle.zh: 功能、布线、电热表现、可靠性与合格件成本
subtitle.en: Function, routing, electrothermal performance, reliability and good-unit cost

body.zh: 先判断连接任务是否相同，再比较整段制造和封装表现。芯片内TSV连接硅芯片顶面与背面电路，要评估与芯片工艺兼容性，不能直接换成TGV。无源中介层连接芯片与下层接口时，可同层比较硅中介层TSV与玻璃中介层TGV。玻璃芯封装基板则评估TGV及双面增层布线，并与其他层TSV协同设计。三者均用代表性测试结构验证。
body.en: First confirm the same connection task, then compare full manufacturing/package performance. Chip TSV connects front/back silicon circuits and requires chip-process compatibility; it cannot simply become TGV. For a passive interposer connecting chips to lower interfaces, compare silicon-TSV and glass-TGV interposers at the same level. Glass-core package substrates require assessment of TGV and two-sided build-up routing coordinated with TSV at other levels. Verify all using representative test structures.

body.zh: 架构与工艺共同选型，确定通孔类型、所在层及验证方式。锁定层级与端点 → 明确孔/RDL需求 → 检查电热与可靠性预算 → 比较完整流程和供应能力 → 代表性测试结构验证。约束为孔距与布线能力、电热指标、可靠性要求和每个合格件总成本。
body.en: Architecture and process jointly choose via type, hierarchy and verification. Fix hierarchy/endpoints → define via/RDL needs → check electrothermal/reliability budgets → compare complete flows/supply capability → test representative structures. Constraints are pitch/routing capability, electrothermal metrics, reliability and total cost per good unit.

body.zh: 大尺寸或面板加工的潜在效率收益要计入搬运、翘曲、缺陷和设备投入；只看材料单价会低估开路、裂纹和组装损失。在目标频段、负载和封装条件下比较导通、损耗、温变与可靠性，结合实际合格件成本决策。选择决定供应链和封装接口；不预设TGV全面替代TSV，也不脱离具体设计给出成本或性能排名。
body.en: Potential large-format/panel efficiency must include handling, warpage, defects and equipment investment; material price alone can undercount opens, cracks and assembly losses. Compare continuity, loss, temperature response and reliability at target frequency/load/package conditions, using actual good-unit cost. Selection determines supply chain and package interfaces. Do not assume complete TSV replacement by TGV or rank cost/performance independently of design.

title.zh: 一张图看懂BARC与TARC
title.en: BARC and TARC at a glance

subtitle.zh: 一个在胶下，一个在胶上，分别解决什么反射
subtitle.en: Below and above resist: which reflections do they address?

body.zh: BARC在胶下，TARC在胶上，职责不只是位置不同。膜堆从上至下为TARC、光刻胶Photoresist、BARC、衬底/下方膜堆Substrate；TARC调节胶上界面反射，BARC控制胶下界面反射。
body.en: BARC lies below resist and TARC above it; their roles differ beyond location. Top-to-bottom stack: TARC, photoresist, BARC, substrate/lower stack. TARC tunes top-interface reflection and BARC controls reflection below the resist.

body.zh: 通过吸收与相位干涉降低有效反射。入射光与多界面反射光相消叠加；无ARC时胶内站立波强，使用ARC后减弱。
body.en: Absorption and phase interference reduce effective reflection. Incident and multiple reflected waves combine destructively; standing waves are strong without ARC and weaker with it.

body.zh: 材料须匹配光学、界面和后续工艺。原图列有机BARC：吸收能力强、工艺窗口宽、与下层匹配好；无机ARC：热稳定性好、耐刻蚀性强、适合高端节点；水溶性TARC或Topcoat：改善胶面光学、易于显影去除、低残留风险。
body.en: Materials must match optics, interfaces and downstream processing. The source lists organic BARC as strongly absorbing, broad-window and compatible with lower layers; inorganic ARC as thermally stable, etch-resistant and suitable for advanced nodes; water-soluble TARC/topcoat as improving top-surface optics, readily removed during development and having low residue risk.

body.zh: 既要压反射，也要稳定打开和转移图形。BARC涂布/固化 → 涂布光刻胶 → 曝光显影 → BARC Open → 图形转移。
body.en: Suppress reflection while enabling stable opening and pattern transfer. BARC coat/cure → resist coat → expose/develop → BARC open → pattern transfer.

body.zh: 胶面光学改善不能换来显影和表面缺陷。涂布光刻胶 → 涂布TARC → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去除TARC → 检查。可能缺陷：干燥不均形成水印、TARC残留影响图形、退润湿形成针孔/裸区。
body.en: Optical improvement must not introduce development/surface defects. Coat resist → coat TARC → expose → develop/rinse to remove TARC → inspect. Risks include watermarks from uneven drying, pattern-affecting TARC residue and dewetting pinholes/bare areas.

body.zh: TARC多在显影侧去除，再进入刻蚀/清洗等后续步骤；BARC显影后仍常需额外打开（BARC Open/刻蚀），再图形转移。具体去除方式依配方。
body.en: TARC is often removed around development before etching/cleaning. BARC commonly requires a separate post-development open/etch before transfer. Actual removal depends on formulation.

body.zh: CD摆动查光学反射、ARC匹配与工艺稳定性；站立波查反射过强、膜厚不当、材料吸收不足；残留查去除不完全、材料相容性与工艺窗口窄；水印/表面缺陷查表面能不匹配、干燥不均和涂膜缺陷。
body.en: For CD swing, inspect reflection, ARC matching and process stability. For standing waves, inspect excessive reflection, thickness and insufficient absorption. For residues, inspect removal, compatibility and narrow windows. For watermarks/surface defects, inspect surface energy, drying and coating.

body.zh: 胶下反射主导时优先BARC；胶上界面主导时优先TARC；两者显著时用BARC+TARC；收益不足或工艺负担大时可不使用额外ARC。
body.en: Prefer BARC for dominant lower-stack reflection, TARC for dominant upper-interface effects, both when both matter, or no additional ARC when benefit is insufficient or process burden too high.

title.zh: 上下位置：BARC与TARC不是简单翻面
title.en: Position: BARC and TARC are not simple mirror images

subtitle.zh: Topcoat / Photoresist / Underlayer / Substrate
subtitle.en: Topcoat / Photoresist / Underlayer / Substrate

body.zh: BARC主要处理胶下膜堆反射，TARC主要调节胶上表面光学边界。膜堆由TARC（胶上涂层）、PR光刻胶、BARC（胶下ARC）、衬底构成。TARC抑制胶上反射、改善入射光场、减少驻波与不均；BARC抑制下方反射、吸收反射光、改善成像对比度。两者不等同。
body.en: BARC mainly addresses lower-stack reflection; TARC adjusts the optical boundary at the resist top. The stack is topcoat/TARC, PR, BARC and substrate. TARC suppresses top reflection, improves the incident field and reduces standing waves/nonuniformity. BARC suppresses lower reflection, absorbs reflected light and improves contrast. They are not equivalent.

heading.zh: 分析流程：从膜堆到功能

body.zh: 1. 读膜堆：识别材料、确认顺序、结合工艺信息。2. 找PR：确定位置、胶层完整性和图形层。3. 辨下方ARC：确认BARC、材料类型和连续性。4. 辨上方涂层：确认TARC/Topcoat、材料特征与表面状态。5. 判断附加功能：是否兼顾抗反射、防粘/抗污、浸没/多层支持，并评估必要性。
body.en: 1. Read the stack: materials, order and process context. 2. Locate PR: position, integrity and patterning layer. 3. Identify lower ARC: BARC presence, material and continuity. 4. Identify upper coating: TARC/topcoat, material and surface state. 5. Assess additional antireflective, anti-adhesion/contamination and immersion/multilayer functions and whether needed.

heading.zh: 去除与图形转移：原图说明

body.zh: 原图写TARC“多数在显影前去除（随光刻胶去除）”，也可能按材料工艺单独去除；BARC通常显影后由后续刻蚀去除。原图称二者一般不直接参与图形转移，TARC主要提供光学/表面功能，BARC主要提供吸收/抗反射功能。具体去除方式依材料及后续工艺。
body.en: The source states that TARC is “mostly removed before development (with the photoresist)” or separately depending on material/process, and BARC is generally removed by etching after development. It describes both as generally not directly participating in transfer, with TARC serving optical/surface functions and BARC absorption/antireflection. Removal depends on material and subsequent processing.

body.zh: 抑制反射、减少驻波、提升对比度，可改善成像；但多涂布步骤、界面和缺陷风险增加。需权衡图形质量与复杂度、性能与缺陷，并匹配整体工艺。“只有位置不同”不对；所有Topcoat并非都是TARC，还可能防粘或抗污；有ARC仍要优化PR膜厚，因为其影响成像、分辨率和窗口。
body.en: Reflection/standing-wave suppression and contrast improve imaging, but added coatings/interfaces increase complexity and defect risk. Balance quality, complexity and defects across the full process. “Only position differs” is incorrect. Not every topcoat is TARC; it may serve other surface functions. PR thickness still needs co-optimization because it affects imaging, resolution and process window.

body.zh: SEM/TEM截面确认层次、连续性并对比材料；椭偏等膜厚测量和反射率光谱比较无ARC、仅BARC、TARC+BARC；CD/形貌量测侧壁和底部，验证成像改善。下游依次为曝光窗口（更宽、更稳定）、显影（改善侧壁、减少残留缺陷）、BARC Open（稳定打开、避免残留）、刻蚀（完整转移、侧壁更垂直、减少微缺陷）。
body.en: SEM/TEM verifies layers/continuity and compares materials. Thickness metrology such as ellipsometry and reflectance spectra compare no ARC, BARC only and TARC+BARC. CD/morphology measurements inspect sidewalls/bottoms. Downstream stages are exposure (wider, more stable window), development (better sidewalls, less residue), BARC opening (stable open, no residual obstruction) and etching (complete transfer, more vertical walls, fewer microdefects).

body.zh: 具体功能随曝光波长、光刻胶体系及是否浸没而变化，须结合应用、材料与流程评估。
body.en: Functions vary with exposure wavelength, resist system and immersion use; evaluate the specific application, material system and flow.

notes.zh: 原图“显影前去除（随光刻胶去除）”与本组总览所写“显影/漂洗去除TARC”不一致，已原意转录；实际顺序需按具体配方流程确认。原图对BARC不参与图形转移的概括，也不能取代具体堆栈整合要求。
notes.en: The source’s “before development (with photoresist)” differs from this chapter’s overview stating TARC removal during development/rinse. It is transcribed faithfully; actual order requires the formulation-specific flow. Its general statement about BARC not participating in transfer does not replace stack-specific integration requirements.

title.zh: 光学机理：不是把反射光全部吸掉
title.en: Optical mechanism: reflection is not simply all absorbed

subtitle.zh: 复折射率 / 膜厚 / 相位差 / 站立波
subtitle.en: Complex refractive index / thickness / phase / standing waves

body.zh: ARC依靠吸收与多界面干涉共同降低进入光刻胶的有效反射。无ARC图：界面反射强（相位接近），PR内光强形成明显站立波；BARC图：吸收衰减反射，反射幅度降低，站立波减弱；TARC图：多界面干涉加吸收，进一步抑制反射，光强波动更弱。
body.en: ARC combines absorption with multi-interface interference to reduce effective reflection into resist. The no-ARC panel shows strong interface reflection and pronounced standing waves. BARC attenuates reflected amplitude and weakens standing waves. The TARC panel depicts interference plus absorption further reducing reflection and intensity variation.

body.zh: 光入射 → 多界面反射 → 相位与振幅改变（不同界面具有相位差、幅度差）→ 在PR内反射光与入射光叠加形成光强分布 → ARC吸收/相消降低有效反射。
body.en: Incident light → reflections at multiple interfaces → altered phase/amplitude → reflected and incident fields superpose inside PR → absorption/destructive interference reduces effective reflection.

body.zh: 复折射率(n,k)：n决定相位，k决定吸收，影响界面反射强度和吸收能力。膜厚d：决定干涉相位差及相消条件。曝光波长λ：影响干涉条件，与材料光学常数耦合。入射角θ与偏振Pol.：改变界面反射强度，影响干涉和吸收。
body.en: Complex index (n,k): n controls phase and k absorption, affecting reflection and attenuation. Thickness d sets interference phase and cancellation conditions. Wavelength λ affects interference and couples to optical constants. Incidence angle θ and polarization affect interface reflectivity, interference and absorption.

body.zh: 吸收太弱则反射强、站立波难抑制；吸收太强或膜厚设计不当可降低有效曝光、缩窄窗口、影响分辨率。站立波表现为PR光强周期变化与CD起伏；原图Swing Curve面板以焦点为横轴，描述焦深曲线波动与窗口变窄；侧壁波纹/刻蚀后粗糙可源于光强不均；CD随下层膜厚周期变化说明干涉显著。
body.en: Weak absorption leaves strong reflection/standing waves; excessive absorption or unsuitable thickness can reduce effective exposure, narrow the window and affect resolution. Standing waves cause periodic PR intensity and CD variation. The source’s “Swing Curve” panel uses focus as the horizontal axis and describes focus-curve fluctuation/window narrowing. Sidewall ripples/etched roughness may arise from nonuniform intensity; periodic CD versus lower-layer thickness indicates strong interference.

body.zh: 椭偏测n、k及膜厚均匀性；反射率光谱验证反射抑制；FEM光学仿真模拟光场并优化材料厚度；CD—膜厚实验关联确认周期趋势。吸收型或多层ARC不能套唯一通用四分之一波长公式，须综合光学常数、膜厚、入射条件和多界面干涉，用仿真与实验优化。
body.en: Use ellipsometry for n, k, thickness/uniformity; reflectance spectra for suppression; FEM optical simulation for fields and material/thickness optimization; and experimental CD–thickness correlation for periodic trends. Absorbing/multilayer ARC cannot use one universal quarter-wave formula; jointly optimize optical constants, thickness, incidence and interference through simulation/experiment.

notes.zh: 原图TARC面板将“TARC（顶部ARC）”箭头指向PR下方，和本组定义不一致；本页保留图示作为参考并标出此疑点。Swing Curve面板标题与“焦点”横轴也存在术语对应疑点，未静默改图。
notes.en: The original TARC-panel arrow points below PR despite calling it top ARC, inconsistent with the chapter definition. The diagram is retained with this discrepancy noted. The “Swing Curve” title versus “focus” horizontal axis is also a terminology concern and has not been silently redrawn.
