title.zh: 材料与堆栈：光学匹配还要服从界面
title.en: Materials and stacks: optical matching must also satisfy interfaces

subtitle.zh: 有机BARC / 无机ARC / 水溶性TARC / Topcoat
subtitle.en: Organic BARC / inorganic ARC / water-soluble TARC / topcoat

body.zh: 材料不只满足n/k，还须兼容光刻胶、衬底、显影和刻蚀。堆栈为Topcoat/TARC、光刻胶、BARC/ARC及衬底。Topcoat/TARC优化胶面光学、保护PR并减少污染缺陷；有机BARC旋涂友好、平坦化强、适应复杂地形；无机ARC/SiARC除光学匹配还可兼顾硬掩膜，支持后续图形转移。
body.en: Materials must satisfy n/k and remain compatible with resist, substrate, development and etching. The stack is topcoat/TARC, PR, BARC/ARC and substrate. Topcoat/TARC improves surface optics, protects PR and reduces contamination/defects. Organic BARC supports spin coating, planarization and complex topography. Inorganic ARC/SiARC may also serve as a hard mask for transfer.

body.zh: 有机BARC（旋涂型）：成熟旋涂、强平坦化、PR兼容、适应复杂地形，典型为有机聚合物。原图把无机ARC/SiARC列为沉积型：光学匹配宽、可兼硬掩膜、耐刻蚀强、适合先进节点，典型列SiARC、氮化物等。水溶性TARC/Topcoat：优化胶面光学、减少表面缺陷、水溶易去除、保护PR，典型为水溶性聚合物。并非所有Topcoat都是TARC：前者偏表面保护，后者有明确抗反射光学功能。
body.en: Organic spin-on BARC offers mature coating, planarization, PR compatibility and topography coverage, typically using organic polymers. The source groups inorganic ARC/SiARC as deposited materials with broad optical matching, hard-mask capability, etch resistance and advanced-node use, listing SiARC and nitrides. Water-soluble TARC/topcoat offers surface optics, defect reduction, easy aqueous removal and PR protection, using water-soluble polymers. Not every topcoat is TARC; topcoat may emphasize protection, while TARC has an explicit optical antireflective function.

body.zh: 衬底准备（清洁、活化）→ BARC涂布/沉积（成膜、平坦化）→ 固化/烘烤（去溶剂、稳定膜性）→ 涂PR（旋涂、软烘、均匀胶膜）→ 涂TARC/Topcoat（光学优化、保护）→ 曝光及后续显影、刻蚀/去除TARC、图形转移。
body.en: Prepare substrate (clean/activate) → coat/deposit BARC (film/planarization) → cure/bake (remove solvent, stabilize film) → spin/soft-bake uniform PR → coat TARC/topcoat (optics/protection) → exposure, development, etching/TARC removal and transfer.

body.zh: 附着力：界面牢固、防脱层、耐后续应力。溶剂正交性：上层溶剂不破坏下层，各层工艺互不影响。界面互混：减少扩散、保持清晰、避免影响光学和PR性质。吸收及膜厚均匀性：有效压反射、均匀覆盖大面积/复杂地形。有机体系易旋涂、平坦化好、窗口相对宽、适于细结构，但耐刻蚀相对有限；无机体系兼顾抗反射和硬掩膜、耐刻蚀强，但整合开口更复杂，界面匹配要求高。
body.en: Adhesion: strong interfaces, no delamination, resistance to later stress. Solvent orthogonality: upper solvents must not damage lower layers. Intermixing: limit diffusion and retain clear interfaces/PR properties. Absorption/thickness uniformity: suppress reflection with uniform coverage. Organic systems coat/planarize readily with relatively broad windows but limited etch resistance; inorganic systems can combine ARC/hard-mask functions and strong etch resistance but require more complex integration/opening and interface matching.

body.zh: 互混降低光学性能或改变PR；脱层/起泡破坏图形；涂布不均影响CD与良率；边缘堆积使开口困难；溶剂或界面导致PR性能异常。量测膜厚/n及均匀性、FTIR/化学结构与材料匹配、接触角/表面能与亲疏水、缺陷分布/颗粒沾污、截面界面清晰度与膜层完整性。部分SiARC/Underlayer兼具抗反射与转移功能，ARC不只是光学层。
body.en: Intermixing degrades optics or changes PR; delamination/bubbles disrupt patterns; nonuniform coating affects CD/yield; edge buildup complicates opening; solvents/interfaces alter PR. Measure thickness/n/uniformity, FTIR/chemistry and compatibility, contact angle/surface energy/wetting, defect/particle/contamination maps, and cross-sectional clarity/integrity. Some SiARC/underlayers combine antireflection and transfer functions; ARC is not only an optical layer.

notes.zh: “无机ARC/SiARC（沉积型）”为原图分组，不能视为所有SiARC均采用同一种成膜方法；选材仍以实际材料规格和工艺为准。
notes.en: “Inorganic ARC/SiARC (deposited)” is the source grouping and should not imply that all SiARC uses one deposition method; use the actual material specification and process.

title.zh: BARC窗口：压反射之后还要打开它
title.en: BARC window: reflection control must be followed by opening

subtitle.zh: 膜厚n/k / 固化 / BARC Open / 刻蚀选择比
subtitle.en: Thickness and n/k / curing / BARC opening / etch selectivity

body.zh: 1. 衬底清洁：去有机物与颗粒。2. BARC涂布/沉积并固化：形成连续均匀膜。3. PR涂布/烘烤：均匀胶膜。4. 曝光显影：形成PR图形，在BARC上方形成开口。5. BARC Open：选择性去除开口处BARC。6. 下层图形转移，去PR与残留。图例为紫色PR、橙色BARC、灰色衬底/下层。
body.en: 1. Clean substrate of organics/particles. 2. Coat/deposit and cure continuous uniform BARC. 3. Coat/bake uniform PR. 4. Expose/develop PR openings above BARC. 5. Selectively remove BARC at openings. 6. Transfer into the lower layer and remove PR/residues. Purple denotes PR, orange BARC and gray substrate/lower material.

body.zh: 膜厚与n/k匹配以降反射、避免残余站立波，兼顾刻蚀/显影窗口。充分固化提升化学和等离子耐受，避免溶胀、起皮、残留；不足会影响选择比。全片膜厚/n/k均匀性影响成像及CD，要看边缘/中心差异并监控。合适BARC刻蚀速率与PR选择比保证开口干净、减少PR损耗/CD偏差，给下层转移稳定窗口。
body.en: Match thickness and n/k to suppress reflection/standing waves while maintaining etch/develop windows. Adequate curing improves chemical/plasma resistance and prevents swelling, peeling and residue; undercure affects selectivity. Across-wafer thickness/n/k uniformity controls imaging/CD, including center-edge variation. Proper BARC rate and PR selectivity enable clean opening with less PR/CD loss and a stable transfer window.

body.zh: 原图称高耐刻蚀BARC有利于下层转移、减少残留风险和拓宽窗口，但开口可能额外消耗PR、引入CD Bias，过强耐刻蚀加重CD损失。风险对比：膜厚或n/k不佳→残余站立波；显影不全→Scum残渣；刻蚀/显影不当→Footing底脚；开口不全→BARC残留；过开口/侧蚀→CD损失；各向异性不足→侧向刻蚀。
body.en: The source states that etch-resistant BARC helps lower-layer transfer, reduces residue risk and broadens the window, but opening can consume additional PR and introduce CD bias; excessive resistance worsens CD loss. Risk mapping: poor thickness/n/k → residual standing waves; incomplete development → scum; unsuitable etch/develop → footing; incomplete opening → BARC residue; over-open/lateral etch → CD loss; insufficient anisotropy → lateral etching.

body.zh: 膜厚图检查全片分布；反射率对比有/无BARC；CD-SEM量CD及侧壁；Open截面查清洁和残留；缺陷扫描查残留颗粒。需预留PR厚度应对BARC损耗，开口可产生正/负CD Bias，并影响下层刻蚀均匀性与保真度。
body.en: Map thickness; compare reflectance with/without BARC; measure CD/sidewalls by CD-SEM; inspect open cross-sections and residue/particle scans. Budget PR for BARC etch consumption. Opening can produce positive/negative CD bias and affect lower-layer etch uniformity and fidelity.

body.zh: 原图列常规有机BARC通常用氧等离子灰化打开，对显影溶剂较敏感，需控制固化与选择比；无机ARC（SiON等）常用氟基等离子刻蚀，化学稳定、显影不易去除，选择比依下层材料；兼作硬掩膜Underlayer可能需专门开口刻蚀，并综合选择比及图形转移。
body.en: The source lists conventional organic BARC opening by oxygen-plasma ashing, sensitivity to developer solvents and the need to control cure/selectivity. Inorganic ARC such as SiON commonly uses fluorine-based plasma, is chemically stable and not easily removed by development, with selectivity depending on underlying materials. Hard-mask underlayers may need dedicated opening etches and integrated selectivity/transfer planning.

notes.zh: 耐刻蚀性与残留风险的关系不能仅凭高低概括：原图的优势描述已保留，但也同时明确记载其开口更难及PR/CD损耗的权衡。
notes.en: Etch resistance alone does not determine residue risk. The source’s benefit claim is retained together with its stated harder-opening and PR/CD-loss trade-offs.

title.zh: TARC窗口：胶面改善不能换来显影缺陷
title.en: TARC window: surface improvement must not cause development defects

subtitle.zh: 表面反射 / 涂布均匀性 / 可去除性 / 浸没兼容
subtitle.en: Surface reflection / coating uniformity / removability / immersion compatibility

body.zh: TARC改善胶上光学边界，同时须保持PR化学与显影稳定。PR涂布/烘烤获得均匀膜并去溶剂 → TARC涂布/稳定 → 曝光 → 显影/漂洗去TARC（依配方）→ 干燥去残液、稳定形貌 → 外观、CD、缺陷检查。原图显影步骤写“去除未曝光PR，同时去除TARC”。
body.en: TARC improves the top optical boundary while preserving PR chemistry and development stability. Coat/bake uniform PR and remove solvent → coat/stabilize TARC → expose → develop/rinse away TARC as formulated → dry residual liquid/stabilize morphology → appearance, CD and defect inspection. The source’s development step says “remove unexposed PR while removing TARC.”

body.zh: 膜厚与折射率n决定反射控制且须兼顾窗口；全片涂布均匀性影响曝光及CD，需看边缘/中心；可去除/溶解行为须与PR同步或按工艺选择性去除，避免残留、聚集及再沉积；PR/TARC界面须避免互溶/反应，保持清晰与适中附着，关注图形边缘。
body.en: Thickness/index n determine reflection control and the window. Coating uniformity affects exposure/CD, including center-edge differences. Removal/dissolution must be synchronized with PR or selectively processed without residue, aggregation or redeposition. Avoid PR/TARC intermixing/reaction; maintain clear interfaces, suitable adhesion and controlled pattern-edge interfaces.

body.zh: 增强保护/阻隔可降反射、减有害物质扩散、稳胶面、改善边缘，却可能难去除、残留、改变化学及显影速率、引入CD偏差。水印来自干燥不均；TARC残留来自去除不全，可在底部/侧壁；退润湿形成岛/针孔；涂布斑来自厚度不均；PR溶胀来自化学影响；CD漂移来自光学或化学变化。
body.en: Stronger protection/barriers can reduce reflection and harmful diffusion, stabilize surfaces and improve edges, but may complicate removal, leave residue, change chemistry/develop rate and shift CD. Watermarks arise from uneven drying; incomplete removal leaves bottom/sidewall TARC; dewetting creates islands/pinholes; thickness variation creates coating marks; chemical effects swell PR; optical/chemical changes shift CD.

body.zh: 检查全片膜厚/反射率、表面和图形缺陷及残留颗粒；适用时测接触角/浸出物，评估表面能；CDU/FEM对比CD均匀性与窗口。目标是显影洁净无残留少聚集、无新缺陷；胶侧壁垂直、线形完整、表面平整低粗糙；转移前掩膜稳定，减少刻蚀异常。
body.en: Check wafer thickness/reflectance, surface/pattern defects and residual particles. Where applicable, measure contact angle/leachables and surface energy. Use CDU/FEM to compare CD uniformity/window. Targets are clean development with little aggregation/no added defects, vertical intact resist lines with smooth surfaces, and stable masks before transfer with fewer etch anomalies.

body.zh: 常规TARC主要降胶面反射，兼顾化学稳定和可去除性；浸没Topcoat用于浸没光刻介质界面控制，并非所有TARC都是浸没Topcoat。Topcoat也可提供保护、润湿或界面控制，不只抗反射。
body.en: Conventional TARC mainly reduces top reflection while maintaining chemical stability/removability. Immersion topcoats control the immersion-medium interface; not all TARC is immersion topcoat. Topcoats can provide protection, wetting and interface control beyond antireflection.

notes.zh: “去除未曝光PR”为原图原话，适用性取决于光刻胶正/负性，不能作为所有PR显影的通用描述。本页未将其静默改为“已曝光”。
notes.en: “Remove unexposed PR” is the source wording; applicability depends on positive/negative resist tone and is not a universal development description. It has not been silently changed to “exposed.”

title.zh: 显影与刻蚀：两种ARC的退出方式不同
title.en: Development and etching: the two ARCs leave differently

subtitle.zh: 显影去除 / BARC Open / 胶厚预算 / CD Bias
subtitle.en: Development removal / BARC opening / resist budget / CD bias

body.zh: TARC常在显影/漂洗中退出；BARC常在显影后保留、需刻蚀打开，依配方膜系而定。TARC路线：PR+TARC曝光 → 显影/漂洗溶解去除TARC → PR图形完成 → 后续刻蚀、离子注入或薄膜沉积。BARC路线：PR+BARC曝光显影 → BARC仍在底部 → BARC Open选择性刻蚀 → 后续图形转移。
body.en: TARC commonly leaves during development/rinse; BARC often remains and requires etch opening, depending on formulation/stack. TARC: expose PR+TARC → dissolve/remove during development/rinse → completed PR pattern → etch, implant or deposit. BARC: expose/develop PR+BARC → BARC remains at the bottom → selective BARC open → subsequent transfer.

body.zh: TARC去除性：充分去除、与显影液/PR/下层兼容，避免残留水印。BARC选择比：对PR高选择比、均匀且各向异性、减少CD偏差及下层损伤。剩余PR厚度：留足转移预算，兼顾分辨率，防过耗塌陷。残留/侧壁：查ARC/聚合物、侧壁角度，防回缩或不完全刻蚀，保证清洁与后续窗口。
body.en: TARC removability: complete removal, developer/PR/lower-layer compatibility, no residue/watermarks. BARC selectivity: high selectivity to PR, uniform anisotropic etch, limited CD shift/lower-layer damage. Remaining PR: enough transfer budget while preserving resolution and preventing collapse. Residue/sidewalls: check ARC/polymer and wall angles to avoid recession/incomplete etch and ensure cleanliness.

body.zh: 弱BARC刻蚀可能残留、影响转移、增加缺陷；更强Open可降BARC残留和Scum，但增加PR损耗、可能使CD增长或损伤下层。典型风险为TARC残留/水印干斑、BARC底部Scum、过刻/欠刻CD Bias、PR顶部损耗导致厚度不足或塌陷、侧壁回缩/角度变化降低保真度。
body.en: Weak BARC etching can leave residue and harm transfer; stronger opening reduces residue/scum but consumes PR, may enlarge CD or damage lower layers. Risks include TARC residue/watermarks, bottom BARC scum, over-/under-etch CD bias, top PR loss and collapse, and sidewall recession/angle changes that reduce fidelity.

body.zh: 显影后缺陷图检查残留水印、密度和稳定性；CD-SEM测尺寸、偏差及侧壁；XSEM查多层结构、ARC残留及整体形貌；残膜检查定位表面异常并验证清洁；刻蚀前后CD对比量化变化和可接受性。下游关注掩膜强度/完整性和耐刻蚀、CD一致性/均匀性及器件良率规则、侧壁保持及偏差累积。可显影BARC、特殊Topcoat和多层胶的退出方式不同，按材料、光学和流程选择验证。
body.en: Post-develop maps inspect residue/watermarks, density and stability. CD-SEM measures dimensions/bias/walls; XSEM examines stacks, ARC residue and overall shape. Residual-film inspection locates anomalies; before/after CD quantifies acceptable changes. Downstream concerns are mask integrity/etch endurance, CD uniformity/device/yield rules and sidewall fidelity/cumulative bias. Developable BARC, special topcoats and multilayer resists may use different removal routes requiring material/optical/process-specific validation.

notes.zh: 原图TARC路线把TARC标签指向PR下方的蓝层，与“胶上TARC”定义不一致；保留原图参照，正文按该组文字定义说明，不将图中错位当作结构事实。
notes.en: The source’s TARC-route label points to a blue layer below PR, inconsistent with top ARC. The original remains available; the text follows the chapter’s definition and does not treat the misplaced drawing as structural fact.

title.zh: 异常诊断：先判断是光学还是材料问题
title.en: Diagnosis: distinguish optical from material problems

subtitle.zh: CD摆动 / 站立波 / 残留 / 水印
subtitle.en: CD swing / standing waves / residue / watermarks

body.zh: 相似CD与缺陷症状可能来自光学设计、膜厚均匀性、界面化学或去除工艺。四类候选根因：光学反射/干涉/窗口；膜厚涂布不均/波动；界面去除/漂洗/浸没；显影或BARC Open去除不足。
body.en: Similar CD/defect symptoms can come from optical design, thickness uniformity, interface chemistry or removal. Four candidate categories are optical reflection/interference/window, coating/thickness variation, interface removal/rinse/immersion, and incomplete development/BARC opening.

body.zh: 1. 侧壁周期波纹：周期与光波相关，厚胶/高反射结构常见，指向站立波/反射。2. CD随下层膜厚周期变化：峰谷关联干涉，指向光学窗口/下层厚度。3. 中心—边缘CD差：径向或环形，常关联涂布/烘烤/均匀性。4. 水印/圆斑：多见TARC去除/漂洗，可关联浸没界面或干燥。5. 底部残留：槽底PR/BARC未清除而侧壁正常，提示显影或Open不足。
body.en: 1. Periodic sidewall ripples: wave-related, common in thick/high-reflection stacks, suggesting standing waves/reflection. 2. Periodic CD versus underlayer thickness: interference peaks/valleys, suggesting optics/thickness. 3. Center-edge CD differences: radial/ring patterns linked to coat/bake/uniformity. 4. Watermarks/circular spots: often TARC removal/rinse, immersion or drying. 5. Bottom PR/BARC residue with otherwise normal walls: insufficient development/opening.

body.zh: 看分布：全片/边缘/局部及周期方向。做膜厚—CD关联：结合椭偏/反射率判断相关性和周期。看PR截面侧壁：找周期波纹、区分光学与材料主导。对照多层光学模型：仿真反射/干涉，与实测对比。检查显影后残留和BARC Open充分性。最后关联PR/BARC材料、涂布烘烤窗口、去除漂洗、设备状态和均匀性，综合验证根因。
body.en: Map whole-wafer/edge/local distribution and periodicity/direction. Correlate thickness/CD using ellipsometry/reflectance. Inspect PR sidewall cross-sections for periodic ripples and optical/material dominance. Compare multilayer reflection/interference simulations with measurements. Check development residue and opening completeness. Finally relate PR/BARC materials, coat/bake windows, rinse/removal, equipment state and uniformity to validate root cause.

body.zh: 优化膜厚/涂布/烘烤均匀性，准确评估n/k并匹配层次，减少烘烤溶剂残留，优化显影窗口与去除一致性，提升刻蚀均匀性、减少叠加偏差。椭偏/反射率给膜厚及n/k；CD-SEM/XSEM查CD、侧壁、残留缺陷；FEM光场仿真验证反射干涉；缺陷图确认类型分布和周期；模型/实测CD—膜厚对比验证根因合理性。
body.en: Optimize thickness/coating/bake uniformity, assess n/k and stack matching, reduce solvent residue, improve development/removal consistency and etch uniformity. Ellipsometry/reflectance gives thickness/n/k; CD-SEM/XSEM checks CD, walls, residue and defects; FEM optical fields test interference; defect maps establish spatial/periodic signatures; measured versus modeled CD–thickness trends test root-cause validity.

body.zh: 不要仅凭一张截面锁定根因。相似形貌可由光学、材料或工艺多因素引起，须结合分布、量测和模型。先用空间分布、周期性和工艺前后对比建立证据链，再综合光学常数、膜厚、条件及多界面干涉逐步定位。
body.en: Do not identify a root cause from one cross-section alone. Similar shapes can arise from optical, material or process factors. Build evidence from spatial distribution, periodicity and before/after process comparisons, then integrate optical constants, thickness, conditions and interference using measurements and models.

title.zh: 工艺选择：先找主要反射界面
title.en: Process selection: identify the dominant reflecting interface

subtitle.zh: 衬底反射 / 胶面反射 / 浸没保护 / 图形转移
subtitle.en: Substrate reflection / resist-surface reflection / immersion protection / transfer

body.zh: 按主反射来源与集成负担选BARC、TARC、组合或不加ARC。下层复杂膜堆反射强而胶上较弱：优先BARC。胶上表面/浸没界面关键、胶下较弱：优先TARC/Topcoat。上下反射均强、相互干涉显著：组合BARC+TARC。现有膜堆已有效控制反射或新增集成负担大：可不加额外ARC。图中分别标入射光、上下界面反射、浸没液、PR及衬底/下层膜堆。
body.en: Choose BARC, TARC, both or no added ARC by dominant reflection and integration burden. Strong lower-stack reflection: prefer BARC. Dominant upper/immersion interface: prefer TARC/topcoat. Strong upper/lower reflection and interference: combine them. Already-controlled reflection or excessive added burden: no extra ARC. Diagrams label incident light, upper/lower reflection, immersion liquid, PR and lower stack/substrate.

body.zh: 明确波长与光学条件（i-line、DUV、193i、EUV，干式/浸没，NA与偏振）→ 建立含所有功能层的完整膜堆和窗口 → 分析各界面反射及主干涉源 → 扫描ARC参数并仿真容差 → 检查涂布均匀、显影窗口、刻蚀选择比及后续兼容 → FEM与缺陷验证光学、成像和风险。
body.en: Define wavelength/conditions (i-line, DUV, 193i, EUV; dry/immersion; NA/polarization) → build full functional stack/window → analyze reflections/dominant interference → scan ARC parameters/tolerance → check coating, development, selectivity and compatibility → verify optics, imaging and defects using FEM/testing.

body.zh: 控制n/k与膜厚窗口、衬底多层反射、PR厚度预算和显影/刻蚀兼容。PR厚度须满足分辨率与成像、匹配Topcoat并避免过厚问题；去除干净、选择比合适、不增新缺陷。新增ARC可扩大窗口与容差，也增加成本、缺陷机会、复杂度和后续耦合。
body.en: Control n/k/thickness window, multilayer substrate reflection, PR thickness budget and develop/etch compatibility. PR thickness must satisfy resolution/imaging, match topcoat and avoid excessive-thickness issues. Ensure clean removal, appropriate selectivity and no new defects. Added ARC may improve window/tolerance but adds cost, defects, complexity and downstream coupling.

body.zh: 主反射界面误判导致方案错、抑制差；仿真实测不符可能是材料参数或工艺波动；BARC难开口导致残留、CD偏差；TARC难去除导致残留污染。用反射率比较方案，膜厚/n/k确认稳定性，FEM分析成像/强度，CDU评估CD与窗口，缺陷图查表面图形，刻蚀后截面验证转移、残留与损伤。
body.en: Wrong dominant-interface identification gives poor ARC choice/suppression. Simulation mismatch may reflect material parameters or process variation. Hard BARC opening causes residue/CD shift; hard TARC removal causes contamination. Compare reflectance, verify thickness/n/k stability, analyze FEM imaging/intensity, assess CDU/window, map defects and inspect post-etch transfer/residue/damage.

heading.zh: 曝光体系边界：原图概括

body.zh: 原图概括：i-line反射相对易控，通常以BARC为主，可不加TARC；DUV反射更强，常需BARC或TARC并优化胶膜；193i关注浸没界面，常用TARC/Topcoat并组合BARC；多层胶干涉复杂，需考虑各层匹配；EUV反射机理不同，不沿用传统ARC方案，依赖吸收与图形设计。具体策略随波长、胶结构和集成要求变化。
body.en: The source summarizes i-line as relatively easier to control, often BARC-led with optional TARC; DUV as stronger-reflection and needing ARC/resist optimization; 193i as immersion-interface-sensitive with topcoat/TARC and BARC combinations; multilayer resist as requiring complex layer matching; and EUV as a different reflection regime that does not simply reuse traditional ARC approaches. Actual strategy depends on wavelength, resist structure and integration.

title.zh: 一张图看懂能带、导带与价带
title.en: Energy, conduction and valence bands at a glance

subtitle.zh: 从原子能级、费米能级到掺杂与能带弯曲
subtitle.en: From atomic/Fermi levels to doping and band bending

body.zh: 原子靠近后，离散能级分裂并汇聚成允许能带。能量E向上；孤立原子离散能级 → 多原子靠近、能级分裂 → 大量能级聚集形成导带、价带，两者之间为带隙E_g。
body.en: As atoms approach, discrete levels split and collect into allowed bands. Energy E increases upward. Isolated atomic levels → splitting as atoms approach → many closely spaced levels form conduction/valence bands separated by E_g.

body.zh: 两类允许能带承担不同成键与输运角色。导带E_c为电子输运能带，价带E_v为原子成键能带；橙色表示负电电子，空心圆表示正电空穴。
body.en: The two allowed bands serve different bonding/transport roles. E_c marks the conduction band for electrons; E_v marks the valence band associated with bonding. Orange denotes negatively charged electrons; hollow circles denote positive holes.

body.zh: 带隙描述允许态间隔，费米能级E_F描述占据倾向。费米–狄拉克分布：f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]；图中E=E_F处电子占据概率为0.5。
body.en: The gap describes separation between allowed states; E_F describes occupation tendency. Fermi–Dirac distribution: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]; occupation is 0.5 at E=E_F.

body.zh: 电子受光/热激发至导带（图示能量≥E_g），价带留下空穴；图示电子传导、空穴传导以及复合发光/放热。
body.en: Optical/thermal excitation moves electrons to the conduction band (energy ≥E_g illustrated), leaving holes. The diagram shows electron/hole conduction and recombination releasing light/heat.

body.zh: 原图以金属价带/导带重叠、无带隙，半导体带隙较小可热激发载流子，绝缘体带隙很大、载流子极少作示意；三者差异不只带隙大小。
body.en: The source schematically shows metal bands overlapping with no gap, a smaller semiconductor gap allowing thermal carriers, and a large insulator gap with very few carriers. Their differences are not only gap size.

body.zh: 本征半导体E_F在带隙中部附近，电子和空穴浓度相等。n型施主能级E_D近导带，E_F上移、电子为多数；p型受主能级E_A近价带，E_F下移、空穴为多数。
body.en: Intrinsic E_F lies near midgap with equal electron/hole concentrations. N-type donor E_D lies near the conduction band, raising E_F with electrons majority. P-type acceptor E_A lies near valence, lowering E_F with holes majority.

body.zh: 空间电势变化使E_c、E_v随位置移动。热平衡PN结图标p型、耗尽层、n型，E_c/E_v跨结弯曲而E_F平坦。
body.en: Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position. The equilibrium PN junction shows p-region, depletion and n-region; band edges bend while E_F remains flat.

body.zh: 按器件目标选材料、掺杂和界面势垒。原图举宽带隙用于高耐压/高温、中等带隙用于通用器件、窄带隙用于高速/光电；n型提高电子浓度，p型提高空穴浓度，本征/轻掺杂平衡特性；选择合适金属—半导体势垒高度φ_B以降低接触电阻、改善性能。
body.en: Select material, doping and interface barrier for device goals. Source examples associate wide gaps with high voltage/temperature, medium gaps with general devices and narrow gaps with high speed/optoelectronics. N/P doping raises electron/hole concentration; intrinsic/light doping balances properties. Choose a suitable metal–semiconductor barrier φ_B to reduce contact resistance and improve performance.

title.zh: 能带怎么来：晶体把离散能级展开成带
title.en: How bands arise: a crystal spreads discrete levels into bands

subtitle.zh: 原子轨道 / 能级分裂 / 周期势场 / 允许态
subtitle.en: Atomic orbitals / level splitting / periodic potential / allowed states

body.zh: 能带不是电子运行轨道，而是晶体中大量允许量子态的能量分布。孤立原子有分立能级（图示n=1、2、3）；两个原子靠近，每个能级分裂；轨道重叠，N个原子形成密集能级；形成晶体能带，分为价带、禁带、导带。图标E_c、E_v和带隙E_g。
body.en: Bands are not electron trajectories; they are the energy distribution of many allowed quantum states in a crystal. Isolated atoms have discrete levels (n=1,2,3 shown); approaching atoms split levels; overlapping orbitals in N atoms produce dense levels that form valence/conduction bands separated by a forbidden gap. Labels are E_c, E_v and E_g.

body.zh: 推理链：孤立原子离散能级 → 原子靠近、相互作用增强 → 轨道/波函数重叠 → 原图以泡利不相容描述每个能级分裂成N个 → 密集能级在宏观尺度呈连续能带。原子种类决定轨道能级与化学性质；晶体结构决定周期势场对称性；原子间距越小通常耦合越强；轨道耦合强度决定分裂大小。
body.en: Reasoning chain: discrete atomic levels → stronger interactions as atoms approach → orbital/wavefunction overlap → the source describes N-fold splitting through Pauli exclusion → dense levels appear as continuous bands macroscopically. Atomic species sets orbital energies/chemistry; crystal structure sets periodic-potential symmetry; shorter spacing generally increases coupling; coupling strength sets splitting.

body.zh: 能带不是轨道，电子在晶体中以波的形式运动；晶体能级并非凭空连续，而来自大量能级分裂聚集；缺陷和应变会引入局域态或改变带边。DFT等能带计算给出带隙、有效质量；ARPES直接量测动量空间能量关系；光学吸收边对应价带到导带跃迁，可确定带隙。
body.en: Bands are not orbits; electrons propagate as waves. Crystal energies do not become continuous arbitrarily but derive from many split, closely spaced levels. Defects/strain introduce localized states or shift edges. Band calculations such as DFT provide gaps/effective masses; ARPES measures energy versus momentum; optical absorption edges correspond to valence-to-conduction transitions and indicate the gap.

body.zh: 带隙E_g影响导电类型与光学性质；有效质量m*影响迁移率和输运；载流子输运影响速度与功耗；材料选择按能带结构匹配需求（金属、半导体、绝缘体）。真实材料并非完全规则：缺陷、杂质、应变、温度、低维量子限域都会改变带边、带隙或引入局域态。不同材料和k空间方向的能带不同，不能用单一模型覆盖全部。
body.en: E_g affects conduction classification and optical properties; effective mass m* affects mobility/transport; transport affects speed/power; choose metal, semiconductor or insulator bands for the application. Real materials are not perfectly periodic: defects, impurities, strain, temperature and low-dimensional confinement can shift edges/gaps or introduce localized states. Bands vary by material and k-space direction; one model cannot describe all cases.

notes.zh: “泡利不相容导致能级分裂”为原图的教学简化表述；本页同时保留其原子间相互作用与轨道耦合的前提。
notes.en: “Pauli exclusion causes level splitting” is the source’s pedagogical simplification; the preceding interaction and orbital-coupling context is retained.

title.zh: 导带与价带：有允许态不等于一定导电
title.en: Conduction and valence bands: allowed states alone do not ensure conduction

subtitle.zh: 导带底E_c / 价带顶E_v / 可用空态 / 载流子输运
subtitle.en: Conduction minimum E_c / valence maximum E_v / empty states / transport

body.zh: 导电既需可移动载流子，也需附近可进入的允许空态。导带电子带负电，价带空穴带正电，E_g=E_c−E_v。图示已占据态与可用空态；电子向右漂移、空穴等效向左漂移。导带输运需附近空态；空穴输运等价于价带电子向相反方向运动，需可被填充空态。
body.en: Conduction requires mobile carriers and nearby accessible empty allowed states. Electrons carry negative charge and holes positive charge; E_g=E_c−E_v. The diagram distinguishes occupied/empty states and shows rightward electron versus leftward hole drift. Conduction-band transport needs nearby empty states; hole motion corresponds to opposite valence-electron motion into empty states.

body.zh: 有载流子且有空态可导电；只有空态没有载流子不导电，只有载流子而无可进入空态难以持续导电。
body.en: Carriers plus available states enable conduction. Empty states without carriers do not conduct; carriers with no accessible empty states cannot sustain conduction in the illustrated picture.

body.zh: 标出E_v价带顶 → 标出E_c导带底 → 识别E_g → 判断载流子在导带/价带 → 结合空态、浓度和迁移率判断导电。带边位置决定带隙与热激发难易；态密度g(E)决定可用态数量；E_F占据情况决定实际载流子浓度；迁移率μ反映晶格中运动能力。
body.en: Mark E_v → mark E_c → identify E_g → locate electrons/holes in bands → assess empty states, concentration and mobility. Band edges set gap/thermal activation; density of states g(E) sets state availability; occupation via E_F determines carrier concentration; mobility μ describes motion through the lattice.

body.zh: σ=q(nμₙ+pμₚ)。提高n或p有助于增大电导，但杂质散射、晶格散射或缺陷使μ显著下降时，电导未必高。器件需在浓度、迁移率与其他性能间权衡。价带并非不参与电流，空穴也能导电；导带有电子不保证高导电；理想晶体禁带内几乎没有允许的延展态。
body.en: σ=q(nμₙ+pμₚ). Higher n or p helps conductivity, but impurity/lattice scattering or defects can reduce mobility enough to limit it. Balance concentration, mobility and other metrics. Valence holes do carry current; conduction-band electrons do not guarantee high conductivity; ideal crystal gaps have essentially no allowed extended states.

body.zh: 吸收光谱确定带隙；PL分析能带跃迁与缺陷能级；UPS/XPS光电子能谱测带边位置和功函数；电导率、霍尔等输运测试获得浓度和迁移率。缺陷、杂质及界面态可在理想带隙中引入局域态或施主/受主能级，显著影响浓度和导电。
body.en: Absorption estimates the gap; PL probes transitions/defect levels; UPS/XPS probes band-edge positions and work function; conductivity/Hall transport measures concentration/mobility. Defects, impurities and interface states can introduce localized or donor/acceptor states in the ideal gap and strongly affect carriers and conduction.

title.zh: 带隙与费米能级：一个管允许态，一个管占据率
title.en: Band gap and Fermi level: allowed states versus occupation

subtitle.zh: 禁带宽度 / 化学势 / 占据概率 / 平衡状态
subtitle.en: Gap width / chemical potential / occupation probability / equilibrium

body.zh: 带隙描述允许态之间的间隔；费米能级描述电子占据能态的倾向。本征半导体示意中，E_c以上与E_v以下有允许电子态，禁带无允许态。平衡时E_F在空间平坦，可位于禁带，即便该能量没有允许态。
body.en: The band gap describes separation between allowed states; Fermi level describes electron occupation tendency. In the intrinsic schematic, allowed states lie above E_c and below E_v, with none in the gap. At equilibrium E_F is spatially flat and can lie in the gap even without a state at that energy.

body.zh: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]。E<E_F时占据概率高、趋近1；E>E_F时低、趋近0；f(E_F)=0.5。E_F是化学势/能量参考，不是电子轨道。画E_c、E_v确定E_g → 标E_F → 叠加f(E)判断n、p → 推断类型：E_F近E_c为n型、近E_v为p型、在禁带中部附近为本征。
body.en: f(E)=1/[1+exp((E−E_F)/kT)]. Occupation tends toward 1 below E_F and 0 above it; f(E_F)=0.5. E_F is chemical potential/energy reference, not an orbit. Draw band edges/gap → mark E_F → combine f(E) with n/p → infer n-type near E_c, p-type near E_v and intrinsic near midgap.

body.zh: E_g影响本征浓度和温度敏感性；温度T升高使分布展宽、n_i增加；掺杂使n型E_F向E_c、p型向E_v移动；有效态密度N_c/N_v影响可用态与浓度。非简并形式：n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT]，p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]。温升可明显改变电导；掺杂增加多数载流子，重掺杂须考虑简并，经典近似可能失效。
body.en: E_g affects intrinsic concentration/temperature sensitivity; rising T broadens occupation and increases n_i. Doping moves E_F toward E_c for N-type and E_v for P-type. N_c/N_v influence available states and concentration. Nondegenerate forms: n=N_c exp[−(E_c−E_F)/kT], p=N_v exp[−(E_F−E_v)/kT]. Temperature can strongly change conductivity; doping increases majority carriers, but heavy doping requires degeneracy treatment.

body.zh: E_F不是实际轨道、不必处在能带内、通常也不等于E_c；原图说明极端n⁺简并时可能很接近。验证用功函数或光电子、Hall、C–V（图示1/C²–V）、温度依赖电导（lnσ–1/T）。非平衡如光照/偏压，应分别使用电子和空穴准费米能级E_Fn、E_Fp，不能只用单一平衡E_F。
body.en: E_F is not an orbit, need not lie inside a band and is generally not E_c; the source mentions close approach under extreme n⁺ degeneracy. Verification includes work-function/photoelectron, Hall, C–V (1/C²–V shown) and temperature-dependent conductivity (lnσ–1/T). Under illumination/bias nonequilibrium, use separate electron/hole quasi-Fermi levels E_Fn/E_Fp rather than one equilibrium E_F.

notes.zh: 分布图右侧E<E_F与E>E_F标注的上下位置和能量轴方向有冲突；正文保留正确对应的原图文字与公式，图形仍供对照。
notes.en: The vertical placement of the distribution panel’s E<E_F/E>E_F annotations conflicts with its energy-axis direction. The text retains the source formula and its correct probability statements while preserving the original for comparison.

title.zh: 电子与空穴：一次激发产生一对载流子
title.en: Electrons and holes: excitation creates a carrier pair

subtitle.zh: 热激发 / 光激发 / 电子—空穴对 / 产生与复合
subtitle.en: Thermal/optical excitation / electron–hole pairs / generation and recombination

body.zh: 电子跨越带隙进入导带，价带缺位等效为空穴参与输运。吸收光子hν或热能 → 获得足够能量跨E_g到E_c、在E_v留下空穴 → 电子和空穴在电场下各自导电 → 复合释放光子或声子。晶格示意中蓝色为原子（如Si）、橙色电子、虚线空心圆为空穴。
body.en: When an electron crosses the gap into conduction, its valence vacancy acts as a transporting hole. Absorb photon hν or heat → cross E_g to E_c, leaving a hole at E_v → electron/hole transport under a field → recombine, releasing photons or phonons. In the lattice, blue denotes atoms such as Si, orange electrons and dashed hollow circles holes.

body.zh: 温度越高热激发越强；hν≥E_g时可产生电子—空穴对；带隙越小越易激发、本征浓度越高。缺陷杂质提供非辐射复合通道，影响寿命。更高T或更强光增加载流子，但缺陷增加或高注入可能缩短有效寿命、增强非辐射复合并降低效率。
body.en: Higher temperature increases thermal excitation; hν≥E_g can create pairs; smaller gaps ease excitation and raise intrinsic concentration. Defects/impurities provide nonradiative paths and affect lifetime. Higher T or stronger light raises carriers, but defects/high injection may shorten effective lifetime, increase nonradiative recombination and reduce efficiency.

body.zh: 暗电流过大：无光电流偏高。寿命短：复合中心过多。光响应弱：吸收/收集效率低。高注入效率下降：非辐射复合增强。PL复合发光强度反映辐射效率；TRPL等寿命测试量电子/空穴寿命；暗/光I–V评估本征或缺陷暗电流；lnσ–1/T分析热激发和带隙。
body.en: High dark current means elevated unilluminated current; short lifetime suggests many recombination centers; weak photoresponse suggests poor absorption/collection; high-injection efficiency loss suggests stronger nonradiative recombination. PL probes radiative efficiency, TRPL probes lifetime, dark/light I–V evaluates intrinsic/defect dark current and lnσ–1/T probes activation/gap.

body.zh: 光探测器把光生载流子变电信号；太阳能电池分离并收集光生载流子；LED依电子空穴辐射复合发光；产生/复合影响漏电和开关速度。直接带隙如GaAs、InP辐射复合效率较高；间接带隙如Si需要声子参与动量守恒，辐射效率较低，发光及光电表现不同。
body.en: Photodetectors convert photocarriers to electrical signals; solar cells separate/collect them; LEDs emit through radiative recombination; generation/recombination affects leakage and switching. Direct-gap GaAs/InP have higher radiative efficiency; indirect-gap Si needs phonons for momentum conservation and has lower radiative efficiency, affecting optoelectronic use.

notes.zh: 原图同时写电子和空穴“向电场方向输运”，却画相反方向箭头；这是源图的方向表述冲突。正文仅保留二者受场输运的共同结论，不把该标注当作准确方向定律。
notes.en: The source labels both electrons and holes as moving “along the electric field” while drawing opposite arrows. This is a source-direction inconsistency. The text retains field-driven transport without treating those labels as a correct directional law.

title.zh: 三类材料：导电差异不只看带隙数字
title.en: Three material classes: conduction is not just a gap number

subtitle.zh: 能带占据 / 带重叠 / 热激发 / 电阻率
subtitle.en: Band occupation / overlap / thermal excitation / resistivity

body.zh: 电导由能带结构、E_F附近允许态、载流子浓度与迁移率共同决定。原图导体（金属）表：能带重叠或部分填充，E_g≈0；E_F附近态密度大；n约10²²–10²³ cm⁻³；迁移率中等、受散射限制；σ约10⁶–10⁸ S/m；温升时电阻通常增加（正温度系数）。
body.en: Conductivity depends jointly on band structure, allowed states near E_F, concentration and mobility. Source conductor/metal table: overlapping or partially filled bands, E_g≈0; large DOS near E_F; n≈10²²–10²³ cm⁻³; moderate scattering-limited mobility; σ≈10⁶–10⁸ S/m; resistance usually rises with temperature.

heading.zh: 半导体与绝缘体：原图范围

body.zh: 半导体表：E_g约0.1–3 eV，E_F附近态密度较小；浓度中等，由本征/掺杂决定；晶体质量好时迁移率较高；σ可调约10⁻⁶–10⁴ S/m；温升载流子增多，电导通常增加（本征负温度系数）。
body.en: Semiconductor table: E_g≈0.1–3 eV, smaller DOS near E_F; moderate intrinsic/doping-controlled concentration; higher mobility with good crystal quality; tunable σ≈10⁻⁶–10⁴ S/m; rising temperature typically increases intrinsic carriers and conductivity.

body.zh: 绝缘体表：E_g通常>3–5 eV，E_F附近几乎无态；本征浓度很低，迁移率通常较低；σ<10⁻¹⁰ S/m；常温难激发自由载流子，高温电导可能略增。图示E_c、E_v、E_F及态密度D(E)。
body.en: Insulator table: E_g typically >3–5 eV, almost no states near E_F; very low intrinsic concentration and usually lower mobility; σ<10⁻¹⁰ S/m; little thermal excitation at room temperature, possibly more conductivity at higher T. Diagrams label E_c, E_v, E_F and D(E).

body.zh: 画E_c/E_v/E_g/E_F → 判断E_F附近态 → 确定本征/掺杂/缺陷/注入载流子 → 考虑晶格/杂质散射迁移率 → 推断电导与温度响应。宽带隙本征载流子少、耐高温、低漏电，但注入、掺杂和低阻接触更难；窄带隙易导电、适于高速低压，但高温漏电与热稳定性较差。
body.en: Draw edges/gap/E_F → assess states near E_F → determine intrinsic/doped/defect/injected carriers → consider lattice/impurity-limited mobility → infer conductivity/temperature response. Wide gaps reduce intrinsic carriers/leakage and support high temperature, but complicate injection, doping and low-resistance contacts. Narrow gaps ease conduction/high-speed low-voltage use but worsen hot leakage/thermal stability.

body.zh: 电阻率—温度曲线比较材料；Hall图示R_H=1/(qn)，测n/p型、浓度与迁移率；吸收边估E_g；击穿I–V得V_br，评高场导电耐压。互连要高电导与热稳定；沟道要可控载流子和高迁移率；栅介质要大带隙低漏电；功率/光电关注宽带隙、耐高压和发光探测。
body.en: Compare resistivity–temperature curves; the Hall panel gives R_H=1/(qn) and measures carrier type/concentration/mobility; absorption edges estimate E_g; breakdown I–V gives V_br. Interconnects require conductivity/thermal stability; channels controlled carriers/high mobility; gate dielectrics large gaps/low leakage; power/optoelectronic materials high voltage and emission/detection properties.

body.zh: 不能只看一个E_g值分类，绝缘体也可能有缺陷或表面导电，不能忽略温度、缺陷、杂质和强场。分类还与能带形状、相、样品质量及测试条件有关。
body.en: Do not classify by E_g alone. Insulators can exhibit defect/surface conduction. Temperature, defects, impurities and strong fields matter, as do band shape, phase, sample quality and test conditions.

notes.zh: 数值范围和迁移率高低是原图的概括，非材料分类的严格阈值；原图Hall式R_H=1/(qn)是简化形式，符号及适用条件需结合载流子类型与测试模型。电阻率示意曲线与表格的金属温度响应并不完全一致，需以文字条件和实际量测为准。
notes.en: Numerical ranges and mobility rankings are source generalizations, not strict class thresholds. R_H=1/(qn) is simplified; sign/applicability depends on carrier type and model. The schematic metal resistivity curve does not fully agree with the table’s temperature statement; retain conditions and verify with measurement.

title.zh: 能带为什么弯：弯的是能量，不是晶圆
title.en: Why bands bend: energy bends, not the wafer

subtitle.zh: 空间电势 / 内建电场 / 耗尽区 / 界面电荷
subtitle.en: Spatial potential / built-in field / depletion / interface charge

body.zh: 空间电势随位置变化，E_c和E_v随之移动；热平衡E_F水平。PN结图标p型受主、n型施主、耗尽区/空间电荷区宽W、离化受主A⁻固定负电荷、离化施主D⁺固定正电荷及x方向。对应能带从p跨耗尽区到n弯曲，E_g示意不变。方向程度取决于材料、掺杂、功函数、偏压与符号约定，不能死记唯一形状。
body.en: Spatial potential shifts E_c/E_v with position; equilibrium E_F is flat. The PN diagram labels P acceptors, N donors, depletion/space-charge width W, fixed ionized A⁻ and D⁺ charges, and x. Corresponding bands bend across depletion with unchanged E_g in the schematic. Direction/magnitude depends on material, doping, work function, bias and conventions, not one universal shape.

body.zh: 两侧材料/掺杂差异、原费米能级及浓度不同 → 多数载流子向对侧扩散，留下离化杂质 → 形成耗尽区固定电荷 → 建立由n指向p的内建电场 → 空间电势使带边移动至热平衡。因素为N_A/N_D、正/反偏压、介质固定电荷（如氧化层）、界面态密度/电荷、金属/半导体功函数差及温度。
body.en: Different material/doping, initial Fermi levels and concentrations → majority-carrier diffusion leaving ionized dopants → fixed depletion charge → built-in field from N to P → band-edge shifts to equilibrium. Factors include N_A/N_D, bias, dielectric fixed charge, interface-state density/charge, metal/semiconductor work-function difference and temperature.

body.zh: 原图以p型MOS列：负V_G积累、表面空穴增加，文字称能带下弯；小正偏耗尽，称上弯；较大正偏反型，称进一步上弯。更强电场可改善静电控制、表面势变化与短沟道抑制，但可能增加隧穿、界面散射、泄漏及可靠性风险。
body.en: The source’s P-type MOS panels list negative-V_G accumulation/increased surface holes, labeled downward bending; small-positive-bias depletion, labeled upward bending; and larger-positive-bias inversion, labeled further upward bending. Stronger fields can improve electrostatic/short-channel control but increase tunneling, interface scattering, leakage and reliability risk.

body.zh: 固定电荷可能使能带整体移动；界面态过多造成E_F钉扎/阈值偏移；势垒异常阻碍注入、增接触电阻；耗尽宽异常提示掺杂或固定电荷问题；非理想接触可致势垒过大、整流或漏电。C–V提掺杂/耗尽宽度，I–V查整流/漏电/击穿，Kelvin测表面电势/功函数，光电子谱看带位/界面态，器件仿真比较电势/能带/载流子。
body.en: Fixed charge may shift bands; excessive interface states pin E_F/shift threshold; abnormal barriers impede injection/raise contact resistance; abnormal depletion width suggests doping/fixed-charge issues; nonideal contacts cause barriers, rectification or leakage. C–V extracts doping/depletion width; I–V probes rectification/leakage/breakdown; Kelvin probes surface potential/work function; photoemission probes bands/interfaces; simulation compares potential/bands/carriers.

body.zh: 下游影响MOS阈值、PN整流、金属/半导体接触电阻、LED/激光器/晶体管注入效率和漏电击穿可靠性。
body.en: Consequences include MOS threshold, PN rectification, contact resistance, LED/laser/transistor injection efficiency and leakage/breakdown reliability.

notes.zh: 原图MOS积累/耗尽/反型图对“上弯/下弯”的文字和常用p型MOS表面约定存在疑点，且横轴表面/体内方向未完整标出。已保留源图说法供核对，不应脱离坐标和偏置约定直接当作通用规律。PN空间图亦将固定电荷画到耗尽区外，是示意而非精确净电荷剖面。
notes.en: The MOS panels’ up/down-bending descriptions are questionable under conventional P-type surface conventions, and surface-to-bulk direction is incompletely labeled. Source wording is retained for checking, not as a coordinate-independent rule. The PN drawing also places fixed charges outside depletion and is schematic rather than a precise net-charge profile.

title.zh: 掺杂改能带：总杂质不等于有效载流子
title.en: Doping and bands: total impurities are not effective carriers

subtitle.zh: 施主能级 / 受主能级 / 电离激活 / 费米能级移动
subtitle.en: Donor/acceptor levels / ionization and activation / Fermi-level shifts

heading.en: Core conclusion and three band diagrams

body.zh: 掺杂改变载流子统计与E_F，最终电性还取决于电离、激活、补偿和缺陷。能量向上增加；本征n=p=n_i，E_F在禁带中部附近；n型引入E_D近E_c，n≫p，E_F上移；p型引入E_A近E_v，p≫n，E_F下移。图例为导带E_c、价带E_v、红虚线E_F、蓝虚线E_D、紫虚线E_A、蓝电子e⁻和空心空穴h⁺。
body.en: Doping changes carrier statistics and E_F, while final electrical behavior also depends on ionization, activation, compensation and defects. Energy rises upward. Intrinsic n=p=n_i with near-midgap E_F; N-type adds E_D near E_c, n≫p and raised E_F; P-type adds E_A near E_v, p≫n and lowered E_F. Legends label bands, red E_F, blue E_D, purple E_A, blue electrons and hollow holes.

body.zh: 在硅晶格替位引入P、As、B等杂质 → 禁带形成施主/受主能级 → 电离与激活（施主供电子，受主产生空穴）→ n型电子或p型空穴多数载流子增加 → E_F相应上/下移。
body.en: Introduce substitutional P, As, B and other dopants into silicon → form donor/acceptor gap levels → ionize/activate (donors supply electrons, acceptors generate holes) → increase majority carriers → shift E_F upward/downward.

body.zh: 控制掺杂种类（图列P、As、B、Al）、总浓度/激活率、补偿、空间分布。N_active=ηN_total，η≤1；施主受主共存相互补偿、降低有效载流子；均匀/非均匀剖面影响结深电性。增浓度可降片阻、增载流子，但增强杂质散射、降迁移率，并可能产生简并、带隙变窄、结漏电增加。
body.en: Control species (P, As, B, Al shown), total concentration/activation, compensation and spatial profile. N_active=ηN_total, η≤1. Coexisting donors/acceptors compensate; profiles affect junction depth/electrical behavior. Higher doping lowers sheet resistance/raises carriers but increases impurity scattering, reduces mobility and may cause degeneracy, gap narrowing and junction leakage.

body.zh: 失效为损伤/退火不足导致激活率低、补偿降低有效浓度、剖面偏移/扩散异常、残留位错或非晶层。SIMS量总元素、不区分激活；片阻与Hall反映电阻率、浓度、迁移率和有效输运；SRP/C–V量有效载流子深度分布。影响V_T、结深/结电容、重掺接触区欧姆电阻、反向漏电和击穿。
body.en: Failures include low activation from damage/insufficient anneal, compensation, shifted/diffused profiles and residual dislocations/amorphous layers. SIMS measures total elements without activation discrimination; sheet resistance/Hall characterize resistivity, carriers and mobility; SRP/C–V profiles effective carriers. Effects include V_T, junction depth/capacitance, heavily doped contact resistance, reverse leakage and breakdown.

body.zh: 浅能级模型适于常见Si浅施主/受主，不通用于深能级、重掺杂及SiC/GaN等宽带隙材料。实际能带可受带隙变窄、杂质带和缺陷态影响。掺杂只是起点，激活、补偿、缺陷和分布共同决定最终电性。
body.en: The shallow-level model applies to common shallow donors/acceptors in Si, not universally to deep levels, heavy doping or wide-gap SiC/GaN. Real bands may include gap narrowing, impurity bands and defect states. Activation, compensation, defects and distribution jointly determine final electrical behavior.

notes.zh: 原图掺杂种类小框只在四种元素下统一标“受主（p型）”，会混淆P/As与B/Al；正文列出元素但不沿用该统一标签，整体施主/受主流程按原图上方说明保留。
notes.en: The small species panel places a single “acceptor (P-type)” label beneath all four elements, which can confuse P/As with B/Al. The text lists the species without repeating that combined label; donor/acceptor behavior follows the source’s main explanation.

title.zh: 工艺选择：带隙、掺杂与势垒怎么配
title.en: Process selection: matching gap, doping and barriers

subtitle.zh: 材料体系 / 掺杂路线 / 接触界面 / 器件目标
subtitle.en: Material system / doping route / contact interface / device goals

body.zh: 没有单独最好的能带，须匹配电压、温度、速度、漏电和光学目标。原图表：Ge窄带隙约0.7 eV，本征载流子高、漏电倾向大、击穿场低、红外响应；Si中等带隙1.1 eV，载流子适中、漏电/场强中等、可见/近红外；GaN/SiC宽带隙3.2–3.4 eV，本征浓度很低、漏电小、场强高、紫外/可见。宽带隙高温高场更稳，但激活和低阻欧姆接触更难。
body.en: No band structure is best alone; match voltage, temperature, speed, leakage and optics. Source table: Ge ~0.7 eV, high intrinsic carriers/leakage, low breakdown field, infrared; Si 1.1 eV, moderate carriers/leakage/field, visible/near-IR; GaN/SiC 3.2–3.4 eV, very low intrinsic carriers/leakage, high field, UV/visible. Wide gaps improve high-temperature/field operation but complicate activation and low-resistance contacts.

body.zh: 原位掺杂在外延生长中引入：轮廓控制好、激活需求低、晶格损伤小、热预算低—中，典型外延层。扩散在高温使杂质向内：轮廓控制较差、激活需求较高、损伤小、热预算高，用深结/均匀掺杂。离子注入后退火：轮廓控制很好、需退火、损伤较大、热预算中—高，用浅结/精准轮廓。浓度影响电阻/阈值，过高增强散射漏电，需权衡激活与损伤。
body.en: In-situ epitaxial doping: good profile control, lower activation demand, little damage, low–medium thermal budget, used in epitaxial layers. Thermal diffusion: poorer profile control, higher activation demand as described, little damage, high budget, used for deep/uniform doping. Implantation plus anneal: very good profile control, anneal required, more damage, medium–high budget, used for shallow/precise profiles. Concentration affects resistance/threshold but excessive doping increases scattering/leakage.

body.zh: 欧姆接触：能带/功函数匹配，势垒薄或可隧穿，低电阻、界面态影响较小，用源漏/电极，挑战是高掺杂/低阻。肖特基：势垒φ_B形成整流，界面态影响可能大，接触电阻中—高，用二极管/传感器，需控势垒高。绝缘界面如栅氧：抑制注入，形成绝缘势垒，电阻很高，界面态决定阈值/可靠性，用MOS栅，需控稳定性。宽带隙低阻接触可通过高掺杂、金属选择或界面工程优化。
body.en: Ohmic contacts use alignment and thin/tunnelable barriers for low resistance, often at source/drain/electrodes, with high-doping/low-resistance challenges. Schottky contacts use φ_B for rectification; interface effects may be large and resistance medium–high, for diodes/sensors with barrier-height control. Dielectric interfaces such as gate oxide block injection, have high resistance and interface-dependent threshold/reliability, for MOS gates. Wide-gap contacts may need high doping, suitable metals or interface engineering.

body.zh: 明确电压/速度、温度、波长/漏电、可靠性目标 → 选材料带隙并评击穿光学与工艺可行性 → 定n/p、浓度、结深梯度、阈值电阻 → 选原位/扩散/注入及激活、热预算/损伤控制 → 设计欧姆/肖特基/绝缘界面、功函数与接触 → 电学测量对标并迭代。维度为E_g/临界场/耐温、迁移率/开关频率、掺杂浓度轮廓与激活、界面态/接触稳定性。
body.en: Define voltage/speed, temperature, wavelength/leakage and reliability → choose gap/material and assess breakdown/optics/process feasibility → set type, concentration, depth/gradient, threshold/resistance → select doping/activation/budget/damage control → design contacts/interfaces/work function → electrically verify and iterate. Assess gap/critical field/temperature, mobility/switching frequency, profile/activation and interface/contact stability.

body.zh: 宽带隙降漏电增击穿但激活接触难；重掺降阻却增散射、降迁移率、增漏电；低热预算减损伤却可能激活不足；高势垒抑漏电却增接触阻。风险：路线目标不匹配、激活不足或剖面偏移、势垒过高或E_F钉扎、界面态使阈值漂移/可靠性下降。
body.en: Wide gaps trade leakage/breakdown against activation/contacts; heavy doping trades resistance against scattering/mobility/leakage; low thermal budget may limit activation; high barriers suppress leakage but raise contact resistance. Risks include route/goal mismatch, poor activation/shifted profiles, excessive barriers/Fermi pinning and interface-induced threshold/reliability issues.

body.zh: Hall/片阻测浓度、迁移率和片阻；SIMS/SRP查掺杂分布、结深轮廓；C–V查掺杂、界面态与氧化层；I–V查接触、整流和漏电；吸收/发光查带隙、效率与材料质量。逻辑要高速低功耗低漏电；功率要高压高温可靠性；射频要高频低损耗；光电要特定波长吸收/发光；传感要高灵敏低噪。不同器件没有统一材料和工艺方案。
body.en: Hall/sheet resistance measures carriers/mobility/resistance; SIMS/SRP checks profiles/depth; C–V checks doping/interfaces/oxide; I–V checks contacts/rectification/leakage; optics checks gap/efficiency/material quality. Logic targets speed/low power/leakage; power targets voltage/temperature/reliability; RF high frequency/low loss; optoelectronics wavelength-specific absorption/emission; sensors sensitivity/low noise. No universal route covers all.

notes.zh: 材料表的数值、光谱范围及工艺热预算是原图定性/代表性比较，须按具体材料、结构、温度与实际配方使用，不能视为固定工艺规格。
notes.en: Material values, spectral ranges and thermal budgets are representative source comparisons, not fixed specifications; apply them with the specific material, structure, temperature and process.
